title: Dynamic Investment in Teamwork Skill: Theory and Experimental Evidence
affiliations: Purdue University, Department of Economics, Purdue University - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Dynamic Investment in Teamwork Skill: Theory and Experimental Evidence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Reviewed by Purdue IRB.
declarations.funderStatement: Internal funding from Daniels School of Business at Purdue.

detail.abstract: Teamwork and collaboration are increasingly important. To help understand the dynamics of teamwork skill formation, we provide the first systematic analysis of dynamic investment in teamwork skill. First, adopting a dynamic game approach, we construct a theoretical framework where investment in team skill creates persistent benefits and externalities for teammates, but where investment is risky because the benefits depend on successful team coordination. Second, we take this framework to the laboratory to gain insight into factors that influence dynamic investment in team skill. We find under-investment compared to the efficient benchmark. However, investment in team skill responds strongly to incentives, in line with specific patterns predicted by our theory. We also find that people's theory of mind and propensity to coordinate predict how much they invest in team skill. We conclude that careful design of team incentives and selection of team members can facilitate the dynamic development of teamwork skills.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析了团队合作技能的动态投资，通过理论建模和实验研究发现团队技能投资存在不足，但投资行为对激励敏感，且受心理理论和协调倾向影响。
AI.research_question: 团队合作技能形成的动态投资机制是什么？哪些因素影响团队技能的动态投资？
AI.motivation: 团队合作在现代社会中日益重要，但缺乏对团队技能动态投资机制的系统理解，需要研究如何促进团队技能的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用动态博弈方法构建理论框架，认为团队技能投资具有持久收益和队友外部性，但投资风险取决于团队协调的成功程度。
AI.method: 理论建模与实验室实验相结合的方法，通过实验验证理论预测并探究影响因素。
AI.findings: 发现团队技能投资低于效率基准，但投资对激励反应强烈；人们的心理理论和协调倾向能够预测团队技能投资水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析团队技能动态投资，构建了包含外部性和协调风险的理论框架，揭示了投资行为的心理机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为团队激励设计和成员选择提供实践指导，有助于促进团队合作技能的动态发展。

reference: MIT Sloan Research Paper No. 7316-25
title: The Fallacy of Concentration
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and State Street Associates

detail.title: The Fallacy of Concentration

publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Sloan School of Management Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Many investors believe that the U.S. stock market is riskier than it has been historically because a large fraction of its capitalization is concentrated in a few large technology companies. Some investors, therefore, conclude that they should rebalance their portfolios toward safer assets. The authors present clear evidence that the U.S. stock market has indeed become more concentrated. However, they also discuss practical and theoretical arguments and present persuasive empirical evidence that gives pause to the notion that investors should act to offset concentration.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了美国股市市值集中度提高的现象，承认市场确实更加集中于少数大型科技公司，但提出理论和实证证据表明投资者不应过度反应而重新调整资产配置。
AI.research_question: 美国股票市场市值集中度的提高是否应该促使投资者重新调整资产配置以降低风险？
AI.motivation: 许多投资者认为美国股市已变得更加风险，因为大部分市值集中在少数大型科技公司，并建议重新调整资产配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产配置理论、风险管理理论、市场集中度对投资策略的影响分析
AI.method: 实证分析方法，包括历史数据分析、市值集中度指标计算、风险测度比较
AI.findings: 美国股市市值集中度确实提高，但理论和实证证据不支持投资者应该为对抗此现象而重新调整资产配置
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于市场集中度与投资策略关系的新理论视角，质疑传统风险管理观念
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供理性投资决策指南，避免过度反应市场集中度现象而造成不必要的交易成本

title: When Strategy is a Dirty Word: The Role of Visuals in Sensegiving Strategy to a Skeptical Audience
affiliations: Loughborough University - Loughborough University London and University of East London

detail.title: When Strategy is a Dirty Word: The Role of Visuals in Sensegiving Strategy to a Skeptical Audience
detail.abstract: When setting a new strategy for their firm, managers engage in a range of sensegiving activities designed to introduce the new direction and explain the reasons for the change. These communication events commonly involve the use of strategic management terms and concepts to explain and justify the prescribed strategy. Literature thus far assumes that audiences understand and agree that these terms and underlying concepts are appropriate and relevant. Yet such views fail to explain strategy sensegiving in contexts where audiences of strategy presentations are ignorant or skeptical towards strategy concepts and ideas. We examine sensegiving under such conditions by analyzing a manager introducing a new strategy in a creative agency which expressed skepticism towards the concepts and practice of strategizing. Using data from video recordings of a sequence of internal strategy presentations, we identify three strategies designed to overcome prejudice towards strategic thinking while at the same time encouraging its use: winning the right to lead, finding resonance, and enrolling the audience into the strategy. We further find how these three sensegiving strategies are supported by carefully crafted visuals to either emphasize or deemphasize aspects of the strategy and its supporting rationale. Our findings extend the literature on the practice of strategy by illustrating how the visual supports sensegiving efforts to guide a firm's interpretation of a proposed new strategic direction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在创意广告公司中，经理如何通过视觉支持的感知给予策略来克服对战略概念的疑惑和偏见，包括获取领导权、找到共鸣和吸引观众参与等三种策略。
AI.research_question: 在观众对战略概念和思想存在忽视或疑惑的情况下，经理如何通过感知给予活动来介绍和推广新的战略方向？
AI.motivation: 现有文献假设观众理解并认同战略管理术语和概念，但这不能解释在观众忽视或疑惑战略概念的情境下的感知给予行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于战略实践理论和感知给予理论，重点关注经理如何通过沟通活动影响组织成员对新战略的理解和接受程度。
AI.method: 分析一家创意广告公司内部一系列战略展示的视频记录，详细研究经理在面对对战略概念疑惑的观众时的感知给予策略。
AI.findings: 识别出三种关键感知给予策略：获取领导权（证明自己的可信赖性）、找到共鸣（与观众的价值观和兴趣点建立联系）、吸引观众参与战略（让观众成为战略形成的一部分），这些策略都通过精心设计的视觉资料来强调或弱化战略的某些方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了战略实践文献，详细说明了视觉支持如何支持感知给予努力，引导公司对建议的新战略方向进行解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经理们提供了具体的工具和方法，帮助他们在面对对战略概念疑惑或忽视的观众时，有效地介绍和推广新的战略方向。

title: Privacy Concerns towards Information Privacy in Hybrid Teams: A Mauritian Context
affiliations: Open University of Mauritius, University of Technology, Mauritius (UTM) and Open University of Mauritius

detail.title: Privacy Concerns towards Information Privacy in Hybrid Teams: A Mauritian Context
detail.abstract: Innovative technology has revolutionized the future of work and will continue to play a vital role in hybrid working arrangements. Technology brings forward the introduction of new threats which increases privacy concerns amongst users. Research around privacy concerns has been explored using different lenses with variance in findings. The Privacy paradox theory has been put forward in various studies as an explanation for inconsistencies where users report having worries about their online privacy but have irresponsible online behavior. This study will examine the privacy paradox theory in the hybrid working environment. A quantitative methodology on a sample population working in hybrid mode (N=204) was followed by using an adaptation of the Concern for Information Privacy scale. The key findings of this study conclude a correlation between behavior and privacy concerns with a p-value of 0.012 but however having a weak relationship. It was also found that there is a disparity of behavior in the working generation with baby boomers showing more concerns and having positive behavior than Gen Z. Gender also influences behavior and concerns, with females exhibiting different behaviors as compared to males. There is a strong positive correlation between privacy awareness and concerns and between privacy awareness and behavior.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过定量研究检验了混合工作环境中的隐私矛盾理论，发现隐秀担忧与行为存在弱相关关系，不同代际和性别群体在隐私行为上存在显著差异，隐私意识与担忧和行为均呈强正相关关系。
AI.research_question: 混合工作环境中是否存在隐私矛盾现象？隐私担忧是否与实际行为存在矛盾关系？
AI.motivation: 创新技术改变了工作方式，特别是混合工作模式的普及带来新的隐私风险和担忧。尽管用户报告担忧但行为不一致的隐私矛盾现象在多个研究中被提出，但在混合工作环境中的验证仍不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐私矛盾理论（Privacy Paradox Theory） - 指出用户虽然报告担忧个人隐私，但在实际行为中却显示出不负责任的在线行为
AI.method: 定量研究方法，采用适配版的信息隐私担忧量表（CFIP），样本为204名混合工作模式的员工
AI.findings: 1. 隐私担忧与行为存在统计显著的相关关系（p=0.012），但关联强度弱 2. 不同代际工作者行为存在差异：宝宝潮一代比Z世代更关注隐私且行为更正面 3. 性别影响隐私行为和担忧，女性与男性展现不同行为模式 4. 隐私意识与担忧、隐私意识与行为均呈强正相关关系
AI.theory_contributions: 在混合工作环境中验证了隐私矛盾理论，发现矛盾现象并非绝对存在，而是一种弱相关关系，为该理论提供了更精细的实证支撑
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织制定混合工作隐私保护政策提供指导，建议根据不同代际和性别的差异采取差异化的隐私教育和保护措施，并强调提高隐私意识对于改善隐私行为的重要性

title: From Dum Diversas to Digital Dominance: Preventing AI driven Technocolonialism Through Historical Pattern Recognition
affiliations: King’s College London, Dickson Poon School of Law

detail.title: From Dum Diversas to Digital Dominance: Preventing AI driven Technocolonialism Through Historical Pattern Recognition
detail.abstract: This paper traces the evolution of colonial exploitation from the 15th-century papal doctrine of Dum Diversas to contemporary technocolonialism mediated by artificial intelligence systems. The analysis integrates two complementary frameworks: the doctrinal triad of ideological justification, legal fiction, and economic extraction identified in post-slavery colonial mechanisms, and the foundational papal bulls that established sovereignty override as the core principle of colonial domination. By examining how corporate entities-from colonial trading companies to modern tech corporations-have pioneered exploitative mechanisms including eugenics-driven sterilisation of "surplus humanity, this paper develops an early warning system for preventing potentially putative digital colonialism such as predictive policing and algorithmic hires. The framework identifies governance vulnerabilities such as corporate concentration, algorithmic consent mechanisms, and cognitive extraction, while proposing institutional safeguards to preserve human agency and democratic oversight in AI-governed societies.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了从15世纪教皇教义到当代AI技术殖民主义的殖民剥削演变，提出了基于意识形态辩护、法律虚构和经济抽取的三重框架，分析了企业从殖民贸易公司到现代科技公司的剥削机制，并开发了预防数字殖民主义的预警系统。
AI.research_question: 殖民剥削机制如何从15世纪的教皇教义演变到当代的人工智能技术殖民主义？
AI.motivation: 理解殖民剥削的历史延续性和现代技术形式，为预防数字殖民主义提供理论框架和预警机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 意识形态辩护-法律虚构-经济抽取的三重教义框架；2) 建立主权覆盖原则的教皇诏书基础理论；3) 技术殖民主义理论
AI.method: 历史分析和理论框架整合，通过案例研究（从殖民贸易公司到现代科技公司）分析剥削机制的演变
AI.findings: 1) 殖民剥削机制在历史上具有连续性；2) 现代科技公司继承了殖民企业的剥削模式；3) AI系统可能成为新的殖民工具；4) 识别了企业集中、算法同意机制和认知抽取等治理漏洞
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了殖民剥削的三重理论框架；2) 建立了历史殖民主义与现代技术殖民主义的理论联系；3) 发展了数字殖民主义预警理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发了预防数字殖民主义的早期预警系统；2) 提出了保护人类自主权和民主监督的制度保障措施；3) 为AI治理社会提供了具体的政策建议

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-042
title: Intergenerational Mobility in Latin America: The Multiple Facets of Social Status and the Role of Mothers
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de La Plata (UNLP), Universidad Nacional de La Plata (UNLP) and ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research - Labour Markets, Human Resources and Social Policy Department

detail.title: Intergenerational Mobility in Latin America: The Multiple Facets of Social Status and the Role of Mothers

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-042
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We assess intergenerational mobility in terms of education and income rank in five Latin American countries—Brazil, Chile, Ecuador, Mexico, and Panama—by accounting for the education and occupation of both parents. Based on the Lubotsky and Wittenberg (2006) approach, we find that intergenerational persistence estimates increase by 26% to 50% when parents’ occupations are considered alongside their education to proxy family socioeconomic background. The increase is particularly strong when education is more evenly distributed in the parents’ generation. Furthermore, we assess how the informativeness of each proxy for parental background evolves across countries and over time, and find that maternal characteristics have become increasingly informative in recent decades, in line with rising women’s educational attainment and labor force participation. Interesting heterogeneities across countries and cohorts are observed.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了五个拉美国家（巴西、智利、厄瓜多尔、墨西哥和巴拿马）的教育和收入代际流动性，发现同时考虑父母教育和职业作为家庭社会经济背景代理变量时，代际持续性估计值增加26%至50%。母亲特征的信息价值随时间增加，与女性教育程度和劳动力参与率上升一致。
AI.research_question: 在考虑父母教育和职业作为家庭社会经济背景代理变量的情况下，五个拉美国家的教育和收入代际流动性如何？父母职业信息的加入如何影响代际持续性估计？
AI.motivation: 传统代际流动性研究通常仅使用父母教育作为家庭背景代理变量，可能低估真实的代际持续性。需要同时考虑父母职业等其他维度来更全面衡量家庭社会经济背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Lubotsky和Wittenberg（2006）的方法论框架，使用多维度代理变量来估计家庭社会经济背景对代际流动性的影响。
AI.method: 使用Lubotsky和Wittenberg（2006）方法，同时考虑父母教育和职业作为家庭社会经济背景的代理变量，分析五个拉美国家的代际流动性和持续性。
AI.findings: 1. 同时考虑父母教育和职业时，代际持续性估计值增加26%-50%；2. 当父母代教育分布更均匀时，增加效应更强；3. 母亲特征的信息价值随时间增加，与女性教育程度和劳动力参与率上升相关；4. 存在国家和队列间的异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了代际流动性研究的理论框架，证明多维度代理变量能更准确估计家庭背景影响，特别是母亲特征的重要性随时间增强。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供更准确的代际流动性估计，强调需要同时考虑父母教育和职业等多个维度来制定更有效的社会流动性政策。

title: A Study on Challenges and Problems Faced by Electric Vehicle and its Impact on Buying Behaviour of Customer

detail.title: A Study on Challenges and Problems Faced by Electric Vehicle and its Impact on Buying Behaviour of Customer
detail.abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) mark a significant shift in the automotive sector, offering notable environmental and technological advantages. There are several factors that impact the EV are Range Anxiety remains a major concern for potential buyers who worry about EVs' limited driving range compared to conventional vehicles. This apprehension about battery life often leads consumers to prefer traditional vehicles that provide greater range and easier refuelling options. Charging Infrastructure is another significant challenge. The current lack of adequate and evenly distributed charging stations makes it inconvenient for potential EV owners, discouraging them from adopting electric vehicles. Concerns about finding reliable and accessible charging points often deter consumers from making the switch to EVs. The High Initial Cost of EVs continues to be a major deterrent. Despite the lower overall operating costs of EVs, the higher purchase price compared to traditional vehicles is a considerable barrier for many buyers.

AI.tldr: 电动汽车推广的三大主要障碍：量程焦虑、充电基础设施不足、购买成本较高

AI.motivation: 电动汽车具有重要环境和技术优势，但推广遍及遇到重大障碍，需要识别关键阻碍因素
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者采纳理论、技术接受模型、投资回报理论
AI.method: 文献综述分析法，基于现有研究识别关键障碍因素
AI.findings: 量程焦虑、充电基础设施缺乏、高初始购买成本是阻碍电动汽车普及的三大主要因素
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了消费者采纳新技术产品的理论框架，特别是在可持续发展和清洁能源领域
AI.practical_contributions: 为汽车制造商、政府政策制定者和基础设施投资者提供了有效的市场推广策略建议

title: From Crisis to Control - A Retrospective Enterprise Architecture Analysis of Cybersecurity Transformation
affiliations: University of Liverpool

detail.title: From Crisis to Control - A Retrospective Enterprise Architecture Analysis of Cybersecurity Transformation
detail.abstract:
This study analyses the cybersecurity transformation of a large regulated financial institution in Kazakhstan during 2021, applying a retrospective enterprise architecture (EA) perspective through the updated 2025 EA lens to evaluate strategic, operational, and human-factor changes. Using a case study approach, the analysis integrates incident management metrics, regulatory requirements, and EA frameworks, supported by internal operational data and external literature.

Over a five-month transformation period, incident resolution times improved significantly, with the 90th percentile reduced from nearly 30 days - the internal compliance limit - to one day. This was achieved through a Kanban-based operational redesign, expanded analyst capabilities, and clearer separation of incident and problem management. Stakeholder confidence improved, although challenges with informal expectations and workload balance persisted.

The findings show how EA principles can be applied in highly regulated operational contexts to balance rapid tactical response with sustained strategic improvement. The study contributes to bridging operational practice with EA theory in the cybersecurity domain, analysed through the updated 2025 EA lens. The four-year gap between the transformation and this retrospective analysis helped to minimise researcher bias, enabling a more objective evaluation of outcomes. The work offers a replicable framework for systematic security improvement in regulated industries, tested in a challenging regulatory environment, and grounded in proven techniques that balance tactical agility with strategic capability development.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过2025企业架构视角，分析了哈萨克斯坦一家大型受监管金融机构2021年的网络安全转型，展示了企业架构原则如何在高度监管环境中平衡快速战术响应与持续战略改进。
AI.research_question: 企业架构原则如何在高度监管的金融机构网络安全环境中平衡战术响应与战略改进？
AI.motivation: 探讨在严格监管环境下如何应用企业架构理论来优化网络安全运营，弥合操作实践与企业架构理论之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于更新的2025企业架构视角，结合事件管理指标、监管要求和企业架构框架。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，整合事件管理指标、监管要求和EA框架，使用内部运营数据和外部文献支持。
AI.findings: 五个月转型期内，事件解决时间显著改善，90百分位数从近30天降至1天；通过看板运营重新设计、分析师能力扩展和事件与问题管理分离实现改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 弥合网络安全领域操作实践与企业架构理论之间的差距，提供了在监管环境中应用EA原则的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管行业提供了可复制的系统安全改进框架，在具有挑战性的监管环境中测试，并基于平衡战术敏捷性与战略能力发展的成熟技术。

title: Self-Employment as a Signal: Career Concerns with Hidden Firm Performance
affiliations: , National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow) - International College of Economics and Finance and CREST Ecole Polytechnique

detail.title: Self-Employment as a Signal: Career Concerns with Hidden Firm Performance
detail.abstract: We analyze a dynamic labor market in which a worker with career concerns chooses each period between (i) self-employment that makes output publicly observable and (ii) employment at a firm that pays a flat wage but keeps individual performance hidden from outside observers. Output is binary and the worker is risk averse. The worker values future opportunities through a reputation for talent; firms may be benchmark (myopic) (ignoring the informational content of an application) or equilibrium (updating beliefs from the very act of applying). Three forces shape equilibrium: an insurance-information trade-off, selection by reputation, and inference from application decisions. We show that (i) an absorbing employment region exists in which low-reputation workers strictly prefer the firm's insurance and optimally cease producing public information; (ii) sufficiently strong reputation triggers self-employment in order to generate public signals and preserve future outside options; and (iii) with equilibrium firms, application choices act as signals that shift hiring thresholds and wages even when infirm performance remains opaque. Comparative statics deliver sharp, testable predictions for the prevalence of self-employment, the cyclicality of switching, and wage dynamics across markets with different degrees of performance transparency. The framework links classic career-concerns models to contemporary environments in which some tasks generate portable, public histories while firm tasks remain unobserved by the outside market (e.g., open-source contributions, freelancing platforms, or sales roles with standardized public metrics). Our results rationalize recent empirical findings on the value of public performance records and illuminate when opacity inside firms dampens or amplifies reputational incentives.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了职业考虑下劳动者在自主经营和企业就业之间的动态选择，揭示了保险与信息的交换、声誉选择和申请信号三大机制形成的均衡，并提出了可测试的预测
AI.research_question: 在职业考虑下，劳动者如何在自主经营（产出公开可观测的输出）和企业就业（隐藏个人表现但提供保险）之间进行动态选择？
AI.motivation: 理解当代劳动市场中的职业选择动机，特别是在某些工作产生公开可穿越的历史记录（如开源贡献、自由职业平台、销售角色），而企业内部任务却保持不透明的环境下
AI.theoretical_framework: 职业考虑模型、信号传递理论、风险避免理论，重点考虑保险与信息的交换、声誉选择和申请信号传递三大机制
AI.method: 动态游戏理论模型，包含二元输出、风险避免的劳动者、知同企业（忽视申请信息）和均衡企业（根据申请行为更新信念）的偏好
AI.findings: （1）存在吸收性就业区域，低声誉劳动者偏好企业保险；（2）充足强的声誉导致自主经营以产生公开信号；（3）均衡企业下申请选择作为信号影响招聘阈值和工资
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典职业考虑模型扩展到当代劳动市场环境，提供了公开与不透明任务的结合分析框架，丰富了声誉机制理论
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了公开表现记录的价值，明确了企业内部不透明性对声誉激励的影响，为自主经营领域的实践提供理论指导

title: Leveraged ETF Issuance During Market Stress and the Mechanics of Profit: Who's the Dog, Who's the Tail?
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Leveraged ETF Issuance During Market Stress and the Mechanics of Profit: Who's the Dog, Who's the Tail?
detail.abstract:
This paper examines daily share creation and redemption in leveraged and inverse ETFs (LETFs), focusing on ProShares UltraPro QQQ (TQQQ), the largest LETF with more than $25 billion in assets. 

TQQQ is routinely cited as proof that leveraged ETFs “work.” The evidence shows the opposite. Across nine full market cycles from 2010–2025, more than $25 billion of new exposure was created during drawdowns, while roughly $20 billion was redeemed during rebounds. Shares outstanding expand as prices collapse and contract as prices recover. These flows are not evidence of “retail buying high and selling low,” but the consistent footprint of issuer and swap-counterparty incentives: creations during stress monetize embedded, mathematically guaranteed decay, while redemptions during recoveries crystallize profits and eliminate future payout liability just as the path turns favorable for holders.

This mechanism is systematic, not random, and statistically significant across all stress episodes. The Day-Late-Dollar-Richer (DLDR) strategy (Bezdjian, 2025, SSRN 5360727) replicates issuer behavior directly: trading just 1/100,000th of daily issuance generated ~$288,000 in profit, equivalent to billions at scale. DLDR proves that decay is not incidental but deliberately harvested, the math is embedded in the product design, providing an easy mechanism for anyone, even retail, to profit along with issuers.

Headline appreciation, such as TQQQ’s multi-thousand-percent gains, masks this distributional reality. TQQQ scaled into a $25B flagship, yet flows consistently advantaged issuers by locking in gains through redemptions or expanding fee/decay through creations. Meanwhile, inverse products like SQQQ absorbed perpetual inflows in the billions and decayed by more than 99%, demonstrating that the ecosystem functions as a closed system: long products showcase eye-catching gains on shrinking floats, while inverse products recycle investor capital into inevitable decay. The scale, timing, and uniformity of these flows are incompatible with random retail behavior. They reflect fiduciary allocations through pooled accounts and collective trusts, executed in a manner that guarantees issuers and swap counterparties profit regardless of market path.

The implication is direct: LETFs are not neutral vehicles but a distribution mechanism engineered around mathematically guaranteed decay, ensuring a one-way transfer of wealth from investors to product manufacturers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析TQQQ等杠杆ETF的每日份额创建和赎回模式，揭示了杠杆ETF并非中性投资工具，而是基于数学保证衰减的财富转移机制，使发行商和互换对手方在任何市场环境下都能获利。
AI.research_question: 杠杆和反向ETF（LETFs）的每日份额创建和赎回模式如何反映发行商和互换对手方的激励机制？
AI.motivation: TQQQ作为规模超过250亿美元的最大杠杆ETF，常被引用作为杠杆ETF"有效"的证据，但实际证据显示相反情况，需要揭示其内在的财富转移机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Day-Late-Dollar-Richer（DLDR）策略理论，证明衰减不是偶然的而是被刻意收获的，数学机制嵌入在产品设计中。
AI.method: 分析2010-2025年九个完整市场周期中TQQQ的每日份额创建和赎回数据，使用DLDR策略进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 超过250亿美元的新风险敞口在下跌期间创建，约200亿美元在反弹期间赎回；份额数量在价格崩溃时扩张，在价格恢复时收缩；DLDR策略交易仅1/100,000的日发行量就产生约28.8万美元利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了杠杆ETF的系统性衰减机制，证明其不是随机零售行为而是发行商激励的结构性结果，提出了财富转移的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别杠杆ETF真实机制的工具，证明即使是零售投资者也可以通过与发行商相同的方式获利，揭示了 fiduciary allocations 通过集合账户执行的模式。

title: A PRISMA-Based Systematic Review on Optimizing Customer Experience through AI, AR, VR, and Big Data: The Case of H&M Online Platform

detail.title: A PRISMA-Based Systematic Review on Optimizing Customer Experience through AI, AR, VR, and Big Data: The Case of H&M Online Platform
detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) 2 , Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), and Big Data has significantly transformed customer engagement and value creation in the fashion retail industry. Despite growing interest, most existing studies have examined these technologies in isolation, lacking an integrated perspective on their combined potential within a single brand context. This study addresses this gap by systematically reviewing literature published between 2015 and 2025, focusing on the H&M online platform as a case study. The research employs the PRISMA 2020 framework to ensure transparency and replicability, and grounds the analysis in the Dynamic Capabilities View (DCV) and the Resource-Based View (RBV) theoretical frameworks, supplemented by the Digital Customer Experience model.The findings reveal that the concurrent application of AI, AR, VR, and Big Data across all stages of the customer journey, from prepurchase to post-purchase, enables deep personalization, enhanced emotional engagement, operational efficiency, and sustainable competitive advantage. The study further categorizes implementation challenges into technical, organizational, ethical, and infrastructural dimensions, offering strategic insights for overcoming these barriers. This research contributes to theory by integrating emerging technologies with established management perspectives, resulting in a transferable conceptual model for digital strategy design in fashion retail. Practically, it highlights the importance of coordinated investment in these four technologies, supported by robust infrastructures, skilled personnel, and clear ethical guidelines. Future research should incorporate primary data collection and comparative analyses across industries to validate and extend these findings.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献综述和H&M案例研究，探讨AI、AR、VR和大数据在时尚零售中的整合应用，基于动态能力观和资源基础观理论框架，发现这些技术在客户旅程各阶段能实现深度个性化、情感参与和竞争优势，并提出实施挑战的四个维度及战略建议。
AI.research_question: 人工智能、增强现实、虚拟现实和大数据如何整合应用于时尚零售业，以提升客户参与度和价值创造？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多孤立考察这些技术，缺乏在单一品牌背景下整合应用的视角，需要系统性的整合研究来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力观（DCV）、资源基础观（RBV）和数字客户体验模型
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020框架对2015-2025年文献进行系统综述，以H&M在线平台为案例研究
AI.findings: 四种技术在整个客户旅程（从购买前到购买后）的并发应用能够实现深度个性化、增强情感参与、运营效率和可持续竞争优势，实施挑战可分为技术、组织、伦理和基础设施四个维度
AI.theory_contributions: 将新兴技术与成熟管理视角整合，提出了可迁移的数字战略设计概念模型
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了协调投资四种技术的重要性，需要强大基础设施、熟练人员和明确伦理准则的支持

title: Russia-Ukraine War: A Quantitative Analysis of Global Fertilizer Supply Chains & Investment Opportunities
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Russia-Ukraine War: A Quantitative Analysis of Global Fertilizer Supply Chains & Investment Opportunities
detail.abstract: The Russia-Ukraine war has profoundly disrupted global fertilizer markets, with cascading effects on agricultural production, food security, and investment dynamics. This paper presents a quantitative analysis of fertilizer supply chains before and after the conflict, drawing on price series data, trade flow statistics, and geopolitical event timelines. We examine the volatility of nitrogen, potash, and phosphates and trace ripple effects across major agricultural economies. Findings show that concentrated supply chains magnify geopolitical risks, leading to sharp fertilizer price shocks and reshaped trade flows. The analysis further evaluates investment opportunities and risks in fertilizer companies and related commodity markets, offering insights for policymakers, agribusiness stakeholders, and investors. By combining event-driven analysis with supply chain data, this study provides a framework for understanding how geopolitical shocks translate into systemic risks and potential investment openings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定量分析俄乌战争前后全球化肥供应链的变化，发现集中化的供应链放大了地缘政治风险，导致化肥价格剧烈波动和贸易流向重塑，为政策制定者、农业企业和投资者提供了系统性风险理解和投资机会的框架。
AI.research_question: 俄乌战争如何影响全球化肥供应链，以及这种地缘政治冲击如何转化为系统性风险和投资机会？
AI.motivation: 俄乌战争深刻扰乱了全球化肥市场，对农业生产、粮食安全和投资动态产生了连锁影响，需要系统分析这种地缘政治冲击的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于供应链风险理论和地缘政治经济学，分析集中化供应链在地缘政治冲击下的脆弱性和传导机制。
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，结合价格序列数据、贸易流量统计和地缘政治事件时间线，对氮肥、钾肥和磷肥的波动性进行事件驱动分析。
AI.findings: 集中化的供应链放大了地缘政治风险，导致化肥价格急剧冲击和贸易流向重塑，主要农业经济体受到连锁影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将地缘政治冲击转化为系统性风险的理解框架，深化了供应链风险理论在地缘政治背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、农业企业利益相关者和投资者提供了化肥公司和相关商品市场的投资机会与风险评估，有助于应对地缘政治冲击带来的市场变化。

title: Restructuring Patent Linkage
affiliations: Texas A&M University School of Law

detail.title: Restructuring Patent Linkage

publicationDetails.detailsText: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper’s focus is on the woes that result from patent linkage resulting in delays in the introduction of less expensive post-patent drugs into the market. The paper traces the history and the operation of patent linkage in the United States to underscore how the patent linkage mechanism in the United States results in woes that the enactment of the Hatch-Waxman statute sought to address in the first place. Thus, patent linkage delays the launch of generic, and/or leads to extended market monopoly of the branded drug, resulting in denying low cost access to post-patent drugs for consumers.

AI.tldr: 专利链接机制导致仿制药延迟上市，延长品牌药市场垄断，阻碍消费者获得低成本后专利药物
AI.research_question: 专利链接机制如何导致仿制药延迟上市并影响消费者获得低成本药物
AI.motivation: 分析专利链接机制对药物市场竞争和消费者福利的负面影响，揭示其与Hatch-Waxman法案初衷相悖的问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利法、药品监管制度、市场竞争理论、消费者福利理论
AI.method: 历史追溯法和运行机制分析，研究美国专利链接制度的历史发展和实际操作
AI.findings: 专利链接机制导致仿制药延迟上市，延长品牌药市场垄断期，阻碍消费者获得低成本后专利药物
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示专利链接机制与药品专利制度初衷的矛盾，为专利制度改革提供理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改革专利链接机制的建议，促进仿制药及时上市，降低药品价格，提高消费者福利

title: Rail Concessions in Africa: Prigogine Lifts Lyapunov
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Rail Concessions in Africa: Prigogine Lifts Lyapunov
detail.abstract: This paper reframes the history and policy of African railway concessions under the structural adjustment programmes (SAP) of the 1990s and 2000s. It does so through the dual lenses of Lyapunov stability and Prigogine's theory of dissipative structures. Lyapunov gives a grammar for local stability, asking whether a rail project returns to health after small shocks. Prigogine shows how systems driven far from equilibrium can cross thresholds and self-organise into new, sometimes higher-entropy regimes. The state, market, and society are treated as a three-body system with adaptive links: the state and market young, society old but strained. Institutions, in Douglass North's sense of norms and values made operative, are conceived as parameters that shift stability margins. Distress is interpreted not as a singular event but as a trajectory in which the system leaves its viable set because institutions and feedback are misaligned. The record of African rail concessions-Sitarail, Camrail, Transrail, Madarail, RSZ, Rift Valley Railways, CCFB, CEAR/CDN, Ressano Garcia, and TRL-illustrates this dynamic. Each case shows how reserves of stability were consumed and how new regimes emerged when far-from-equilibrium driving overwhelmed local order. Together these insights yield a design grammar for the next generation of African rail, grounded both in the mathematics of stability and the political economy of SMS dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过李雅普诺夫稳定性和普里高津耗散结构理论的双重视角，重构了1990-2000年代非洲铁路特许经营的历史和政策，提出了基于稳定性数学和政治经济学的下一代非洲铁路设计框架。
AI.research_question: 非洲铁路特许经营在结构调整计划背景下如何经历稳定性变化和制度转型？
AI.motivation: 重新审视非洲铁路特许经营的历史和政策，从系统稳定性角度理解其发展轨迹和制度演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 李雅普诺夫稳定性理论（局部稳定性分析）、普里高津耗散结构理论（远离平衡态的系统自组织）、道格拉斯·诺斯的制度理论（规范和价值操作化）。
AI.method: 案例分析法，考察Sitarail、Camrail、Transrail等10个非洲铁路特许经营项目的稳定性动态和制度演变。
AI.findings: 非洲铁路特许经营系统在远离平衡态的驱动下消耗稳定性储备，最终自组织形成新的制度体系；制度参数和反馈机制的错配导致系统离开可行集。
AI.theory_contributions: 将稳定性数学理论与政治经济学相结合，为基础设施制度分析提供了新的理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为下一代非洲铁路设计提供了基于稳定性数学和政治经济学的设计语法和实用指导原则。

title: Driving Systemic Change in Women's Health: The Tara Health Foundation's Spend-Down Model and Multicapital Approach
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Driving Systemic Change in Women's Health: The Tara Health Foundation's Spend-Down Model and Multicapital Approach

declarations.ethicsApproval: Written consent for publication has been obtained from all individuals interviewed to write the case.
declarations.funderStatement: This case study research is part of the Owning Impact Project at MIT, with funding from an anonymous donor and the Center for Innovation in Sustainable Business.

detail.abstract: This case study examines the Tara Health Foundation’s evolving systemic investing model for addressing entrenched racial and gender inequities in U.S. reproductive and maternal health. Founded in 2014 by Dr. Ruth Shaber as a 20-year spend-down vehicle, Tara began as a founder-led philanthropic foundation and progressively realigned 100% of its financial and human capital to a single mission—improving reproductive and maternal health—operationalized through a deliberate multicapital strategy (grants, equity, low-interest debt, and intensive human-capital support). Over time, Tara shifted from opportunistic, founder-directed giving to a research-driven, collaborative approach that identified structural gaps and built new field infrastructure (including analytic tools and pooled investment vehicles). Simultaneously, the foundation deepened its field understanding and analytic framework by centering racial justice within a gender-equity lens and redesigning governance: authority migrated from sole-founder control to staff-led, trust-based grantmaking and ultimately to a participatory, multi-stakeholder board that elevated voices with lived experience. Confronted with crises in 2020, Tara accelerated disbursements and shortened its timeline, and it translated institutional learning into a deliberate exit strategy, seeding four independent anchor organizations and transferring relationships and expertise to sustain impact post-sunset. The case shows that sequencing full mission alignment, multicapital deployment, and equity-centered governance can mobilize additional impact capital, strengthen field infrastructure, and enable community-driven innovation. It also illuminates some key practical tensions, such as balancing rapid response with strategic planning and managing deep internal cultural change, that future impact investors and spend-down philanthropists must navigate.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Tara健康基金会的案例研究，展示了如何通过系统性投资模式解决美国生殖和孕产妇健康领域的种族与性别不平等问题。该基金会从创始人主导的慈善机构逐步转型为研究驱动、多资本策略的机构，最终通过参与式治理和退出策略实现持续影响。
AI.research_question: Tara健康基金会如何通过系统性投资模式解决美国生殖和孕产妇健康领域的种族和性别不平等问题？
AI.motivation: 美国生殖和孕产妇健康领域存在根深蒂固的种族和性别不平等问题，需要创新的慈善投资模式来系统性地解决这些结构性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性投资理论、多资本部署策略、参与式治理理论、种族正义与性别平等框架
AI.method: 案例研究法，深入分析Tara健康基金会从2014年成立到退出的整个发展历程和转型过程
AI.findings: Tara基金会通过分阶段实施全面使命对齐、多资本部署和以公平为中心的治理，成功动员了额外的影响资本，加强了领域基础设施，并实现了社区驱动的创新
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统性投资模式的实施路径框架，阐明了使命对齐、资本部署和治理结构转型的时序关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他影响投资者和限期慈善机构提供了可操作的实践指南，包括多资本策略设计、参与式治理实施和有序退出策略

title: Buyer Power and Power Buyers in Cellular SEP Licensing: Are there Implications for Competition and Competition Law?
affiliations: Berkeley Research Group, LLC and University of California, Berkeley - Business & Public Policy Group

detail.title: Buyer Power and Power Buyers in Cellular SEP Licensing: Are there Implications for Competition and Competition Law?
detail.abstract: European competition law has always had a role in shaping the development of ETSI standards. In the 2000s and for part of the 2010s, competition law concerns about the "hold-up" of SEP implementers by SEP holders became prominent and competition law intervention in the area was largely shaped by holdup concerns. Recent years have seen recognition of another problem-hold-out by patent implementers. Limitations on injunctive relief and the requirement that FRAND terms be available at all times limit the licensor's ability to achieve payment and the ease with which implementers can use SEPs for years before paying significantly limits the bargaining strength of the SEP holders. Hold-out or the credible threat of hold-out may lead not just to costly and inefficient litigation but also to depressed rates in "market-based" license agreements. However, even where these problems and issues are recognized, they are often treated as issues of bargaining that may affect the distribution of rents between SEP holder and implementer, rather than competition law issues. This paper illustrates how the problems of hold-out should properly be viewed as the problems of monopsony. This is particularly the case because SEP holders in fact interact with a concentrated licensee market, with smartphone makers such as Apple holding a very high share of potential licensable revenue. These firms can act as dominant buyers, with vertically unintegrated SEP licensors dependent on them for revenues, but also for "validation" of their licensing programmes. This leverage or dominance spills over into a market-wide impact, through a variety of mechanisms we discuss, and thus is not simply an issue of bargaining. The evidence on royalty rates actually paid suggests that the leverage or dominance of buyers is not countervailing in nature but depresses royalty rates below the level that balances the interests of implementers and technology developers as envisaged by ETSI's IPR policy and the FRAND commitment. The resulting extraction of SEP holders' innovation rents is akin to the effects of monopsony, and its results and effects on output (especially long-term output of innovation) are equally counterproductive. The monopsony power we describe also threatens to distort the pattern of future innovation because it asymmetrically impacts the incentives of unintegrated SEP owners. In an environment where innovation in air interface standards (e.g. the advance in capabilities from 2G to 5G) is a major driver of consumer welfare gains, a dynamic perspective on competition requires that competition authorities review the effects of hold-out as they would the effects of monopsony.

AI.tldr: 本文认为SEP实施者的"hold-out"行为应被视为买方垄断问题而非单纯的议价问题，分析了智能手机制造商作为主导买家如何压低专利费率，损害创新激励，建议竞争当局应从垄断视角审视这一问题

detail.abstract: Small business bankruptcy risk Predictive modeling Small business bankruptcy risk has become an important instrument of advanced financial decision-making, credit risk evaluation, and precocious intervention approaches. This paper discusses the various machine learning and statistical methods that have been used to forecast bankruptcy: logistic regressions, decision trees, support vectors machines, random forests and deep learning architectures. The background focuses on the relevance of data quality, feature engineering and explanation of models to ensure robust performance in their predictive purpose. Other fundamental issues highlighted in the paper include lack of sufficient data, imbalance of classes, heterogeneity in profiles of small businesses, and financial distress signals which are dynamic. Besides that, the aspect of explainable AI (XAI) is discussed as an intermediary between anti-predictive accuracy and regulatory transparency. Lastly, the policy implications of predictive modeling are discussed, including its ability to enable early-warning system, SME lending framework and targeted financial interventions. A combination of technical and regulatory lenses provides evidence that predictive analytics is strategically important in encouraging resilience of small businesses and ensuring financial ecosystem stability.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the problems of non-disclosure in the context of an asset sale between a buyer and a seller. The seller can have important information about the asset and can opportunistically decide not to disclose that information to the buyer, and the buyer may sue the seller ex post for remedy. The buyer and the court have a choice over different types of remedy. The paper considers three different remedy regimes: (1) no liability; (2) voidance; and (3) damages. Under voidance, the buyer can rescind the transaction (return the asset and get the price back), while with damages, the buyer receives monetary compensation from the seller. The analysis shows that, when comparing between voidance and damages, while voidance regime does poorly in deterring the opportunistic non-disclosure, by undoing inefficient transactions ex post, it can perform better than either damages or no liability. The paper analyzes circumstances under which one regime performs better than the others and also different types of damages.

detail.title: Academic Bubbles *
detail.abstract: We develop a model of how a principal motivates innovation by contracting researchers to generate ideas that improve economic productivity. Because individual contributions are unobservable, the principal relies on career incentives tied to peer recognition, measured through citations. However, citations reward not only societal value but also reflect the number of researchers working on a given topic. As a result, researchers may inefficiently over-coordinate their efforts. This can give rise to “academic bubbles" in which researchers continue working in areas with little prospect of advancing knowledge. We empirically analyze the selection of topics in research on the genetic determinants of human disease. We document that crowding on a narrow set of topics inflates citation impact, with patterns that point to career concerns as a driver of misallocated scientific effort.

title: Anomalies, Trends and Patterns in Disclosure Activities: Understanding EDGAR
affiliations: sec-api.io

detail.title: Anomalies, Trends and Patterns in Disclosure Activities: Understanding EDGAR
detail.abstract: We present the largest exploratory analysis to date of the SEC's EDGAR database, covering all 15 million regulatory disclosures filed by more than 800,000 entities-including public and private companies, funds, insiders, and other registrants-between 1994 and 2024. By examining filing volume and filer activity across entity types, form types, sectors, and time, we uncover structural trends and recurring patterns. Periods preceding major market events, such as the dot-com bubble, the 2007-08 global financial crisis, and the 2022 downturn, are characterized by shifts in disclosure behavior, including elevated activity in the asset-backed securities sector, the rise of SPAC filers, and increased registration of complex financial products. We document a steady decline in publicly traded company filers, offset by growing private capital formation. Insider trading activity consistently spikes in February, one month before the March release of annual reports. Filing activity also follows a seasonal cycle, peaking in February and reaching its lowest point in September. Finally, disclosure volume is highly concentrated: just 2% of form types account for 80% of all annual submissions. Our findings provide a foundation for understanding anomalies, trends and patterns in U.S. disclosure practices and offer insights for further investigation by researchers, regulators, and market participants.

detail.abstract: We examine how parental income and family structure during childhood and adolescence affect adult income, emphasizing the timing of these effects. Using an ordered multinomial probability model with functional covariates, we find that these familial influences are strongest in middle childhood and adolescence. We also uncover a complementary relationship in the effects of income and family structure trajectories during key developmental periods. By flexibly controlling for personal and family characteristics using nonparametric methods, our approach effectively handles high-dimensional covariates. The results advance the understanding of intergenerational income mobility and highlight the long-term importance of familial conditions for adult economic success.

title: Hate Speech Against Women As A Barrier To Political Participation A Human Security Concern
affiliations: University of Colombo

detail.title: Hate Speech Against Women As A Barrier To Political Participation A Human Security Concern
detail.abstract: This research has investigated the pervasive issue of hate speech against women in the context of their political participation which is a human security concern by showcasing its complex nature. Employing a two-tiered approach to data collection was commenced with an online open-ended survey, followed by semi-structured interviews to collect primary data from key informants. Hate speech, defined as verbal expressions intending to demean, discriminate, and cause harm based on race, religion, or gender, manifested across diverse settings, notably on social media and during public speeches and according to the findings visible, especially in parliament. The impact of gendered hate speech on women in politics emerged and as per the researcher, it has undermined active participation, creating a hostile environment that perpetuates discriminatory attitudes and silences their voices. This not only has threatened inclusive and participatory governance but also eroded societal cohesion and effective gender inclusion. The delicate balance between freedom of expression and hate speech regulation emerged as a critical challenge and in the research, the researcher has showcased how this restriction is subjective and contextual. In addition, the researcher has showcased the human security implications of hate speech against women which was found to violate fundamental human rights, including the right to dignity, equality, security, as well as participation which are seldom viewed through the security lens. In conclusion, hate speech against women poses a significant barrier to their political participation, necessitating a multifaceted approach to address its gravity while navigating the balance between curbing hate speech and upholding the principles of freedom of expression. Therefore, the recommendations include preventive strategies encompassing education, awareness campaigns, legal interventions, and follow-up mechanisms. Education and community-centric approaches, political support, cultural and societal responsibility, and accountability and transparency are proposed as additional measures to combat hate speech effectively.

detail.abstract: The significance of exchange rate and its influence on economic stability, productiveness, and trade patterns. Our study is the first in Selected South Asian Association for Regional Corporation (SAARC) countries including Bangladesh, India, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. We used four methods of estimation of panel data like Generalized Method of Moment (GMM), Fixed Effect (FE), Pooled Ordinary Least Square (POLS), and Random Effect (RE). The Hausman test preferred the fixed effect instead of the random effect. This study aims to examine the effect of foreign exchange reserve on exhange rate over the period of 2000 to 2020. The concept of exchange rate is also essential to government operations. Our study also adds to previous literature by discussing and testing the impact of foreign exchange reserve on exchange rate. According to estimated results, real gross domestic product, foreign exchange reserve, and openness of trade all have a significant impact on exhange rate over the time span under consideration. Whereas money supply and terms of trade both have an insignificant impact on exchange rate. Our finding confirms that the effect of foreign exchange reserve on exchange rate has a substantial and pessimistic. The empirical findings of the paper are of great significance for macroeconomic markets. Findings are also conducive to the countries' exports and domestic resources over time, which will result in an increase in foreign exchange reserves. In the end, exchange rate is essential for understanding and implementing broader macro and financial economic policies.

detail.abstract: The application of theories and philosophies on leadership is very essential for the actualization of the aim and target of every administration in Nigeria. In lieu of this, this study investigated the socioeconomic development situation of Nigeria during Buhari's administration; and the perception of Nigerians on the application of the philosophy of existentialism. The theory of existentialism as propounded by Danish philosopher Søren Kierkegaard in the 1800s which suggests that we have a choice in who we desire to be, was adopted. The study employed survey method of research in studying a population of 5,953,500, which is the total population of residents of Anambra State. Purposive sampling technique was used to study a sample size of 400, which was generated through the Taro Yamane formula for sample size derivation. The findings are that socioeconomic development situation of Nigeria during Buhari's administration was too poor; and there is possible improvement on socioeconomic development with the application of the philosophy of existentialism in Nigeria. The study recommends that there is need for absolute application of the tenets of existentialism by the Nigerian leadership in order to bring about the desired socioeconomic development.

AI.tldr: 这份研究调查了布哈里政府时期的经济社会发展状况，并探讨存在主义哲学在导领力应用中的潜在作用。研究发现尽管当时发展状况较差，但通过应用存在主义原则可以改善经济社会发展。
AI.research_question: 布哈里政府时期的经济社会发展状况如何；并且届于存在主义哲学的导领力应用在日常政府中的潜在作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 领导力理论和哲学的应用对实现民日利亚每个政府的目标至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用了丹麦哲学家克尔凯那尔在1800年代提出的存在主义理论，该理论强调我们有选择成为谁的自由。
AI.method: 采用调查研究方法，研究对象为安纳布拉州居民总人口5,953,500人。通过目的性抽样技术选取了400人的样本规模，样本量通过Taro Yamane公式计算得出。
AI.findings: 布哈里政府时期的经济社会发展状况极差；但通过应用存在主义哲学原则，民日利亚的经济社会发展可能得到改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 将存在主义哲学理论应用于政府领导力研究，为领导力开发提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议民日利亚领导层完全应用存在主义的原则，以实现期望的经济社会发展目标。

title: Three-Engine AI Framework for Financial Services: Prediction, Personalization, and Prevention
affiliations: Ally Financial (Ally Financial Inc.)

detail.title: Three-Engine AI Framework for Financial Services: Prediction, Personalization, and Prevention

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper reflects independent research and does not represent the views of the institution.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethical approval was required for this study, as it does not involve human subjects, identifiable personal data, or sensitive information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is no longer confined to experimental research; it has become the
cornerstone of digital transformation across industries. In financial services, AI adoption has
accelerated in areas such as credit scoring, fraud detection, robo-advisory, and customer support.
Yet, many of these implementations remain siloed, delivering partial benefits with limited longterm
impact.
To address this fragmentation, we introduce a Three-Engine AI Framework that unifies
Prediction, Personalization, and Prevention into an integrated ecosystem. This model provides
foresight, enhances customer-centricity, and enforces proactive safeguards—transforming AI
from a tactical enabler into a strategic growth driver. By embedding interconnected feedback
loops, the framework establishes resilience, agility, and trust at scale.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种三引擎AI框架，通过统一预测、个性化和预防功能来解决金融服务中AI应用的层面化问题，将AI从战术推手转化为战略增长驱动力。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一个统一的AI框架来解决金融服务业中AI应用的层面化问题，并实现更大的长期价值？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI在金融服务领域得到广泛应用，但大部分实施仍然存在层面化问题，只能产生部分效益且缺乏长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三引擎AI框架（预测引擎、个性化引擎、预防引擎）统一整合的理论框架
AI.method: 通过嵌入相互连接的反馈循环来建立一个集成生态系统
AI.findings: 该框架能够提供预见能力、增强客户中心性、实施主动防护，并在大规模上建立弹性、灵活性和信任度
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的统一式AI应用框架，为金融服务业AI转型提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了一种将AI从战术工具升级为战略增长驱动力的实践框架

reference: C.D. Howe Institute 690
title: Friend or Foe? Preferred Pharmacy Networks and the Future of Drug Benefits in Canada
affiliations: University of Toronto, Toronto, Canada

detail.title: Friend or Foe? Preferred Pharmacy Networks and the Future of Drug Benefits in Canada
detail.abstract:
• Preferred Pharmacy Networks (PPNs) in Canada are primarily used for distributing high-cost specialty drugs through select pharmacies that agree to lower fees in exchange for higher volumes. While some have suggested that PPNs increase market concentration, there is limited evidence of widespread harm to small and independent pharmacies.
  • Pharmacy stakeholders have cautioned that the use of PPNs is the latest example of an evolution of Canada’s drug benefits system towards the US model. However, Canada’s system is structurally different, making a drift toward the dysfunctions of the US model unlikely. The main differences include less vertical integration and federal drug price regulation. The result is much higher levels of reimbursement to community pharmacies in Canada than in the United States.
  • Given the limited savings available and drug plan beneficiary preferences for pharmacy choice, it is unlikely that PPNs will expand beyond specialty drugs. Bans on PPNs are not supported by current evidence, though further monitoring of pharmacy market concentration is warranted.
  • While some have raised concerns that PPNs fragment patient care, there is limited evidence of widespread harm to patients. Nevertheless, pharmacy regulators may wish to assess information-sharing requirements between specialty pharmacies and out-of-network pharmacies. Insurers may wish to assess drug plan sponsors’ willingness to pay for PPNs that allow more pharmacies to participate.

AI.tldr: 加拿大优先药房网络主要用于高成本专科药物分销，虽然可能增加市场集中度但缺乏广泛损害证据。由于加拿大医疗体系结构差异，不太可能走向美国模式。PPNs不太可能扩展到专科药物之外，禁令缺乏证据支持但需要持续监控。
AI.research_question: 加拿大优先药房网络对药房市场和患者护理的影响是什么？是否会导致加拿大医疗体系向美国模式演变？
AI.motivation: 随着优先药房网络在加拿大的应用增加，需要评估其对小型独立药房的潜在影响、市场集中度风险以及患者护理质量的影响，同时探讨加拿大医疗体系是否面临美国化风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗市场结构理论、药品福利管理理论和市场竞争理论，分析垂直整合、价格规制和市场集中度对药房网络的影响。
AI.method: 文献综述和比较分析法，对比加拿大和美国医疗体系的结构差异，分析PPNs的实施现状和潜在影响。
AI.findings: 1) PPNs主要限于高成本专科药物，缺乏广泛损害小型药房的证据；2) 加拿大体系结构差异（较少垂直整合和联邦价格规制）使其不太可能走向美国模式；3) 加拿大社区药房报销水平远高于美国；4) PPNs不太可能扩展到专科药物之外。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了加拿大特定医疗体系背景下PPNs影响的理论分析框架，丰富了国际医疗体系比较研究，为理解不同医疗体系结构对市场行为的影响提供理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据支持：不建议禁止PPNs但需要监控市场集中度；建议药房监管机构评估信息共享要求；建议保险公司评估药房参与意愿的支付模式。

title: Component-Based Dynamic Factor Nowcast Model
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Bank New York

detail.title: Component-Based Dynamic Factor Nowcast Model
detail.abstract: In this paper, we propose a component-based dynamic factor model for nowcasting GDP growth. We combine ideas from ‘bottom-up’ approaches, which utilise the national income accounting identity through modelling and predicting sub-components of GDP, with a dynamic factor (DF) model, which is suitable for dimension reduction as well as parsimonious real-time monitoring of the economy. The advantages of the new model are twofold: (i) in contrast to existing dynamic factor models, it respects the GDP accounting identity; (ii) in contrast to existing ’bottom-up’ approaches, it models all GDP components jointly through the dynamic factor model, inheriting its main advantages. An additional advantage of the resulting CBDF approach is that it generates nowcast densities and impact decompositions for each component of GDP, as a by-product. We present a comprehensive forecasting exercise, where we evaluate the model’s performance in terms of point and density forecasts and we compare it to existing models (e.g. the model of Almuzara, Baker, O’Keeffe, and Sbordone (2023) currently used by the New York Fed as well as the model of Higgins (2014) currently used by the Atlanta Fed). We demonstrate that, on average, the point nowcast performance (in terms of RMSE) of the standard DF model can be improved by 15% and its density nowcast performance (in terms of log-predictive scores) can be improved by 20% over a large historical sample.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于组件的动态因子模型（CBDF）用于GDP增长的即时预测，该模型结合了'自下而上'方法和动态因子模型的优势，既尊重GDP核算恒等式，又能联合建模所有GDP组件，在预测精度和密度预测方面相比现有模型有显著提升。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种既尊重GDP核算恒等式又能有效进行维度缩减的GDP即时预测模型？
AI.motivation: 现有动态因子模型不尊重GDP核算恒等式，而现有的'自下而上'方法无法联合建模所有GDP组件，需要一种结合两者优势的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态因子模型理论和国民收入核算恒等式理论
AI.method: 提出基于组件的动态因子模型（CBDF），结合自下而上方法和动态因子模型，进行全面的预测实验评估
AI.findings: 新模型在点预测方面比标准动态因子模型提升15%（RMSE），在密度预测方面提升20%（对数预测得分），显著优于纽约联储和亚特兰大联储当前使用的模型
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合自下而上方法和动态因子模型的新理论框架，解决了现有模型在尊重核算恒等式和联合建模方面的局限性
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和经济预测机构提供了更准确的GDP即时预测工具，能够生成各GDP组件的预测密度和影响分解，具有重要的实际应用价值

title: A Novel Hybrid Approach to Hausman's Specification Test for Fixed vs. Random Effects in Panel Data Models
affiliations: Arab Monetary Fund

detail.title: A Novel Hybrid Approach to Hausman's Specification Test for Fixed vs. Random Effects in Panel Data Models
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Hausman-Predictive Evaluation Test (HPET), a novel hybrid methodology designed to enhance model selection between fixed effects (FE) and random effects (RE) in panel data econometrics. The classical Hausman test, though widely adopted, is limited by its reliance on strict variance assumptions, its binary decision framework, and its neglect of predictive performance. HPET integrates the inferential foundation of the Hausman test with outof-sample predictive validation, yielding a more robust, interpretable, and flexible decision criterion. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that HPET performs comparably to the classical Hausman test in clear-cut cases, while offering superior guidance in borderline or ambiguous scenarios. By combining inferential rigor with predictive relevance, HPET represents a significant step forward in practical panel data model selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Hausman预测评估测试（HPET），这是一种结合传统Hausman检验和样本外预测验证的混合方法，用于改进面板数据中固定效应和随机效应模型的选择。
AI.research_question: 如何改进面板数据中固定效应和随机效应模型的选择方法？
AI.motivation: 传统的Hausman检验存在严格方差假设依赖、二元决策框架限制以及忽略预测性能等局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hausman检验的推断基础和预测验证理论，构建混合方法论框架。
AI.method: 开发HPET方法，结合推断严谨性和预测相关性，通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行性能验证。
AI.findings: HPET在明确情况下与传统Hausman检验表现相当，在边界或模糊情况下提供更优的指导。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合推断和预测的混合方法论，扩展了面板数据模型选择的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究提供了更稳健、可解释和灵活的面板数据模型选择工具。

reference: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 7/2025
title: Heterogeneous responses to monetary policy: the role of floating rate loans
affiliations: Bank of Finland, Bank of Finland and Bank of Finland

detail.title: Heterogeneous responses to monetary policy: the role of floating rate loans

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 7/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines the floating rate channel—a mechanism through which monetary policy affects firms’ investment and credit demand based on their exposure to variable rate loans. Using a granular loan-level dataset from the euro area, we find that firms with variable rate loans significantly reduce their investment-related borrowing after monetary tightening, compared to firms with fixed rate loans. This effect is most pronounced among the smallest firms, consistent with the theoretical view that the floating rate channel is explained by financial constraints. Our results highlight the heterogeneity in firms’ reactions to interest rate changes and underscore the importance of accounting for firm size and financial constraints in monetary policy analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，拥有浮动利率贷款的企业在货币政策收紧后会显著减少投资相关借款，这种效应在最小型企业中最为明显，表明浮动利率传导机制与财务约束相关。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何通过浮动利率渠道影响企业的投资和信贷需求？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策传导机制中企业层面的异质性反应，特别是基于可变利率贷款暴露程度的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 浮动利率传导机制理论，财务约束理论，企业异质性理论
AI.method: 使用欧元区细粒度贷款级别数据集进行实证分析，比较可变利率和固定利率贷款企业的投资借款行为
AI.findings: 拥有可变利率贷款的企业在货币政策收紧后显著减少投资相关借款，最小型企业效应最明显
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了浮动利率传导机制的存在，证明了财务约束在货币政策传导中的重要作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策制定者提供了企业层面异质性反应的重要证据，强调在政策分析中需要考虑企业规模和财务约束因素

title: Variation in the Gender Pay Gap across a Diverse Sample of Postsecondary Graduates
affiliations: U.S. Census Bureau, Cornell University, U.S. Census Bureau and Government of the United States of America - Bureau of the Census

detail.title: Variation in the Gender Pay Gap across a Diverse Sample of Postsecondary Graduates
detail.abstract: This paper studies early-career gender gaps in a sample of 585,000 postsecondary graduates, which we index into 10 distinct classes based on institutional information. We estimate a uniquely large gender pay gap among community-college certificate holders. While gender differences in field-of-degree explain more of the pay gap among graduates from elite colleges, gender differences in work hours and in unobserved variables are more important for less-competitive bachelor, associate, and certificate graduates. These patterns are partially but not fully explained by class differences in fertility timing. Our results indicate a plurality of explanations for gender inequality in the Millennial generation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对58.5万名高等教育毕业生的研究，发现社区大学证书持有者中存在显著的性别薪酬差距。精英院校毕业生中专业选择差异是薪酬差距主因，而普通院校毕业生中工作时间和未观察变量更重要。生育时机差异只能部分解释这一现象。
AI.research_question: 千禧一代高等教育毕业生早期职业生涯中的性别薪酬差距及其解释因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究千禧一代高等教育毕业生的性别不平等问题，探索不同院校类型毕业生性别薪酬差距的差异化解释机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、性别薪酬差距理论、院校分层理论、职业选择理论
AI.method: 基于58.5万名高等教育毕业生的样本数据，将院校分为10个不同类别进行统计分析
AI.findings: 社区大学证书持有者性别薪酬差距最大；精英院校毕业生薪酬差距主要由专业选择差异解释；普通院校毕业生差距更多由工作时间和未观察变量解释；生育时机差异只能部分解释这些模式
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了解释性别薪酬差距的多元化框架，强调不同院校类型毕业生差距机制的差异性
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育政策和性别平等政策提供实证依据，帮助针对不同院校类型制定差异化的干预措施

title: Evaluating the Influence of CEFTA Membership on Financial Integration: An Empirical Panel Data Analysis
affiliations: Mother Teresa University, North Macedonia, International University of Sarajevo (IUS) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Evaluating the Influence of CEFTA Membership on Financial Integration: An Empirical Panel Data Analysis
detail.abstract: This investigation elucidates the correlation between membership in a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) and the degree of financial integration among Central European Free Trade Agreement (CEFTA) countries. A particular emphasis is placed on discerning whether CEFTA affiliation enhances financial integration. A comprehensive panel data analysis spanning two decades (2000-2020) is implemented, incorporating crosssectional and time-series data. The influence of various determinants on financial integration is quantified through an Estimated Generalized Least Squares (EGLS) panel regression model, integrating panel-corrected standard errors. The findings consistently reveal that CEFTA membership bolsters financial integration. Moreover, the study substantiates that control variables such as inflation rate, market size, and corporate tax rate, incorporated in the regression model, significantly contribute to the variance of financial integration at a minimum 5% significance level. Conversely, trade openness demonstrated a positive, albeit statistically insignificant, effect. Empirical evidence suggests that CEFTA affiliation positively impacts financial integration, underscoring the necessity for more profound regional economic amalgamation. The significance of these findings can be observed in two dimensions: the contribution to existing literature on CEFTA region trade integration, and the broader discourse on financial integration. Insight gleaned from these findings recommends that CEFTA members should intensify mutual trade integration and diminish trade barriers to foster comparative advantages.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过面板数据分析发现CEFTA成员资格显著促进金融一体化，通胀率、市场规模和公司税率等控制变量也对金融一体化有显著影响。
AI.research_question: CEFTA成员资格是否增强了成员国之间的金融一体化程度？
AI.motivation: 探讨自由贸易协定成员资格对金融一体化的影响，特别是在中欧自由贸易协定地区的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自由贸易协定与金融一体化关系的理论框架，重点关注区域经济一体化对资本流动和金融市场整合的影响。
AI.method: 采用2000-2020年面板数据，运用EGLS面板回归模型（包含面板校正标准误）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: CEFTA成员资格显著促进金融一体化；通胀率、市场规模和公司税率在5%显著性水平上对金融一体化有显著影响；贸易开放度有正向但不显著的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了CEFTA地区贸易一体化文献，为金融一体化理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议CEFTA成员国加强相互贸易整合，减少贸易壁垒，以促进比较优势的发展。

title: Managing the University: Why "organized anarchy" is unacceptable in the age of MOOCs
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Business & Public Policy Group

detail.title: Managing the University: Why "organized anarchy" is unacceptable in the age of MOOCs
detail.abstract: The growing complexity of the university and of its competitive, technological, and operating environment means that the status quo in management is no longer adequate. New mental models are required. An approach that has been developed through a lengthy study of strategic management in the private sector is the dynamic capabilities framework. This essay presents the dynamic capabilities framework with indications for how it applies in the university context. By thinking in terms of sensing shifts, seizing opportunities, and transforming the university, a university’s leaders can improve their own effectiveness and their school’s readiness to respond to challenges and achieve its goals.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了动态能力框架在高校管理中的应用，提出高校领导者需要通过感知变化、抓住机会和转型变革来提升管理效能和应对挑战的能力。
AI.research_question: 动态能力框架如何应用于大学管理环境中？
AI.motivation: 大学及其竞争、技术和运营环境的日益复杂性使得传统管理方式不再适用，需要新的思维模式来应对挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力框架（Dynamic Capabilities Framework），包括感知变化（sensing）、抓住机会（seizing）和转型变革（transforming）三个核心维度。
AI.method: 基于对私营部门战略管理的长期研究，将动态能力框架理论应用于大学管理情境的分析性研究。
AI.findings: 动态能力框架可以有效应用于大学管理，通过感知环境变化、抓住发展机会和组织转型，提升领导效能和学校应对挑战的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将私营部门发展的动态能力框架理论扩展到高等教育机构管理领域，丰富了该理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学领导者提供了具体的管理框架和行动指南，帮助其提升管理效果和学校应对环境变化的能力。

title: Free Public Transport and Macroeconomic Variables

detail.title: Free Public Transport and Macroeconomic Variables
detail.abstract: Analysis of macroeconomic factors that enable the implementation of free public transport (FPT) in various cities and countries to address a logistic probability to model feasibility and compare success cases in different locations. The findings suggest that higher urban density, combined with high gross domestic product by population, are strongly correlated with the adoption of this measure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析宏观经济因素，探讨了免费公共交通（FPT）在不同城市和国家的实施可行性，发现高城市密度和高人均GDP与FPT采用率呈强相关关系。

AI.method: 采用逻辑概率模型分析不同城市的宏观经济数据，比较多个成功案例的实施条件。

detail.abstract: I reflect on the book Ergodicity Economics by Ole Peters and Alexander Adamou. I summarize the main arguments of the book and discuss challenges in its reception by mainstream economics.

title: Supreme Court of India Delineates Principles to Determine Fixed Place Permanent Establishment: Warning Bells for Foreign Law Firms Intending to Set Shop in India?
affiliations: Supreme Court of India

detail.title: Supreme Court of India Delineates Principles to Determine Fixed Place Permanent Establishment: Warning Bells for Foreign Law Firms Intending to Set Shop in India?
detail.abstract:
Permanent establishment has been a core conceptual foundation of international tax policy and law for many decades. The contours of the concept and its implications have been discussed, debated and dissected across jurisdictions for long. The judicial review of the concept, however, continues to add life and breath in the contemporary appreciation of the concept of permanent establishment notwithstanding its long incumbency in the international tax regime. 

In a recent decision [Hyatt International] the Supreme Court of India has revisited the concept of ‘fixed place’. The decision comes at a critical juncture given that the attempts for progressive expansion of international tax law (under the two pillar umbrella) have reached a stalemate and thus there is pressure to invoke the existing rules to address the contemporary economic developments. 

This article sketches the past and present of fixed place permanent establishment concept and seeks to extrapolate its likely ramifications in context of an allied development wherein foreign lawyers and law firms have been permitted to operate in India and carry out their economic activities therein.

AI.tldr: 本文分析印度最高法院在Hyatt International案中对'固定场所'常设机构概念的重新诠释，探讨该概念在当代数字经济背景下的适用性及其对外国律师事务所在印度运营的影响。
AI.research_question: 印度最高法院对'固定场所'常设机构概念的重新诠释如何影响国际税收规则在当代经济环境中的应用，特别是对外国律师事务所在印度运营的税务影响？
AI.motivation: 国际税收法律的两支柱改革陷入僵局，需要利用现有规则应对当代经济发展，特别是数字经济和外国专业服务提供者在印度的运营问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于常设机构理论，特别是固定场所型常设机构的概念框架，结合国际税收协定和国内税法的交叉分析。
AI.method: 采用案例分析法，深入研究印度最高法院Hyatt International案的判决，结合历史演进和比较法视角进行法律解释学分析。
AI.findings: 最高法院对固定场所概念的重新解释扩展了常设机构的认定标准，为在数字经济环境下适用传统税收规则提供了新的法理基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了常设机构理论在数字时代的适用性研究，为传统国际税收概念在新型商业模式中的适用提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务机关和跨国企业提供了明确的税务合规指引，特别是对外国律师事务所在印度运营的税务处理具有重要实践意义。

title: Trade Facilitation and Aid for Trade: The European Union's Approach to Supporting Developing Economies through Geneva-based International Institutions
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Trade Facilitation and Aid for Trade: The European Union's Approach to Supporting Developing Economies through Geneva-based International Institutions
detail.abstract: This research paper examines the European Union's comprehensive approach to Aid for Trade (AfT) and its impact on developing economies through Geneva-based international institutions. The study analyzes how the EU leverages multilateral frameworks, particularly the World Trade Organization (WTO), United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), and International Trade Centre (ITC), to implement trade facilitation measures that enhance export capacity and sophistication in developing countries. Using empirical analysis covering the period 2006-2022, this research demonstrates that EU Aid for Trade initiatives have generated significant positive effects on recipient countries' export performance, with particular improvements in export sophistication and diversification. The paper provides evidence that trade facilitation measures, when combined with capacity-building programs coordinated through Geneva-based institutions, create multiplicative effects that exceed the sum of individual interventions. Policy recommendations include enhanced coordination mechanisms between Geneva-based institutions, increased focus on digital trade facilitation, and the development of more sophisticated monitoring and evaluation frameworks to capture the full spectrum of Aid for Trade impacts on sustainable development outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧盟通过日内瓦国际机构实施的贸易援助对发展中国家经济的积极影响，发现贸易便利化措施与能力建设项目相结合能产生乘数效应，显著提升受援国的出口绩效、复杂度和多样化。
AI.research_question: 欧盟通过日内瓦国际机构实施的贸易援助如何影响发展中国家的经济发展？
AI.motivation: 评估欧盟贸易援助政策在促进发展中国家贸易能力建设方面的有效性，为多边贸易援助机制提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多边主义理论、贸易援助理论、贸易便利化理论、出口复杂度理论
AI.method: 实证分析（2006-2022年数据），分析欧盟通过WTO、UNCTAD、ITC等日内瓦机构实施的贸易援助项目
AI.findings: 欧盟贸易援助对受援国出口绩效产生显著积极影响，特别是在出口复杂度和多样化方面；贸易便利化措施与能力建设项目结合产生乘数效应
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了多边贸易援助理论，证明了机构间协调的乘数效应，为贸易援助有效性提供了新证据

title: Myanmar: Prima Facie Evidence of Trade-Based Money Laundering
affiliations: Global Financial Integrity

detail.title: Myanmar: Prima Facie Evidence of Trade-Based Money Laundering

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded.

detail.abstract: The paper provides prima facie evidence of trade-based money laundering (TBML) by Myanmar's private sector. It shows that while governance and fragility indicators help identify the conditions that enable TBML, mirror trade data can strongly indicate related transactions. The impact of abrupt changes in government regimes on governance and fragility indicators are assessed to underscore how such conditions facilitate TBML. The paper uses mirror trade data to show large-scale financing gaps as well as export smuggling. While direct military rule led to a further deterioration in governance, greater civilian participation in the running of government improved conditions, underscoring the importance of such oversight in the successful control of TBML. Mirror trade data show large under-reporting of Myanmar's imports. Given past sources of external credit and Myanmar's limited capacity to attract additional financing, recorded flows are unlikely to have closed the large financing gaps. Instead, prima facie evidence points to the financing of unrecorded imports using illicit funds generated through the smuggling of Myanmar's natural resources across porous borders. The article makes an important contribution to the literature on money laundering by showing that weak governance and increasing state fragility can create the ecosystem necessary to sustain TBML. Furthermore, mirror trade data reveal large import financing gaps and suggest widespread export smuggling which together provide a prima facie evidence of TBML.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过镜像贸易数据提供了羅甸私营部门贸易基金洗钱的初步证据，证明弱劳的治理和国家脆弱性为TBML创造了生态系统，政治制度变化影响治理质量，而镜像贸易数据能够显示大规模进口资金空欠和出口走私现象。
AI.research_question: 羅甸私营部门如何通过贸易基金洗钱(TBML)？治理和国家脆弱性指标如何影响TBML的发生？镜像贸易数据能否有效识别TBML交易？
AI.motivation: 贸易基金洗钱是一种复杂且难以识别的金融犯罪形式，特别是在治理弱劳和国家脆弱的环境中。需要研究如何通过数据分析来证明和识别这种洗钱行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易基金洗钱(TBML)理论、治理理论、国家脆弱性理论、镜像贸易数据分析方法
AI.method: 使用镜像贸易数据进行实证分析，评估政治制度变化对治理指标的影响，分析进出口数据差额来证明贸易基金洗钱
AI.findings: 1.直接军事统治导致治理状况恶化，民主参与政府运作改善条件 2.镜像贸易数据显示羅甸进口存在大规模低报现象 3.记录的资金流动无法填补大规模资金空欠 4.有初步证据表明通过自然资源走私获得的非法资金用于赎付未记录的进口
AI.theory_contributions: 1.证明弱劳治理和增长的国家脆弱性可以创造维持TBML所需的生态系统 2.扩展了金融洗钱文献，提供了贸易基金洗钱的实证研究案例
AI.practical_contributions: 1.为监管机构提供了识别TBML的方法论工具 2.突出了民主监督在控制TBML中的重要作用 3.为国际组织和政府部门提供了政策建议

title: Equities and Economic Empowerment: The Role of Stock Markets in Reducing Poverty
affiliations: Centro Universitário das Américas

detail.title: Equities and Economic Empowerment: The Role of Stock Markets in Reducing Poverty
detail.abstract: This article examines the role of stock markets in reducing poverty, focusing on the United States, United Kingdom, and Japan. By enabling capital formation, business expansion, and household participation in corporate growth, equity markets contribute to wealth creation and economic inclusion. Data indicate that approximately 55% of U.S. households, 30-35% of U.K. adults, and 25% of Japanese households hold stocks or equity-related investments, resulting in higher median net worth and improved financial stability. In contrast, countries with underdeveloped or nonexistent stock markets, such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo and South Sudan, exhibit extreme poverty rates of 74.6% and 67.3%, respectively. While risks such as market volatility and unequal access persist, evidence suggests that active and accessible stock markets are a critical mechanism for economic empowerment and poverty reduction, even without direct policy interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析美英日三国股市发展情况，发现股票市场通过促进资本形成、企业扩张和家庭参与企业成长，有助于财富创造和经济包容，约55%美国家庭、30-35%英国成年人和25%日本家庭持有股票投资，提升了净资产中位数和财务稳定性。相比之下，股市不发达的国家如刚果民主共和国和南苏丹贫困率高达74.6%和67.3%。尽管存在市场波动和准入不平等风险，证据表明活跃可及的股市是经济赋权和减贫的重要机制。
AI.research_question: 股票市场在减少贫困方面扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 探讨股票市场作为经济赋权和减贫机制的重要性，特别是在发达国家与股市不发达国家之间的对比
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本形成理论、财富创造理论和经济包容性理论，分析股市对贫困减少的作用机制
AI.method: 比较分析方法，选取美国、英国、日本三个股市发达国家与刚果民主共和国、南苏丹等股市不发达国家进行对比分析
AI.findings: 1) 美国家庭55%、英国成年人30-35%、日本家庭25%持有股票投资；2) 持股家庭具有更高的净资产中位数和财务稳定性；3) 股市不发达国家贫困率极高（刚果74.6%，南苏丹67.3%）；4) 股市通过资本形成、企业扩张和家庭参与促进财富创造
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证了股票市场作为减贫机制的理论有效性；2) 丰富了经济包容性理论在资本市场领域的应用；3) 提供了股市发展与贫困减少之间的实证联系
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为发展中国家发展股票市场提供政策参考；2) 强调了股市可及性对家庭财富积累的重要性；3) 指出了在推动股市发展的同时需要关注市场风险和准入平等问题

title: The Belt and Road Initiative and My Hometown: Bangladesh's Experience
affiliations: Zhengzhou University

detail.title: The Belt and Road Initiative and My Hometown: Bangladesh's Experience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: My writing is based on my personal interest and my research interest.

detail.abstract: China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), launched in 2013, has emerged as the largest global infrastructure development program of the twenty-first century. It aims to enhance connectivity across Asia, Africa, and Europe through investments in transport, energy, and digital networks. This paper examines the role of Bangladesh within the BRI framework, with particular attention to its economic opportunities and risks. Drawing on specific projects such as the Padma Bridge Rail Link, the Karnaphuli Tunnel, and the Payra Port, the study highlights how BRI investments are reshaping Bangladesh's infrastructure and trade potential. At the same time, concerns regarding debt sustainability, transparency, and geopolitical balancing remain significant. The analysis concludes that Bangladesh can maximize the benefits of the BRI if it ensures effective governance, diversified partnerships, and financial prudence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究孟加拉国在"一带一路"倡议中的经济机遇与风险，通过具体项目分析基础设施改善和贸易潜力，同时关注债务可持续性和地缘政治平衡问题。

AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析帕德玛大桥铁路连接线、卡纳普里隧道和帕拉港等具体项目
