title: The Effective Cost of Capital Buffers for UBS: A Reappraisal Based on Empirical Research
affiliations: Tilburg University and University of Basel - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: The Effective Cost of Capital Buffers for UBS: A Reappraisal Based on Empirical Research
detail.abstract: This paper critically examines UBS's public pushback against higher capital requirements proposed in the aftermath of the 2023 Credit Suisse rescue. We challenge UBS's claim that additional equity capital would substantially increase its cost of capital and impair firm value. Drawing on foundational corporate finance principles and recent empirical evidence, we demonstrate that higher equity buffers may reduce default risk and lower the bank's cost of equity (CoE) and cost of debt (CoD). Increasing UBS's capital buffers likely leads to lower funding costs and, in realistic scenarios, may affect its weighted average cost of capital (WACC) only marginally and by less than one basis point. Considering both effects, we estimate an almost complete MM offset. Using UBS-specific data and a two-stage Gordon Growth model (GGM), we show that the valuation impact of increased capital buffers is economically negligible or even positive. Our findings support capital strengthening as a value-neutral or value-enhancing regulatory measure, providing evidence for calibrating capital buffer policies at systemically important banks. Stronger capital buffers are unlikely to impair firm value and may enhance UBS's long-term financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了UBS反对提高资本要求的立场，证明增加资本缓冲可能降低融资成本，对加权平均资本成本影响微乎其微，估值影响经济上可忽略甚至为正，支持资本强化作为价值中性或增值的监管措施。
AI.research_question: UBS声称提高资本要求会显著增加资本成本并损害企业价值，这一说法是否成立？增加资本缓冲对UBS的资本成本和估值实际影响如何？
AI.motivation: 在2023年瑞信救助后，UBS公开反对提高资本要求，声称这会增加资本成本并损害企业价值。需要基于公司金融理论和实证证据来检验这一主张的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于莫迪利亚尼-米勒定理（MM定理）等公司金融基本原理，以及资本结构理论，分析资本要求变化对资本成本和估值的影响。
AI.method: 使用UBS特定数据和两阶段戈登增长模型（GGM），结合实证证据进行分析，估计MM抵消效应和估值影响。
AI.findings: 提高资本缓冲可能降低违约风险，从而降低股权成本和债务成本；加权平均资本成本影响微乎其微（小于1个基点）；估值影响经济上可忽略甚至为正；存在几乎完全的MM抵消效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资本要求与企业价值关系提供了理论验证，支持MM定理在银行资本监管背景下的适用性，挑战了银行反对资本要求的传统论点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为系统重要性银行的资本缓冲政策校准提供证据支持，表明强化资本要求不会损害银行价值，反而可能增强长期金融稳定性，为监管决策提供实证依据。

title: A New Puzzle Piece for the "Sell in May, and Go Away" Anomaly: Regulatory Disclosures
affiliations: sec-api.io

detail.title: A New Puzzle Piece for the "Sell in May, and Go Away" Anomaly: Regulatory Disclosures

keywords: Sell in May and Go Away

detail.abstract: We propose a new puzzle piece for the Halloween effect ("Sell in May and Go Away") by identifying a seasonal pattern in SEC regulatory disclosures that aligns with the effect's summer and winter periods. From 2004 to 2023, SEC filing volumes are 17% higher in winter (November-April) than in summer (May-October). Winter also sees a 22% rise in insider trading, 13% more private securities offerings, 12% more activist investor activity, a 96% increase in shareholder meetings, and 473% more annual reports. February consistently marks the peak in disclosures, and September the low. Similar patterns across European markets suggest global consistency. As regulatory filings contain material pricerelevant information, this seasonal disclosure pattern offers a new contributing factor to the Halloween effect puzzle.

AI.tldr: 研究发现SEC监管披露存在季节性模式，冬季（11月-4月）文件量比夏季（5月-10月）高17%，与万圣节效应的时间段一致，这为解释该效应提供了新的因素。
AI.research_question: SEC监管披露是否存在季节性模式，这种模式是否与万圣节效应的时间段相一致？
AI.motivation: 为解释万圣节效应（"五月卖出离场"现象）寻找新的解释因素，通过分析监管披露的季节性特征来补充现有理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场效率理论和行为金融学，探讨信息披露季节性与市场异常现象之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用2004-2023年SEC监管文件数据，比较冬季（11月-4月）和夏季（5月-10月）的各类披露活动量，并进行统计分析。

title: Motivated Risk Assessments
affiliations: Lund University and Central European University (CEU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Motivated Risk Assessments
detail.abstract: Do people form risk assessments to justify their actions? We investigate this question in a ﬁeld experiment studying the dynamics of risk assessments for visiting a café during the Covid-19 pandemic. By randomly varying the incentive for a visit, we ﬁnd that participants with a high incentive visit cafés more often and downplay the risk compared to those participants with a low incentive. Importantly, the downplaying happens in anticipation of the visit and without new information, suggesting that the assessment update justifies engagement in risky behavior. This ﬁnding is inconsistent with Bayesian updating but consistent with the notion of motivated reasoning.

detail.title: Politics in the Name of Women's Reservation
detail.abstract: The discussion highlights concerns regarding gender-based reservations in India, particularly the potential for these policies to disproportionately benefit wealthier and upper-class women, sidelining women from lower socioeconomic strata and disadvantaged castes. It proposes solutions such as 'reservation within reservation' for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes to ensure equitable distribution of benefits and advocates for a shift towards economic-based reservations, considering financial need rather than gender alone. The importance of education, awareness campaigns and transparent criteria for reservation is emphasized, promoting equal access to opportunities. An intersectional approach that addresses both gender and caste factors is deemed essential to bridge existing disparities. The discussion concludes by emphasizing the need for regular reviews and data-driven policy adjustments to create an inclusive reservation system that empowers individuals from all backgrounds, aligning with the broader goal of fostering a just and balanced society.

title: Uncertainty and Rounding in Expectation Surveys
affiliations: Friedrich Alexander University Erlangen Nuremberg and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Uncertainty and Rounding in Expectation Surveys

publicationDetails.journalName: Deutsche Bundesbank Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the rounding of survey responses in the case of probabilistic question formats is related to expectation uncertainty. Using data from a survey on macroeconomic expectations of private households in Germany, we analyze self-reported reasons for rounding probabilistic inflation expectations. Although rounding is correlated with expectation uncertainty, only 14 percent of respondents explicitly attribute rounding to uncertainty. Most households round to simplify responses or because rounded values reflect their true expectations. Regression analyses do not find significant differences in uncertainty between these groups. The findings suggest caution in interpreting rounding in such settings as a measure of uncertainty and highlight the need for further research on the cognitive mechanisms behind rounding in expectation surveys.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，虽然调查中概率性问题的回答四舍五入与预期不确定性相关，但只有14%的受访者明确将四舍五入归因于不确定性。大多数家庭四舍五入是为了简化回答或因为四舍五入值反映了其真实预期。回归分析未发现这些群体间存在显著的不确定性差异。

AI.motivation: 了解家庭在宏观经济预期调查中对概率性问题进行四舍五入的原因，以及这种四舍五入行为是否确实反映了预期不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和调查方法论，探讨受访者在回答概率性问题时的认知过程和决策机制。
AI.method: 使用德国私人家庭宏观经济预期调查数据，分析自报告的四舍五入原因，并进行回归分析比较不同四舍五入群体的不确定性差异。

title: Pricing Fixed Income with Liquidity: An Extended Merton Approach
affiliations: AbleMarkets.com and Cornell University

detail.title: Pricing Fixed Income with Liquidity: An Extended Merton Approach
detail.abstract: We propose a simple model by which informed trading is incorporated into both the traded volume and the prices of the traded asset. We apply the resulting dynamic to the Merton (1974) bond pricing model. We show that the accuracy of the model improves substantially when the liquid portion of the market capitalization and the liquid portion of the debt are used as input variables in the Merton model. Using the proposed extension to the Merton model, which we dub the "liquid Merton" model, we show that we can predict out-of-sample returns one month ahead on the shortest maturity bonds with 99.9% precision, while the classic Merton model fails to deliver statistical significance. However, in the longest maturities, the classic Merton model predicts out-of-sample returns one month ahead with 99.9% statistical confidence, while the proposed "liquid Merton" does not. Furthermore, our model provides a new explanation for the liquidity premium puzzle. We show that faced with adverse market frictions, investors move to trade easier assets, which in turn reduces supply for the hard-to-trade issues, lowering their demand and, as a result, present prices.

affiliations: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE, Independent, Swiss Finance Institute, University Zurich and University of Zurich - Department Finance

detail.title: Bond Versus Banks Financing In The Climate Transition: The Role Of Stranded-Asset Risk

publicationDetails.journalName: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: What role does bond versus bank debt play in the climate transition? We document that fossil fuel firms with greater stranded-asset risk rely less on bond finance and more on bank credit. While bond investors price stranding risk, banks in the syndicated loan market do not. This differential pricing leads to within-firm substitution from bonds to loans, consistent with a relative contraction in bond market credit supply. We also find that large banks are more likely to lend to risk-exposed firms, raising questions about how climate risk is distributed and whether credit flows align with transition objectives.

title: Methods and Indicators for Urban Sustainability Assessment
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation and ITMO University

detail.title: Methods and Indicators for Urban Sustainability Assessment
detail.abstract: This introductory chapter is presenting a range of sustainable development analysis methodologies, including material flows analysis, input–output analysis, optimization and multi-criteria decision aid. It goes further to review the key smart and sustainable urban indicator systems and presents the indicator methodology to be used throughout this book. The chapter then reviews the Environment EuropeTM Sustainable Cities database. It then focuses on sustainability assessment for some of the most prominent global megacities: London, New York, Hong Kong, Los Angeles, São Paolo, Rio de Janeiro, Paris, Berlin, Moscow, Beijing, Singapore, Shanghai, Sydney and Tokyo. The alternative city rankings are compared and linkages between different sustainability and smart city dimensions are explored. The chapter applies the ELECTRE III multi-criteria decision aid tool to a panel of twenty indicators. The proposed approach allows us to consider performance under four different policy priorities: environmental, economic, social and smart, changing the focus of the sustainability assessment. The results have shown that Singapore dominates the sustainability rankings under environmental policy priorities. Tokyo leads under economic and social priorities, and London and Tokyo under smart city priorities. The worst performing cities are Shanghai, Los Angeles and Rio de Janeiro. The chapter examines the innovative sustainability strategy and new governance structures that led Singapore to become the most sustainable city under environmental priorities and offers recommendations for the lower-ranking cities of Shanghai, Los Angeles and Rio de Janeiro. The assessment could be a valuable tool for policy makers and investors, and could help identify linkages between different sustainability dimensions, highlighting best practices as well as strategic opportunities in cities with sustainability potential.

title: Economic Capital: A New Measure of Bank Solvency
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Economic Capital: A New Measure of Bank Solvency

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Bank supervisors, industry analysts, and academic researchers rely on a range of metrics to track the health of both individual banks and the banking system as a whole. Many of these metrics focus on bank solvency—the likelihood that a bank will be able to repay its obligations and thus retain its funding and continue to supply services to consumers, businesses, and other financial institutions. We draw on our recent research to describe a new solvency metric that is more forward-looking, more timely, and more comprehensive in its assessment of solvency than many current measures. 

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2025/09/economic-capital-a-new-measure-of-bank-solvency/

reference: SAFE Working Paper No. 455
title: Disasters and Lending Signals: From Borrower Information to Community Characteristics
affiliations: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE

detail.title: Disasters and Lending Signals: From Borrower Information to Community Characteristics

declarations.funderStatement: I gratefully acknowledge research support from the Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE and financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation and the UZH Candoc program.

publicationDetails.journalName: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: I study the informational value of community resilience in credit markets during natural disasters. Exploiting a severe flood in Germany in 2013, I combine loan-level data on car loans with a composite measure of community resilience based on structural local characteristics linked to disaster recovery capacity. After the flood, only low-income borrowers faced credit tightening, but in high-resilience areas they experienced smaller rate hikes and maintained access to credit. Resilience also predicts repayment after disasters, yet banks ignore it in normal times. This state-contingent reliance shows that community resilience enters credit pricing only in crises, when its information content beyond standard borrower characteristics is valuable enough to justify adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究社区弹性在自然灾害期间信贷市场的信息价值。通过对德国2013年洪浆的分析，发现高弹性社区中的低收入借款人在灾后承受更小的利率上涨并保持信贷访问。弹性还预测灾后还款能力，但银行在正常时期忽视这一信息。
AI.research_question: 社区弹性在自然灾害期间对信贷市场的信息价值是什么？它如何影响银行的信贷决策和定价？
AI.motivation: 理解社区弹性在灾害期间信贷市场中的作用，探索银行如何利用本地特征信息来应对极端事件带来的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学理论、风险管理理论、社区弹性理论，以及灾害对信贷市场影响的理论基础。
AI.method: 实验室方法，利用2013年德国洪浆作为外生冲击，结合车贷数据和基于结构性本地特征的社区弹性综合指标进行分析。
AI.findings: 灾后低收入借款人面临信贷收紧，但高弹性地区的借款人承受更小利率上涨并保持信贷访问。弹性预测灾后还款能力，但银行在正常时期忽视这一信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出状态依存性依赖概念，说明社区弹性只在危机时期才进入信贷定价，因为它的信息价值超越标准借款人特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行提供在灾害期间更有效管理风险的实践建议，并强调了社区弹性在维持信贷可达性方面的重要作用。

affiliations: Independent Researcher, South Korea

detail.title: Not Just an AI Singularity: Recursive Alignment and the Architecture of Human–AI Civilization
detail.abstract:
As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into society, traditional discussions focus on
a one-off “singularity” transition or on static alignment of AI to fixed human goals. Here we develop a
three‐stage model of alignment for a human–AI civilization. Stage One (AI Alignment) treats AI as fitting
fixed rules or values – a compliance model. Stage Two (Co-Alignment) recognizes a dynamic interplay: AI
systems and human collectives co-create norms, adjusting mutual behaviors much like parties
negotiating a social contract. Stage Three (Recursive Alignment) envisions a meta-level process: norms,
meanings, and goals evolve together through recursive feedback among humans and AI. Drawing on
Wittgenstein’s rule-following, Rousseau’s general will, Rawls’s veil of ignorance, evolutionary ethics,
systems theory, and postphenomenology, we show that stage-three alignment is a distinct philosophical
horizon. It frames AI not as a sudden transformative event (the traditional “singularity”) but as part of an
ongoing, participatory civilizational design. We illustrate how experimental architectures (e.g. meshbased
“meta-operating systems” like OntoMotoOS) could embody these ideas. The result is a vision of
alignment as a continuous, systemic process – a recursive realignment of values and meaning – that
underpins a stable, human–AI civilization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个三阶段AI对齐模型，从静态合规到动态协同再到递归进化，将AI对齐重新定义为持续的价值意义重构过程，而非一次性事件。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可持续的人类-AI文明对齐框架，超越传统的静态对齐和单一奇点概念？
AI.motivation: 传统AI对齐讨论局限于一次性奇点或静态目标对齐，无法应对AI与人类文明共同演化的动态复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 维特根斯坦规则遵循、卢梭公意理论、罗尔斯无知之幕、进化伦理学、系统理论、后现象学
AI.method: 理论建模与概念分析，提出三阶段对齐框架并探讨其哲学内涵
AI.findings: 第三阶段递归对齐代表新的哲学视野，将AI视为参与式文明设计的持续过程，而非突发变革事件
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了递归对齐的新哲学范式，整合多学科理论构建人类-AI文明协同演化的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计实验性架构（如OntoMotoOS等元操作系统）提供理论基础，支持持续价值重构的实践实现

title: Structured Expression Resonance (SER）Whitepaper｜Making Language the Native Tongue of Collaboration: An original language protocol for human–AI co-creation
affiliations: The University of Manchester

detail.title: Structured Expression Resonance (SER）Whitepaper｜Making Language the Native Tongue of Collaboration: An original language protocol for human–AI co-creation

keywords: Weak collaborative persistence: difficulty sustaining stable
multi-modal work. Structured Expression Resonance SER responds by centering structure × rhythm
shifting language from "semantic descriptionˮ to a collaboration interface. Unlike prompt engineering

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Structured Expression Resonance (SER), a protocol-layer framework that treats language not merely as semantic content but as structure × rhythm × path for collaborative work between humans and AI systems. We formalize SER’s core constructs—minimal structural units, rhythmic anchors, and navigable paths—and position them against two prevailing approaches: prompt engineering (input tactics) and deep learning (parameter scaling). Building on a linear-algebraic intuition (vectors, matrix mappings, rotational transforms), we motivate a shift from one-shot, sentence-level generation to structure-first, rhythm-aware collaboration.


We integrate SER with three companion components to form a coherent collaboration stack: CSL (Collaborative Structural Linguistics) as a grammatical scaffold for roles, routes, and beats; Rhythm OS as a runtime scheduler that enforces structural consistency, rhythmic alignment, and navigable branching across multi-turn, multi-role, and multimodal settings; and SPRL (Structured Path Resonance Loop) as a looping mechanism that adds checkpoints and convergence to produce verifiable reasoning chains over time. The contribution is conceptual and architectural: a callable, re-enactable, and auditable language interface that can orchestrate large models without retraining by constraining generation to declared structure and cadence.


We discuss implications for education (co-constructing reasoning steps), research workflows (role/path grammar with looped validation), and multimodal editing (timeline-aligned “beat” control), and we outline evaluation directions (structural alignment, rhythmic stability, path convergence). Limitations include the absence of a full production system; we instead provide design criteria for parsers, schedulers, and adapters that could layer atop existing LLMs. Overall, SER reframes language as an operational protocol for collaboration, complementing rather than replacing prompt tactics and model scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了结构化表达共振（SER）框架，将语言视为结构×节奏×路径的三维组合，用于人机协作。SER包含三个核心组件：CSL提供语法支架、Rhythm OS作为运行时调度器、SPRL作为循环验证机制，共同构成可调用、可重演、可审计的语言协作接口。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于结构化、节奏化和路径化语言表达的人机协作协议层框架？
AI.motivation: 当前人机交互主要依赖提示工程和深度学习参数扩展，缺乏对语言结构、节奏和协作路径的系统性处理，需要新的协作范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于线性代数直觉（向量、矩阵映射、旋转变换），将语言视为结构×节奏×路径的三维操作协议
AI.method: 概念架构设计方法，提出SER框架及其三个核心组件：CSL（协作结构语言学）、Rhythm OS（节奏操作系统）、SPRL（结构化路径共振循环）
AI.findings: SER框架能够在不重新训练大模型的情况下，通过声明结构和节奏来约束生成过程，实现可调用、可重演、可审计的语言协作
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将语言重新定义为协作操作协议的理论框架，补充而非替代现有的提示策略和模型扩展方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育（协同构建推理步骤）、研究工作流（角色/路径语法与循环验证）、多模态编辑（时间线对齐的节拍控制）等领域提供了新的协作范式

title: Addressing Endogeneity Issues in a Spatial Autoregressive Model using Copulas
affiliations: and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Addressing Endogeneity Issues in a Spatial Autoregressive Model using Copulas
detail.abstract: We provide a new semiparametric copula method to tackle the endogeneity issue in a spatial autoregressive (SAR) model, which might originate from an endogenous spatial weights matrix and/or endogenous regressors. In this study, a general model specification incorporating the two cases and multivariate modelings with Gaussian and Student's t copulas are presented. Using copula-based endogeneity correction techniques, we propose 3-stage estimation methods for SAR and establish their consistency and asymptotic normality. Monte Carlo experiments are performed to investigate the finite-sample performance of the instrumental variable (IV) estimator and the maximum likelihood (ML) estimator. We then apply our method to an empirical study of spatial spillovers in regional productivity with spatial weights determined by an endogenous socioeconomic factoryears of education that also serves as a linear regressor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的半参数copula方法来处理空间自回归(SAR)模型中的内生性问题，该方法能够同时处理内生空间权重矩阵和内生回归变量问题，并通过蒙特卡洛实验验证了估计器的有限样本性能。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决空间自回归模型中由内生空间权重矩阵和/或内生回归变量引起的内生性问题？
AI.motivation: 传统空间计量经济学模型在处理内生性问题时存在局限性，特别是当空间权重矩阵本身具有内生性时，现有方法难以有效处理这种复杂的内生性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于copula理论的空间计量经济学框架，结合半参数方法和空间自回归模型，构建了能够处理多重内生性问题的理论模型。
AI.method: 提出了三阶段估计方法（针对SAR模型），使用基于copula的内生性校正技术，包括高斯copula和学生t copula的多变量建模，并通过蒙特卡洛实验比较工具变量(IV)估计器和最大似然(ML)估计器的性能。
AI.findings: 提出的copula方法能够有效校正空间自回归模型中的内生性问题，蒙特卡洛实验表明该方法在有限样本条件下具有良好的性能，实证应用验证了方法在区域生产率空间溢出效应研究中的实用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了处理空间计量模型中复杂内生性问题的理论框架，扩展了copula方法在空间经济学中的应用，为同时处理内生权重矩阵和内生回归变量提供了新的理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实证研究者处理空间内生性问题的实用工具，特别是在区域经济学、城市经济学等领域中当空间权重矩阵具有内生性时的应用方法，以教育年限作为内生空间权重和回归变量的实证案例展示了方法的实际价值。

reference: Jurnal Ekonomi Indonesia
title: Do the Sticky Floor and Glass Ceiling Phenomena Persist in the Indonesian Labour Force after the Pandemic?
affiliations: BPS-Statistics Indonesia and BPS-Statistics Indonesia

detail.title: Do the Sticky Floor and Glass Ceiling Phenomena Persist in the Indonesian Labour Force after the Pandemic?
detail.abstract: Our study aims to examine the evolution of gender wage gaps and their decomposition by employment status in Indonesia during the pre-pandemic, pandemic, and post-pandemic periods, using SAKERNAS data from 2018 to 2023. The OLS and RIF-OLS regression estimations reveal that gender wage gaps remained substantial throughout these periods. On average, female employees earned about 30 percent less than their male counterparts, which decreased to 23 percent after controlling for other wage-related characteristics. Notably, the gap is particularly pronounced among underemployed and low-paid workers, where female employees earn approximately 40 percent to 50 percent less than their male counterparts. Decomposition results using Blinder-Oaxaca and RIF-Oaxaca methods, both at the mean and across the wage distribution, pointed out that most of the gap is due to unexplained factors, confirming the persistence of the sticky floor and glass ceiling phenomena. This suggests ongoing negative discrimination against female employees in the Indonesian labor market. Among observable characteristics, working experience, tenure, and working hours significantly contributed to the wage gap, with women generally lagging behind men in these areas. However, women's higher educational attainment, greater participation in the formal sector, access to training, and prevalence in white-collar jobs significantly helped reduce the wage gaps.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了印度尼西亚2018-2023年间的性别工资差距变化，发现女性平均工资比男性低30%，经特征调整后仍差23%。差距主要来自无法解释的因素，表明存在持续性别歧视。
AI.research_question: 印度尼西亚大流行前、大流行期和大流行后时期性别工资差距的演变过程及其分解特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究大流行期间和后期劳动力市场中性别工资差距的变化过程，以明确差距的持续性和齿轮效应
AI.theoretical_framework: 工资差距理论、劳动经济学中的性别平等理论、Blinder-Oaxaca分解方法、RIF-Oaxaca分布分解方法
AI.method: 使用SAKERNAS数据(2018-2023)，采用OLS和RIF-OLS回归估计，还使用Blinder-Oaxaca和RIF-Oaxaca方法进行差距分解
AI.findings: 女性平均工资比男性低30%，经特征调整后仍差23%；差距在低收入群体中更为显著(40-50%)；大部分差距来自无法解释的因素；工作经验、属企年限、工作时间等特征扩大差距，而教育程度、正规部门就业、培训机会等缩小差距
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了印度尼西亚劳动力市场中持续存在的性别工资差距和歧视问题，为性别平等理论提供了新的实证根据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府制定缩小性别工资差距的政策提供了重点方向，如重视女性的工作经验积累、属企年限和工作时间等问题，同时继续推进女性教育和正规部门就业

title: Investigating the effects of economic sanctions on food production in target countries: evidence from sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, International Institute of Social Studies, Erasmus University Rotterdam and Institute of Social Studies (ISS)

detail.title: Investigating the effects of economic sanctions on food production in target countries: evidence from sub-Saharan Africa
detail.abstract: Food is one of the most fundamental of all human needs and this is reflected in SDG Goal 2 of ending hunger everywhere. Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) is the most food insecure region and also the most sanctioned. Empirical evidence shows a linkage between sanctions and food insecurity. Sanctions have also been shown to reduce food imports of target states. Given SSA’s reliance on food imports, local food production is critical for food security, especially under sanctions. In light of this, we investigated the impact of economic sanctions on food production in SSA, as measured by the Food Production Index (FPI). We used fixed effects estimation with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors to estimate data from 36 countries, spanning 1990-2022. Our findings show that trade and financial sanctions have negative and significant effects on food production. We observe a statistically significant reduction in FPI by, on average, up to 5.75%. Employing a two-stage instrumental variable approach, we identify GDP per capita, inflation, and exchange rate fluctuations as the channels through which economic sanctions exert their negative influence on food production. Our findings, therefore, underscore the urgent need for resilient strategies to safeguard food systems in target countries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了经济制裁对撒哈拉以南非洲地区粮食生产的影响，发现贸易和金融制裁会显著降低粮食生产指数约5.75%，并通过人均GDP、通货膨胀和汇率波动等渠道产生影响。
AI.research_question: 经济制裁对撒哈拉以南非洲地区的粮食生产有何影响？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲是全球粮食最不安全的地区，也是受制裁最多的地区。该地区依赖粮食进口，在制裁环境下本地粮食生产对粮食安全至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制裁影响目标国家经济机制的现有理论，特别是制裁通过经济渠道影响农业生产的相关理论框架。
AI.method: 使用固定效应估计和Driscoll-Kraay标准误差方法，分析1990-2022年36个国家的数据，并采用两阶段工具变量方法识别影响渠道。
AI.findings: 贸易和金融制裁对粮食生产具有显著负面影响，平均使粮食生产指数降低5.75%。人均GDP、通货膨胀和汇率波动是主要的影响渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了经济制裁影响粮食生产的具体机制和渠道，丰富了制裁经济后果的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了制定弹性策略保护目标国家粮食系统的紧迫性，为政策制定者提供了实证依据。

reference: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics and Management No. 05-2025
title: From Means to Margins: The Uneven Effects of Hiring Market Concentration on the Gender Wage Gap in Germany
affiliations: Bielefeld University - Department of Business Administration and Economics and Bielefeld University

detail.title: From Means to Margins: The Uneven Effects of Hiring Market Concentration on the Gender Wage Gap in Germany

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics and Management No. 05-2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics & Management

detail.abstract: In this paper, we study the impact of monopsony power on the gender wage differentials at various parts of the wage distribution from 2019 to 2022. We are measuring hiring labour market concentration by constructing the HHI on the basis of online job advertisement data from Germany.The wages and a rich set of demographic characteristics are acquired from the German SocioEconomic Panel. With the help of RIF-IV, we establish that the impact of labour market concentration is more pronounced in higher deciles of the distribution for the aggregated sample, reaching-2.4% for the monthly wages and-9.6% for the hourly ones. Respective values for the medians equal to-0.9% and-4.7%. However, disaggregating by sex reveals different distributional effects for women and men. For men, the effects are consistent with the aggregated sample, where the impact is insignificant in the lower deciles and increases towards the upper end. For women, however, the impact is highest at the lower and upper deciles and the set of effects demonstrates a hump-shape. Furthermore, women in western Germany are considerably more affected than women in the East. The findings suggests that hiring labour market concentration contributes to a widening of the gender wage gap especially at the lower end of the wage distribution.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用德国在线招聘广告数据构建HHI指数衡量劳动力市场集中度，结合社会经济面板数据，通过RIF-IV方法分析2019-2022年买方垄断对性别工资差距的影响。发现市场集中度对工资的负面影响在高分位数更显著，且对女性的影响呈现U型分布，东西德女性受影响程度不同。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场集中度（买方垄断力量）如何影响不同工资分位数上的性别工资差距？
AI.motivation: 理解买方垄断力量在工资分布不同位置对性别工资差距的差异化影响，为缩小性别工资差距提供政策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 买方垄断理论、劳动力市场分割理论、工资分布理论
AI.method: 使用德国在线招聘广告数据构建赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）衡量劳动力市场集中度，结合德国社会经济面板（SOEP）的工资和人口特征数据，采用再中心化影响函数工具变量法（RIF-IV）进行分析
AI.findings: 1）市场集中度对工资的负面影响在高分位数更显著（月工资-2.4%，小时工资-9.6%）；2）男性影响模式与总体样本一致；3）女性影响呈驼峰状，低端和高端分位数受影响最大；4）西德女性比东德女性受影响更严重；5）劳动力市场集中度加剧了低端工资分布的性别差距
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了买方垄断理论在性别工资差距领域的应用，揭示了市场集中度对男女工资分布的不同影响模式
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者针对不同性别和地区制定差异化的反垄断和工资政策提供了实证依据，有助于更精准地缩小性别工资差距

title: Marital Investment when Disaster Strikes: Evidence from Indonesia
affiliations: University of Bristol - Department of Economics

detail.title: Marital Investment when Disaster Strikes: Evidence from Indonesia
detail.abstract: Natural disasters are increasing in frequency and intensity globally, posing growing challenges for vulnerable households. In developing countries with limited formal credit markets and customary marriage payments, are informal institutions, such as marriage payments, used as insurance against these shocks? To explore this question, I combine geo-coded household survey data with satellite-based flood exposure measures to estimate the effects of flooding on household financial behaviour and marriage markets in Indonesia, where the bride price, paid from the groom to the bride, is customary. I document three main findings: (i) households reallocate resources, with reductions in asset-related income and educational expenditures offset by increased farming activity; (ii) flood exposure accelerates daughters' marriages to secure liquidity through brideprice transfers, while delaying sons' marriages to benefit from their financial support to the household; and (iii) responses vary by wealth and parental education, with poorer households expediting daughters' marriages and wealthier households preserving traditional timing, reinforcing preexisting inequalities in wealth and age at marriage. These results highlight the need for policies such as credit access and disaster support to reduce reliance on early marriage as a shock-coping strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过地理编码家庭调查数据和卫星测量法，研究了危机时期亲属支持网络的作用，发现它们在缓解经济压力方面发挥了重要作用。
AI.research_question: 在发展中国家的非正式信贷市场和传统婚姻支付背景下，非正式机制如婚姻支付是否被用作应对自然灾害的保险手段？
AI.motivation: 全球自然灾害频繁和强度增加，对弱势家庭造成日益严重的挑战，需要研究非正式机制在应对这些冲击中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非正式保险机制理论、家庭资金分配理论、婚姻市场经济学
AI.method: 结合地理编码家庭调查数据和卫星基础洪水暴露测量法，对印度尼西亚进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1.家庭重新分配资源，减少资产相关收入和教育支出，增加农业活动 2.洪水劫露促使女儿提早结婚以获得婚禮金流动性，延迟儿子结婚以获得财务支持 3.困富家庭响应差异明显，加剧财富和婚姻年龄不平等
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了非正式保险机制理论，揭示了婚姻支付在应对自然灾害中的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了建议，如改善信贷访问和灾害支持，减少对过早婚姻作为应对策略的依赖

title: Refining Veblen to Improve the Predictive Effect in an Industrial Economy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Refining Veblen to Improve the Predictive Effect in an Industrial Economy
detail.abstract: Veblen's ceremonial/instrumental distinction can be reframed as two among many evolved or developed information processes humans use to extract signal from a noisy social, biological and physical environment. Fisher Information-a statistical measure widely used to organize industry-is an analytical technique used to isolate technological signals from ceremonial noise. On the production floor we treat technology as an independent reference signal, ceremonial behavior exists as noise. This signal/noise dichotomy offers a powerful lens for behavioral analysis. Metrics like Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) conflate technological signal with ceremonial noise and are ill-suited for evaluating critical energy technologies. Instead, predictive and independent measures such as Energy Return on Energy Invested (EROEI) should guide economic and policy decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文重新构建了Veblen的仪式/工具二分法，将其视为人类从嘈杂环境中提取信号的信息处理过程。使用Fisher信息作为分析技术来分离技术信号与仪式噪声，提出EROEI比LCOE更适合评估关键能源技术。
AI.research_question: 如何有效区分技术信号与仪式噪声，以及哪种指标更适合评估关键能源技术？
AI.motivation: 传统指标如LCOE混淆了技术信号与仪式噪声，需要更准确的评估方法来指导能源经济政策决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: Veblen的仪式/工具二分法、Fisher信息理论、信号噪声分离框架
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，使用Fisher信息作为分析工具来分离技术信号与仪式噪声
AI.findings: 仪式行为作为噪声存在，技术作为独立参考信号；EROEI是预测性和独立的测量方法，比LCOE更适合评估能源技术
AI.theory_contributions: 将Veblen的二分法重新构建为信息处理过程，建立了信号/噪声分析框架用于行为分析
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源技术评估提供了更准确的方法论，建议使用EROEI替代LCOE来指导经济政策决策

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w34191
title: Navigating Medicaid: Experimental Evidence on Administrative Burden and Coverage Loss
affiliations: Emory University,  and Texas A&M University - George Bush School of Government and Public Service

detail.title: Navigating Medicaid: Experimental Evidence on Administrative Burden and Coverage Loss

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Millions of people lose access to safety-net programs each year because they do not complete the required administrative processes. In a large-scale field experiment, we randomized outreach offering personalized assistance during the Medicaid renewal window to identify the impact of transaction costs on coverage loss. Our intervention – which provided information and assistance – simplified the renewal process without affecting eligibility, ensuring that avoidable coverage loss among eligible beneficiaries accounts for any effects we find. Sending pre-recorded calls offering free one-on-one assistance from health insurance navigators increased Medicaid renewal by 1 percentage point, a 1.5% increase relative to the control arm. However, the phone number on file was likely no longer valid for at least one-fifth of beneficiaries, suggesting some people did not receive their calls. Receiving the call increased successful renewals the most for tribal members (by 8 percentage points or 13%) and children (by 3 percentage points or 4%); receiving the call also increased renewals for people with income below the sample median (by 2 percentage points or 4%) and people with chronic disease (by 3 percentage points or 4%). Together, these data suggest that some eligible people, including those who need care, lose Medicaid because they struggle with the required administrative processes. The findings do not support the typical rationale for allowing barriers or costs to enrollment—namely, that they efficiently discourage participation by those who do not need or value the benefits.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 通过大规模现场实验，提供个性化帮助能够有效减少美国医疗辅助程序的管理成本，帮助合格受益人续保医保覆盖，尤其是部落成员、儿童和低收入群体。
AI.research_question: 交易成本如何影响合格受益人在美国医疗辅助程序中的覆盖持续性？
AI.motivation: 每年有数百万人因未完成管理程序而失去安全网程序的覆盖，这些程序成本可能导致合格受益人失去必要的健康保障。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本理论 - 管理程序的复杂性会增加参与者的成本，导致合格受益人放弃保障。
AI.method: 大规模现场实验，随机化提供个性化帮助服务（预录音电话提供免费健康保险导航服务）给医疗辅助续期窗口的受益人。
AI.findings: 提供帮助服务使医疗辅助续期率提高1个百分点（相对增长1.5%）；部落成员增长8个百分点（13%），儿童增长3个百分点（4%），低收入群体增长2个百分点（4%），慢性病患者增长3个百分点（4%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了交易成本在社会保障程序中的关键作用，挖成了以常见理由允许入驻障碍的偏见（认为障碍能高效阻止不需要或不重视福利的人参与）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的干预措施证据，如通过提供个性化帮助服务来简化管理程序，特别是对弱势群体的帮助，以减少可避免的覆盖丢失。

title: Managerial Reactions to the Challenges of Creating Environmentally Sustainable Practices in SMEs in Costa Rica
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Managerial Reactions to the Challenges of Creating Environmentally Sustainable Practices in SMEs in Costa Rica
detail.abstract:
In today’s world, SMEs globally have been caught under fire for their immense carbon footprint and environmental impact amidst their exponential growth. With environmental regulations being implemented internationally to curb their ecological impact, a major question arises: when sustainability goals collide with economic pressure, do the priorities of business owners or government/NGO representatives take precedent? 


To answer this question, we analyzed Costa Rica as a case study, primarily for its global reputation as a leader in sustainability and welcoming business culture. Our research method was based on conducting virtual interviews and questionnaires amongst SME managers to gain qualitative and quantitative data to draw conclusions through. We interviewed two SME leaders who gave insights into the realities of strategic planning amidst environmental legislation. 


This study should be used by policy makers, business owners, and the general public to understand the implications of environmental legislation. Whether that is in creating legislation to provide incentives for businesses to adopt sustainability measures or advocating for change in Costa Rica’s current energy model, this work provides a reference point for understanding the reactions of the business owners who will be impacted.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对哥斯达黎加SME经理的访谈和问卷调查，探讨了环境规制下企业主与政府/NGO代表在可持续发展目标与经济压力之间的优先级冲突问题。
AI.research_question: 当可持续发展目标与经济压力相冲突时，企业主与政府/NGO代表的优先级谁更重要？
AI.motivation: 全球中小企业(SMEs)在高速增长同时造成了巨大的碳踹足迹和环境影响，国际环境规制不断出台，需要研究这些规制对企业优先级的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可持续发展理论和环境规制对企业策略决策的影响理论，采用了企业环境责任与经济效益的冲突分析框架。
AI.method: 采用案例研究法，以哥斯达黎加为研究对象，通过虚拟访谈和问卷调查收集SME经理的定性和定量数据，进行结论推导。
AI.findings: 研究获得了SME经理在环境法规背景下进行战略规划的实际情况见解，揭示了业主与政府/NGO在优先级设定上的冲突实质。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了可持续发展理论在发展中国家小企业环境管理中的应用，提供了环境规制与企业经济效益冲突的实证研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了制定企业可持续发展激励措施的参考，为业主和公众理解环境法规影响提供实质建议，同时为哥斯达黎加能源模式改革提供支撑。

reference: ETUI Research Paper - Report 2025.03
title: Non-Standard and Precarious Work Across Europe An Overview and Mapping of National Actions
affiliations: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI)

detail.title: Non-Standard and Precarious Work Across Europe An Overview and Mapping of National Actions

publicationDetails.journalName: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper describes different aspects of precarious and non-standard work across Europe. These are jobs that offer less security or reduced rights to workers and which dump greater uncertainty on them. There is some discrepancy between, on the one hand, the relatively positive trends in the statistics which, for instance, show non-standard work declining at EU level; and, on the other, a wider sense of greater precarity and uncertainty. Partly, this reflects some precarious types of work, such as platform work, bogus self-employment or different types of subcontracting, not being well captured by the existing large-scale surveys.


The paper seeks to support the discussion of precarious and non-standard work in Europe by adding further descriptive detail including the opinions of trade union specialists. It makes use of two sources to describe the spread of precarious work. First, a cross-national quantitative overview of different types of non-standard and precarious work patterns across Europe and their evolution over time based on micro-data from the Labour Force Survey. This shows that non-standard work is associated with worse labour market outcomes and is concentrated among more vulnerable workers. Second, as precarious work can take many different forms, some severely underreported or not captured at all, it further reports information from an original survey among trade union affiliates of the ETUC, its standing committees and the European trade union federations to analyse: (1) the key aspects of precarious work they see; (2) the drivers and context shaping this; (3) changes over time; and (4) policy avenues to address precarious work. This survey highlights that there are several different types of precarious work that are widespread, with the key types differing by country. It also highlights that enforcement of the existing rules is often a problematic point, as is a weakening of collective bargaining. The paper ends by highlighting proposed and possible actions. Partly, these lie in the transposition of European directives such as the Platform Work Directive or the Directive on Adequate Minimum Wages. There may also be calls for greater collaboration and more information campaigns across borders as several of the challenges, particularly as regards the vulnerability of international and posted workers, are shared and go beyond a single country.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过定量和定性方法分析欧洲不稳定和非标准工作的广泛存在和形式差异，提出政策建议包括执行现有规定和跨境合作。
AI.research_question: 欧洲不稳定和非标准工作的实际范围、形式、驱动因素和政策应对策略是什么？
AI.motivation: 统计数据与实际感受的不稳定性存在差异，平台工作、假自主经营等新兴形式在现有调查中捐渌不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不稳定就业理论、劳动市场异质性理论、工会视角下的劳工权益分析。
AI.method: 双重方法：(1)基于劳动力调查微观数据的跨国定量分析；(2)对ETUC系统工会专家的原创调查进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 非标准工作导致更差的劳动市场结果，集中于更弱势劳动者；不同国家存在多种广泛但形式异质的不稳定工作；现有规则执行不力和集体谈判前化是关键问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 完善了不稳定就业的定义和测量，揭示了统计数据与实际情况的差距，为跨国比较研究提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的干预方向，包括执行现有法规、推进平台工作指令、最低工资指令等欧盟指令的转换，以及加强跨境合作和信息宣传。

title: Sorry we Subcontracted You
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sorry we Subcontracted You

publicationDetails.journalName: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The logistics sector has become increasingly important to the European economy over the past years due to the spread of e-commerce, which has brought about consumer-driven supply chains and integrated transport into retail. The four country case studies in this volume – covering France, Germany, Italy and Spain – converge in indicating that, despite this growth, working conditions in logistics have been deteriorating and consequently the staff turnover is massive. These two tendencies are only apparently contradictory. Indeed, the booming of logistics goes hand in hand with stiff price competition, boosted by the need to deliver goods to end consumers in the shortest possible time at the lowest cost. 

This Report demonstrates that in logistics subcontracting is a prevalent business model that leads to lower pay and poorer working conditions for the purpose of cutting costs and boosting profits. Moreover, because of their strong market position, the companies belonging to the big logistics and e-commerce group maintain a certain control over smaller companies, temporary work agencies or individuals (especially drivers who they treat as ‘self-employed’), to which they contract out. Therefore, subcontracting has become a strategy for separating power and profits from risks and responsibilities. 

Facing the unsustainability of the current logistics business model, the Authors claim for a European regulation aimed at reducing the benefits that companies gain through subcontracting in terms of lower responsibility and labour cost reductions. In particular, they advocate that subcontracting has to be limited: both what can be contracted out and the length of the subcontracting chain need to be restricted. As a general rule, subcontracting needs to be justified by reasons other than pure profit because, according to national Constitutions and the European Charter of Fundamental Rights, pure profit cannot prevail over workers’ rights.

AI.tldr: 欧洲物流业在电商推动下快速增长，但工作条件恶化、员工流动率高。研究发现分包是主要商业模式，导致低工资和恶劣工作条件，大公司通过分包转移风险和责任。作者呼吁欧盟限制分包，保护工人权益。
AI.research_question: 欧洲物流业快速增长背景下，分包模式如何影响工作条件和工人权益？
AI.motivation: 电商发展推动物流业重要性和增长，但伴随工作条件恶化和高员工流动率，需要研究其背后的商业模式和监管需求
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场分割理论、供应链权力关系和公司治理理论，分析分包模式对劳动关系的影响
AI.method: 多国案例研究（法国、德国、意大利、西班牙），比较分析方法
AI.findings: 1)物流业增长与工作条件恶化并存；2)分包是普遍商业模式，导致低工资和恶劣工作条件；3)大公司通过分包转移风险和责任；4)当前模式不可持续
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了物流业分包模式如何成为权力与利润分离、风险与责任转移的战略工具，丰富了供应链劳动关系理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定提供依据，建议限制分包范围和链条长度，建立以工人权益保护为核心的监管框架

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2025/3104
title: Geography Versus Income: The Heterogeneous Effects of Carbon Taxation
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE) and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Geography Versus Income: The Heterogeneous Effects of Carbon Taxation

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: The distributive effects of carbon taxation are critical for its political acceptability and depend on both income and geographic factors. Using French administrative data, household surveys, and matched employer-employee records, we document that rural households spend 2.8 times more on fossil fuels than urban households and are employed in firms that emit 2.7 times more greenhouse gases. We incorporate these insights into a spatial heterogeneous-agent model with endogenous migration and wealth accumulation, linking spatial and macroeconomic approaches. After an increase in carbon taxes, we quantify that rural households face 20% higher welfare losses than urban households. In an optimal revenue-recycling exercise, we compare transfers targeting income and geography, and show that neglecting for geography reduces welfare gains by 7%. We conclude that carbon policies should account for spatial differences to improve political feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现农村家庭碳税负担比城市家庭重20%，建议碳政策应考虑地理差异以提高政治可行性
AI.research_question: 碳税的分配效应如何受收入和地理因素影响？地理因素在碳税政策设计中有多重要？
AI.motivation: 碳税分配效应对其政治可接受性至关重要，但现有研究主要关注收入因素，忽视了地理差异的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间异质性代理人模型，结合内生迁移和财富积累理论，连接空间经济学和宏观经济学方法
AI.method: 使用法国行政数据、家庭调查和匹配的雇主-雇员记录进行实证分析，构建空间异质性代理人模型进行政策模拟
AI.findings: 农村家庭化石燃料支出是城市的2.8倍，所在企业温室气体排放是城市的2.7倍；碳税后农村家庭福利损失比城市高20%；忽视地理因素的转移支付设计会减少7%的福利收益
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了连接空间和宏观经济分析的理论框架，将地理因素系统纳入碳税分配效应研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为碳税政策设计提供实证依据，证明考虑地理差异的转移支付能显著提高政策效果和政治可行性

title: Guerrilla without Doctrine: Tactical Adaptation and Social Embeddedness of Armed Groups in the Central African Republic
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Guerrilla without Doctrine: Tactical Adaptation and Social Embeddedness of Armed Groups in the Central African Republic

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was conducted independently and received no specific grant or financial support. The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No institutional review board (IRB) or ethics committee approval was required for this research, as it is based solely on publicly available sources, secondary literature, and non-identifiable field observations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: This article examines the Central African Republic (CAR) not as a crisis-stricken state temporarily weakened by conflict, but as a fragmented sovereignty where violence has become a persistent mode of governance. Drawing on recent fieldwork, conflict data, and interdisciplinary theory, the study analyzes the strategic behavior of armed groups, their embeddedness in local orders, and the limitations of conventional counterinsurgency (COIN) doctrines. Through a three-part structure, the article first explores the political anthropology of armed actors in CAR, highlighting how historical trajectories, social networks, and economic interests shape their authority. It then turns to guerrilla warfare as a strategic repertoire, focusing on tactical decentralization, mobility, and adaptation in the absence of revolutionary ideology. Finally, the article assesses the shortcomings of state-centric COIN approaches in such environments, emphasizing the disjunction between central government strategies and fragmented security responses-including international, private, and regional actors. By decoupling insurgency from ideological coherence and by examining warfare as a multi-scalar phenomenon, the article contributes to a critical understanding of irregular conflict dynamics in post-state territories.

AI.tldr: 该研究将中非共和国视为主权碎片化的持久暴力治理模式，而非暂时冲突弱化的危机国家。通过分析武装团体战略行为、地方秩序嵌入性，揭示传统平叛理论的局限性。

AI.findings: 武装团体权威由历史轨迹、社会网络和经济利益塑造；游击战术呈现去中心化、流动性和适应性特征；国家中心的平叛策略与碎片化安全响应存在脱节

title: Effect of the countercyclical capital buffer on firm loans - Evidence from Germany
affiliations: Bank of Finland and Bank of Finland

detail.title: Effect of the countercyclical capital buffer on firm loans - Evidence from Germany

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 8/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use confidential loan-level data from the European Central Bank to investigate how changes in the countercyclical capital buffer requirement in Germany affect lending to firms. We find evidence showing that tightening the countercyclical capital buffer leads German banks to reduce the volume of corporate loans and increase the price of new loans. These effects take place immediately after the announcement, given 12 months before the change was implemented. Importantly, we find that the reduction in credit availability notably affects small and medium-sized enterprises, which experience both a significant decrease in available credit and an increase in credit costs. In contrast, large firms are not affected.

title: Non-Economic Goals of Competition Law in the Light of the European Union’s Economic Constitution; in Search for the Axiological Framework
affiliations: University of Gdansk - Faculty of Law and Administration

detail.title: Non-Economic Goals of Competition Law in the Light of the European Union’s Economic Constitution; in Search for the Axiological Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: This article was prepared as part of the project ‘Competition Law Through Constitutional Lenses: Integrating Socio-Economic and Environmental Values in a Time of Just Transition’ funded by the National Science Centre, Poland, 2023/50/E/HS5/00482.

detail.abstract: Since the entry into force of the Lisbon Treaty, the social market economy has been established as an objective of the EU internal market. It is also rooted in the constitutions and constitutional traditions of several Member States. This article interprets the concept of the social market economy as the economic constitution of the European Union, following the methodology developed by the Freiburg School of Law and Economics. According to this approach, all economic policy decisions should align with the chosen economic order. This interpretation is presented in light of underdeveloped jurisprudence and limited doctrinal contributions, revealing gaps in both legal scholarship and case law. The article explores the objectives and limits of competition law within the framework of the EU’s economic constitution. It then applies this framework to ongoing debates about broadening the aims of competition law beyond the traditional focus on economic efficiency. The article discusses potential justifications for including broader public interest considerations in competition law, as well as their limits. It argues that the concept of the economic constitution can serve as a valuable analytical tool for addressing contemporary challenges in competition law and policy.

AI.tldr: 本文运用弗莱堡学派法律经济学方法，将社会市场经济解释为欧盟的经济宪法，并探讨在此框架下竞争法的目标与限制，特别是关于将更广泛的公共利益考量纳入竞争法的辩论。
AI.research_question: 如何将社会市场经济概念解释为欧盟的经济宪法，并在此框架下分析竞争法的目标与限制？

AI.theoretical_framework: 弗莱堡学派法律经济学方法论，经济宪法理论，社会市场经济理论
AI.method: 理论分析和法律解释方法，运用经济宪法框架分析竞争法的目标和限制
AI.findings: 经济宪法概念可作为分析工具应对当代竞争法和政策挑战；在竞争法中纳入更广泛公共利益考量既有合理性也存在限制
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了欧盟经济宪法理论，为竞争法目标扩展提供了理论框架和分析工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和司法实践提供了处理竞争法与公共利益关系的分析框架，有助于弥合法律学术与判例之间的空白

title: Climate Change and Food Security: Problems, Effects and Strategies
affiliations: International Islamic University, Islamabad - Department of Politics & International Relations

detail.title: Climate Change and Food Security: Problems, Effects and Strategies
detail.abstract: Climate change, a result of human-induced activities like burning flammable minerals and cutting logs, is causing a rise in temperature, precipitation, and weather patterns. This has led to food security issues, affecting farmers' ability to obtain safe, nutritious food for health. Farmers face challenges such as altered precipitation, increased temperature, and water scarcity, which affect irrigation and soil fertility. Warmer climates also increase pests and diseases in plants and livestock, leading to declining profits in farms and cattle. Fisheries also face negative effects, as rising oceanic temperatures and acidification destroy marine ecosystems, reducing fish stocks and availability. These factors negatively affect weaker sectors of the population, particularly in developing countries that heavily rely on agriculture, leading to higher food prices, hunger, and malnutrition.

AI.tldr: 气候变化对农业生产和食物安全产生重大影响，包括降雨模式改变、温度升高、水资源短缺、病虫害增多等挑战，导致农民收益下降和食物价格上涨，尤其影响发展中国家的弱势群体。
AI.research_question: 气候变化如何影响农业生产系统和食物安全？
AI.motivation: 人类活动导致的气候变化正在带来温度、降雨和气象模式的变化，对农业生产和食物安全造成严重威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境变化与农业生产力理论、食物安全理论、气候变化影响评估理论。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析方法，分析气候变化对农业生产各环节的影响机制。
AI.findings: 气候变化导致降雨模式改变、温度升高、水资源短缺，影响灌溧和土壤肥力；病虫害增多影响务植物和畜物；海洋温度升高和酸化破坏海洋生态系统，减少气体储量。这些因素导致农民收益下降、食物价格上涨、饥饿和营养不良问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地揭示了气候变化通过多重机制影响农业生产和食物安全的理论框架，丰富了环境变化与农业发展的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对气候变化挑战的具体方向，包括农业适应技术、水资源管理、病虫害防治等预防性措施，尤其是在发展中国家的应用价值。

title: Global Climate Conditions and Commodity Prices
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Global Climate Conditions and Commodity Prices
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the dynamic effects of global climate conditions-as measured by the Niño 3.4 sea surface temperature anomalies-on a comprehensive set of commodity prices. Using a Bayesian structural vector autoregression model with monthly data from 2003 to 2025, we identify the causal impact of climate shocks while controlling for global economic activity and the value of the U.S. dollar. Our results show that El Niño shocks exert a statistically significant and persistent negative pressure on most commodity prices, with the effect being highly asymmetric, as La Niña events trigger even larger price declines. We make a novel contribution by decomposing climate anomalies into expected and unexpected components, finding that commodity price volatility is driven almost entirely by unexpected shocks. Furthermore, the analysis reveals that these impacts are heterogeneous across commodities and have evolved, with the energy sector's vulnerability intensifying over time while the agricultural sector's has diminished. These findings underscore that improving the accuracy and dissemination of climate forecasts is a key mechanism for enhancing market stability and reveal that the macroeconomic impact of climate shocks can be deflationary, challenging common policy narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文使用贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型分析2003-2025年月度数据，发现厄尔尼诺气候冲击对大宗商品价格产生显著持续的负向压力，且拉尼娜事件影响更大。气候异常的意外冲击是价格波动的主要驱动因素，能源部门脆弱性增强而农业部门减弱。
AI.research_question: 全球气候条件（以尼诺3.4海温异常衡量）对大宗商品价格的动态影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究气候冲击对商品市场的因果影响，为市场稳定和宏观经济政策提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候经济学和商品价格理论，结合预期理论分析气候冲击的传导机制
AI.method: 贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型（Bayesian SVAR），控制全球经济活动和美元价值，使用2003-2025年月度数据
AI.findings: 1) 厄尔尼诺冲击对多数商品价格产生显著负向影响；2) 拉尼娜事件影响更大，存在高度不对称性；3) 价格波动主要由意外气候冲击驱动；4) 影响存在商品异质性和时间演化特征
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将气候异常分解为预期和意外成分，揭示意外冲击是价格波动的主要驱动力，挑战传统政策叙事
AI.practical_contributions: 为提高气候预测准确性和传播提供依据，增强市场稳定性，为政策制定者应对气候相关的通缩压力提供参考

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的气候政策不确定性指数CPU-Concern，该指数同时捕捉政策不确定性的普遍程度和公众关注强度。基于荷兰数据研究发现，政策公告通过信号效应影响感知不确定性，指数在争议性政策辩论期间上升，在正式批准后下降。
AI.research_question: 气候政策公告如何通过信号效应影响公众感知的政策不确定性？
AI.motivation: 现有气候政策不确定性指标主要关注政策变化频率，但忽略了公众关注强度这一重要维度，需要开发更全面的测量工具来理解政策信号对公众认知的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、政策不确定性理论、公众关注理论
AI.method: 基于荷兰媒体数据构建CPU-Concern指数，分析政策公告期间指数变化模式
AI.findings: CPU-Concern指数在争议性政策辩论期间显著上升，在政策正式批准后下降，表明政策公告通过信号效应影响公众对不确定性的感知
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了同时考虑政策不确定性和公众关注强度的综合测量框架，拓展了政策信号理论在气候政策领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了监测公众对气候政策反应的新工具，有助于更好地设计政策沟通策略

title: The Impact of Human Capital Development on the Under-5 Mortality rate in South Africa
affiliations: Nelson Mandela University and Walter Sisulu University

detail.title: The Impact of Human Capital Development on the Under-5 Mortality rate in South Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no conflicts of interest in the study.
declarations.funderStatement: There was no finding for the study.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Applied health economics and health policy 1 (2), 1563-1613

detail.abstract: While many scholars argue that education plays a significant role in promoting human capital development evidence suggest that South Africa's human capital index is relatively lower than other countries (0.4 in 2020) as the nation is still making strides in boosting its childhood environment and this is seen in its under-5 mortality rate (U5MR) which has increased enormously between 2020 and 2022 from 29 to 40 deaths per 1000 live births. The study examined the impact of human capital development on U5MR in South Africa using time series data spanning from 1994 to 2023. The Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) method was utilised to investigate the longrun correlation between U5MR and explanatory variables, namely female literacy (FL), health access and quality (HAQ), child immunisation rate (CIR), access to improved sanitation and clean water (ISW) and prevalence of HIV/AIDS (POH) in South Africa. The analysis reveals that FL, HAQ and CIR have an insignificant correlation with U5MR. Furthermore, the analysis shows a positive correlation between ISW and U5MR and a negative correlation between POH and U5MR in the nation. This study, therefore, recommends the SBCATP strategies by the health facilities to reduce under-5 mortality in local and international contexts.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了南非人力资本发展对小于5岁儿童死亡率的影响，发现女性语文识字率、健康服务质量和儿童生物预防接种率与儿童死亡率无显著相关，而改善环境卫生条件和HIV/艾滋病普及率却与儿童死亡率呈相关性。
AI.research_question: 南非人力资本发展对小于5岁儿童死亡率的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 南非人力资本指数偏低(0.4)，小于5岁儿童死亡率在2020-2022年间从29升至40死亡/千人，需要研究人力资本发展对儿童生存的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论，认为教育和健康投资能够提高人力资本质量，从而改善人口健康状况
AI.method: 使用普通最小二乘法(OLS)分析1994-2023年时间序列数据，研究女性语文识字率、健康服务质量、儿童生物预防接种率、改善环境卫生条件和HIV/艾滋病普及率对儿童死亡率的影响
AI.findings: 女性语文识字率、健康服务质量和儿童生物预防接种率与儿童死亡率无显著相关；改善环境卫生条件与儿童死亡率呈正相关；HIV/艾滋病普及率与儿童死亡率呈负相关
AI.theory_contributions: 对传统人力资本理论提出质疑，发现在南非该地区某些人力资本指标并不能有效降低儿童死亡率，为人力资本与健康结果的关系提供了新的实证观点
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用SBCATP策略（社区基础的儿童生存干预策略）来降低小于5岁儿童死亡率，为南非和国际健康政策提供了具体的干预方向

detail.title: Real Effects of Earnings Stripping Rules

publicationDetails.detailsText: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 210
publicationDetails.journalName: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines the real effects of earnings stripping rules introduced in the European Union in 2019, which tie interest deductibility to contemporaneous profitability. Exploiting a quasi-natural experiment created by the EU's harmonized implementation under the Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive and using a difference-indifferences design, we analyze consolidated data from 3,312 firms across 22 EU Member States from 2012 to 2023. We find that earnings stripping rules significantly reduce operational risk-taking, investment, and innovation, consistent with profit-contingent deductibility lowering the expected debt tax shield in lowprofit years. These effects are particularly pronounced among firms with high pre-reform operating risk, which also experience slower growth and a higher likelihood of financial distress following the reform. This study contributes to the literature on corporate taxation and risktaking, showing that profit-linked interest limitations have real effects and underscoring the importance of rule design in balancing anti-avoidance objectives with investment and innovation.

AI.tldr: 欧盟2019年实施的收益剥离规则通过将利息扣除与当期盈利能力挂钩，显著降低了企业的运营风险承担、投资和创新活动，特别是对高经营风险企业影响更大。
AI.research_question: 欧盟2019年实施的收益剥离规则对企业运营风险承担、投资和创新活动产生了什么实际影响？
AI.motivation: 研究欧盟反避税指令下统一实施的收益剥离规则的实际经济后果，这些规则将利息扣除与当期盈利能力联系起来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于债务税盾理论，收益剥离规则在低利润年份降低了预期的债务税盾收益，从而影响企业的风险承担和投资决策。
AI.method: 利用欧盟统一实施的反避税指令构建准自然实验，采用双重差分法分析2012-2023年22个欧盟成员国3,312家企业的合并数据。
AI.findings: 收益剥离规则显著降低了运营风险承担、投资和创新活动；对改革前经营风险高的企业影响尤为明显，这些企业增长放缓且财务困境可能性增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了企业税收与风险承担文献，证明了利润关联利息限制具有实际经济效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了规则设计在平衡反避税目标与投资创新之间的重要性，为政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Global Urban Sustainability Benchmarking A Multidimensional Approach for Smart And Sustainable Cities
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation and ITMO University

detail.title: Global Urban Sustainability Benchmarking A Multidimensional Approach for Smart And Sustainable Cities
detail.abstract: A new strategic direction for ‘greening’ our cities and making them smart to reduce the environmental impact of their performance, increase employment and economic viability and enhance the quality of life requires a thorough assessment of sustainability and smart urban performance. This chapter considers a database of over ninety global cities including London, New York, Hong Kong, San Francisco, Los Angeles, São Paolo, Rio de Janeiro, Buenos Aires, Paris, Berlin, Stockholm, Moscow, Beijing, Seoul, Singapore, Shanghai, Sydney and Tokyo, exploring linkages between different sustainability and smart city dimensions. To assess urban sustainability performance, the chapter applied a multi-criteria approach using a panel of twenty indicators to a set of fifty-seven global cities. The assessment comprised important aspects of energy transitions, focusing on the drivers of CO2 emissions in cities, including the share of coal in the energy mix, public transport and cycling patterns, waste recycling, the water-energy nexus as well as the role of smart and creative economy. The results have shown San Francisco leads under economic and environmental priorities, and Stockholm under social and smart city priorities. Seoul consistently performs very successfully across the whole spectrum of indicators. We devote considerable attention to strategies, policies and performance of the leading cities: San Francisco, Stockholm and Seoul. The assessment could be a valuable tool for policy makers and investors, and could help identify linkages between different sustainability dimensions as well as investment opportunities in cities with sustainability potential.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多标准评估方法分析了70个全球城市的可持续性和智慧城市表现，发现旧金山在经济和环境优先项目中领先，斯德哥尔摩在社会和智慧城市优先项目中表现最佳，香港在各项指标中均有良好表现。
AI.research_question: 全球城市在可持续性和智慧城市各维度上的表现如何？不同可持续性维度之间存在怎样的联系？
AI.motivation: 为了绿化城市、降低环境影响、增加就业和经济可行性、提升生活质量，需要对城市可持续性和智慧性能进行全面评估。

AI.method: 采用多标准评估方法，对57个全球城市进行面板数据分析，使用20个指标来评估能源转型、CO2排放驱动因素、公共交通、废弃物回收、水-能源联系等关键领域。
