title: "Trump's New Economic Order" or "Practitioners Lead, Scholars Explain"
affiliations: University Tor Vergata - Economia

detail.title: "Trump's New Economic Order" or "Practitioners Lead, Scholars Explain"
detail.abstract: This paper examines the implications of the economic policies introduced by the 47th President of the United States, Donald Trump. It begins with an overview of the “Old Economic Order,” established after 1945, which marked the era of multilateralism. The discussion emphasizes that great economic theories have often originated from great economic practices—most notably Roosevelt’s New Deal, later conceptualized in Keynes’s General Theory of Employment, Interest, and Money. The paper then outlines the structural weaknesses of the U.S. economy preceding Trump’s presidency, particularly the growing foreign trade deficit, the expanding budget deficit, and the mounting national debt. These conditions are analyzed as the preconditions for Trump’s “America First” policies. However, the paper also argues that the political tensions generated— especially through confrontations with allies such as the European Union and Canada—were largely avoidable. Nonetheless, we are witnessing the emergence of a New Economic Order (NEO), Trump’s economic paradigm, characterized by several defining features: • Global Trade Disruption • The Concept of the Economic Nation-State • The Diminishing Role of Multilateral Organizations • Reshoring Manufacturing Finally, the paper explores the policy options available for small nations, such as North Macedonia, in navigating this shifting global economic environment. It distinguishes between two levels of response: 1. Short-Term Tactical Approach: Bilateral negotiations for preferential terms and targeted support for export-oriented industries. 2. Long-Term Strategic Approach: (1) Diversification of products and markets; (2) Value-chain upgrading; (3) Investments in branding and quality certification; (4) Expansion of digital trade and e-commerce; (5) Strategic use of diaspora networks; (6) Policy stability and institutional strengthening; and (7) Regional integration and trade alliances. Particular emphasis is placed on the long-term benefits of integrating North Macedonia and other Western Balkan countries into the European Economic Area (EEA). Epilogue Donald Trump has undeniably altered the course of economic history. Whether this transformation will prove sustainable depends on two critical factors: the persistence of Trump’s vision and the potential continuation of his policies by future administrations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析特朗普经济政策对全球经济秩序的影响，探讨美国经济结构性问题如何催生"美国优先"政策，并提出小国在此新经济秩序下的应对策略。
AI.research_question: 特朗普经济政策如何改变全球经济秩序？小国应如何应对这种新经济环境？
AI.motivation: 特朗普总统的经济政策颠覆了二战后建立的多边主义经济秩序，对全球经济格局产生深远影响，需要系统分析其影响机制和小国应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史经济实践与理论发展的互动关系（如罗斯福新政与凯恩斯理论），分析经济民族主义、双边主义对多边主义的挑战。
AI.method: 采用历史分析和政策分析方法，通过梳理美国经济结构性问题、特朗普政策特征，提出小国应对策略框架。
AI.findings: 特朗普政策形成了以全球贸易扰乱、经济民族主义、多边组织作用减弱、制造业回流为特征的新经济秩序；小国需要采取短期战术和长期战略相结合的应对方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"新经济秩序"理论框架，深化了对经济民族主义与多边主义冲突的理解，为小国经济战略提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为北马其顿等小国提供了具体的短期和长期应对策略，强调区域一体化（如加入欧洲经济区）的重要性，具有实际政策参考价值。

title: An Implied Risk-Free Rate from Distributional and CAPM Consistency: A Moment-Based Quadratic Model
affiliations: University of Delhi

detail.title: An Implied Risk-Free Rate from Distributional and CAPM Consistency: A Moment-Based Quadratic Model
detail.abstract: This paper presents an enhanced and rigorously analyzed methodology for deriving implied risk-free rates through the consistency condition between distributional and CAPM-based derivatives of beta. The approach equates two distinct constructions: (i) a distributional derivative obtained through dominated convergence theorems applied to joint density integrands, and (ii) the analytical derivative of the CAPM expression. This consistency yields a quadratic equation in the risk-free rate whose roots provide model-implied candidates. This enhanced version strengthens mathematical foundations with complete proofs, expands econometric discussion incorporating post-2020 literature on density estimation and option-implied rates, provides detailed statistical inference procedures, and comprehensively analyzes practical limitations and implementation challenges. It demonstrates that while theoretically sound, the methodology faces significant empirical hurdles including density derivative estimation noise, measurement error amplification, and model specification sensitivity, positioning it primarily as a diagnostic rather than estimation tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个增强的、经过严格分析的方法论，通过分布法和CAPM法推导beta导数的一致性条件来推导隐含无风险利率。该方法将两种构造等同：(i)通过主导收敛定理应用于联合密度被积函数得到的分布导数，和(ii)CAPM表达式的解析导数。这种一致性产生了一个关于无风险利率的二次方程，其根提供了模型隐含的候选值。
AI.research_question: 如何通过分布法和CAPM法推导beta导数的一致性条件来准确推导隐含无风险利率？
AI.motivation: 需要开发一个数学上严谨的方法来推导隐含无风险利率，以解决传统方法的局限性，并为金融理论和实践提供更可靠的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主导收敛定理的分布导数理论和资本资产定价模型(CAPM)的解析导数理论，通过建立两种导数方法的一致性条件来推导无风险利率。
AI.method: 将分布导数（通过主导收敛定理应用于联合密度被积函数获得）与CAPM表达式的解析导数等同，建立一致性条件，从而推导出关于无风险利率的二次方程并求解其根。
AI.findings: 虽然该方法在理论上是合理的，但在实证应用中面临重大挑战，包括密度导数估计噪声、测量误差放大和模型规范敏感性，因此主要作为诊断工具而非估计工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 加强了数学基础，提供了完整的证明，扩展了计量经济学讨论，纳入了2020年后关于密度估计和期权隐含利率的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了详细的统计推断程序，全面分析了实际限制和实施挑战，为金融实践提供了重要的诊断工具。

title: Private Equity Continuation Vehicles: A Model of Strategic Asset Transfers
affiliations: Harvard University, Carnegie Mellon University and University of Oxford - Said Business School

detail.title: Private Equity Continuation Vehicles: A Model of Strategic Asset Transfers
detail.abstract: We study private equity continuation vehicles (CVs), documenting their contractual features and developing a model that highlights the conflicts of interest they generate. While CVs can enhance efficiency by extending the holding period of high-potential assets, they also enable general partners (GPs) to extract rents by exploiting informational advantages and their intermediary position between legacy and new limited partners (LPs). In particular, GPs may transfer low-quality assets that should be liquidated, or high-quality assets that should be sold, thereby redistributing value across investor groups. The optimal legacy fund contract ties GP compensation to both dealand fund-level outcomes and requires GP to invest more than the carry earned on the transaction. GP coinvestment mitigates adverse selection when low-quality assets are transferred, but strengthens incentives to move high-quality assets at below fair value.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨私募股权延续基金(CVs)的合同特征和利益冲突问题。CVs虽能通过延长优质资产持有期提升效率，但也让普通合伙人(GPs)利用信息优势和中介地位从新旧有限合伙人(LPs)间提取租金。
AI.research_question: 私募股权延续基金(CVs)如何产生利益冲突？最优合同设计应如何平衡效率提升与租金提取问题？
AI.motivation: 随着私募股权市场中CVs的兴起，需要理解这种新型投资工具带来的效率提升潜力和利益冲突风险，为投资者保护和合同设计提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和信息不对称理论，分析GPs作为中介在CVs交易中的双重角色和利益冲突机制。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，结合CVs合同特征的实证观察，构建博弈论模型分析GPs在不同资产质量情况下的行为选择。
AI.findings: CVs既可通过延长优质资产持有期提升效率，也可能被GPs用于转移低质量应清算资产或高质量应出售资产，从而在不同投资者群体间重新分配价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析CVs中的利益冲突机制，提出GP双重补偿结构和跟投要求的最优合同设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私募股权基金投资者提供识别CVs交易风险的框架，为合同设计提供具体建议，包括将GP报酬与交易和基金层面结果挂钩，并要求GP投入超过附带权益的资金。

reference: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 561; Journal of Genocide Research, 0[10.1080/14623528.2025.2545083]
title: Enemy of Justice? Secrecy in Domestic War Crimes Trials in Serbia
affiliations: Indiana University - Maurer School of Law, London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) and London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Enemy of Justice? Secrecy in Domestic War Crimes Trials in Serbia

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 561
publicationDetails.journalName: Indiana University Maurer School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Secrecy is an essential element in war crimes trials, as it protects vulnerable individuals and sensitive information, ensuring trials can proceed effectively. However, secrecy often conflicts with principles of public justice, undermining the legitimacy and societal acceptance of trial processes and judgements. This, in turn, can limit the transformative potential of war crimes trials for post-conflict societies. We examine this tension between secrecy and publicity in the war crimes jurisprudence of Serbian courts. Drawing on an analysis of 164 final judgements issued between 1999 and 2019, we show that courts employ anonymization excessively and inconsistently. We document a typology of redaction techniques – including electronic patches, manual redactions, and coded substitutions – that are applied inconsistently not only across courts but also within individual documents. Similar types of information (such as names of defendants and victims, addresses, or crime locations) are sometimes redacted and sometimes left visible, reflecting the absence of harmonized standards. To assess the broader impact of these practices, we supplement our analysis with fieldwork, including interviews with legal practitioners and civil society actors. We reveal how excessive and erratic redactions of judgements obstruct transparency, impair the capacity of civil society to analyze trials, and constrain efforts to foster critical engagement with war crimes. Our study also reveals the limits of empirical methods when applied to irregularly redacted materials. The inconsistent anonymization precluded the use of advanced statistical techniques and constrained the scope of analysis. This has broader implications for research design in transitional justice, particularly when relying on digital data sources in environments with weak information governance. We conclude that reform is needed to standardize redaction practices, and that digitization alone cannot substitute for transparency. War crimes trials can only fulfil their social and historical function if protective secrecy is balanced with meaningful public access to court records.

AI.tldr: 塞尔维亚法院在战争罪审判中过度且不一致地使用匿名化技术，导致透明度受损，阻碍了民间社会对审判的分析能力，限制了战争罪审判对冲突后社会的变革潜力。
AI.research_question: 塞尔维亚法院在战争罪审判中如何处理保密与公开之间的张力？
AI.motivation: 保密在战争罪审判中保护弱势个体和敏感信息，但过度保密会损害审判的合法性和社会接受度，限制审判对冲突后社会的变革作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战争罪审判中的保密与公开张力理论，过渡时期司法理论，信息治理理论
AI.method: 分析1999-2019年间164份最终判决书，结合实地调研（包括对法律从业者和民间社会行动者的访谈）
AI.findings: 法院过度且不一致地使用匿名化技术（电子补丁、手动涂黑、编码替换），相同类型信息在不同案件甚至同一文件中处理方式不同，缺乏统一标准
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字化环境下信息治理薄弱对实证研究方法的影响，提出了战争罪审判中保密与公开平衡的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出需要改革以标准化匿名化实践，强调数字化不能替代透明度，为战争罪审判的信息管理提供实践指导

title: A Unified Theory of External Sector Growth Multipliers in Developing Economies: Time Horizons, Nonlinearities and Policy Insights (Evidence from Bangladesh)
affiliations: Ministry of Finance, Bangladesh

detail.title: A Unified Theory of External Sector Growth Multipliers in Developing Economies: Time Horizons, Nonlinearities and Policy Insights (Evidence from Bangladesh)
detail.abstract: This study develops the primary temporally disaggregated theory of external sector growth effects, suggesting why remittance, FDI and trade reveal nonlinear, time-varying impacts in labourintensive economies. Time series data were applied from FY 1995-96 to FY 2023-24, in million USD, with the base year 2015-16. The data sources are the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics, the Bangladesh Bank, and the Export Promotion Bureau. The article integrates a distributed lag (DL) model, dynamic ARDL (AIC-optimised lags), microfoundational evidence from interviews with 61 policymakers, and policy recommendations. The study's main findings are: 1) Remittance transits from short-term consumption ((𝛽 = 0.09, * 𝑝 * < 0.05) to long-term investment (𝛽 = 0.43, * 𝑝 * < 0.01) with interview data highlighting diaspora-driven SME capitalisation as the mechanism. 2) FDI reveals a hump-shaped impact, peaking at eight years (𝛽 = 21.83, * 𝑝 * < 0.05) With a delay due to institutional barriers (78% of policymakers agreed). 3) Trade shows asymmetric temporal multipliers: export boosts growth (𝛽 = + 4.09) whereas import creates crowding out of domestic production (𝛽 =-40,570 units). Policy simulation suggests that reducing FDI approval times by 30 days could boost GDP by 0.7% annually. This study directly advances towards SDG goals 8 (growth) and 9 (infrastructure), offering actionable insights for labour-intensive economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了外部部门增长效应的主要时间分解理论，解释了汇款、FDI和贸易在劳动密集型经济体中为何呈现非线性、时变影响。研究发现汇款从短期消费转向长期投资，FDI呈驼峰形影响，贸易具有不对称时间乘数效应。
AI.research_question: 为什么汇款、外国直接投资（FDI）和贸易在劳动密集型经济体中表现出非线性、时变的增长影响？
AI.motivation: 为理解外部部门（汇款、FDI、贸易）对经济增长的时间动态影响，特别是在劳动密集型经济体中，需要开发时间分解理论来指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部部门增长效应的时间分解理论，分布式滞后模型，动态ARDL模型
AI.method: 时间序列数据分析（1995-96至2023-24财年），分布式滞后模型，动态ARDL模型（AIC优化滞后），61位政策制定者的访谈微观基础证据
AI.findings: 1) 汇款从短期消费(β=0.09)转向长期投资(β=0.43)，机制是侨民驱动的中小企业资本化；2) FDI呈驼峰形影响，8年达到峰值(β=21.83)，存在制度障碍延迟；3) 贸易具有不对称时间乘数：出口促进增长(β=+4.09)，进口挤占国内生产(β=-40,570)
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了首个外部部门增长效应的时间分解理论，解释了非线性、时变影响的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 政策模拟显示减少FDI审批时间30天可使GDP年增长0.7%，为实现SDG目标8（增长）和9（基础设施）提供可操作见解

reference: 60 Ga. L. Rev. __ (forthcoming 2026)
title: Multistate Tax Norms

detail.title: Multistate Tax Norms
detail.abstract:
Although the states are each sovereign entities that adopt their own tax laws, sometimes their tax laws align with each other. When a critical mass of states adopt the same tax law, they create a “multistate tax norm.” Multistate tax norms are a type of general law representing widely-adopted state tax laws. Thus, a multistate tax norm represents some measure of uniformity among the states in tax matters.
Uniformity in state taxation is a powerful tool to promote national economic union, a foundational goal of the United States Constitution. However, the federal courts are struggling to advance this goal under the current dormant Commerce Clause doctrine, having instead become too deferential to the states. This deference inhibits the courts’ ability to check economic protectionism by the states. The federal courts should rebalance their approach to the dormant Commerce Clause doctrine by tapping into the value of uniformity and incorporating multistate tax norms into their review of state taxes. Doing so would create a doctrine that is more effective at weeding out protectionist state actions that could harm national economic union.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文推荐联邦法院在间控商业条款定则中采纳"多州税政规范"，利用已形成的多州税政统一规范来更有效地防止各州的经济保护主义行为，以促进国家经济一体化。
AI.research_question: 联邦法院如何通过采纳多州税政规范来改进间控商业条款定则，更有效地防止各州的经济保护主义行为？
AI.motivation: 当前联邦法院在间控商业条款定则下对各州太过尊重，影响了制约各州经济保护主义的能力，而税政统一性是促进国家经济一体化的重要工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多州税政规范理论，间控商业条款定则，经济保护主义理论，美国典章国家经济一体化目标。
AI.method: 理论分析法，法律原则推导，通过对现有间控商业条款定则的批判性分析，提出融入多州税政规范的改进方案。
AI.findings: 多州税政规范作为广泛采用的州税法律，代表了某种税政统一性，可以为联邦法院提供更有效的判断标准来识别和防范经济保护主义。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"多州税政规范"的新概念，丰富了间控商业条款定则理论，为联邦法院审查州税提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联邦法院提供了具体的可操作建议，通过将多州税政规范融入司法审查，提高识别和防范各州经济保护主义行为的效果，促进国家经济一体化。

reference: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 9/2025
title: DSGE Model Meets Data Gently: the Importance of Trend Modelling
affiliations: Bank of Finland and

detail.title: DSGE Model Meets Data Gently: the Importance of Trend Modelling

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 9/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: DSGE models are often specified so that the long-run variation of variables is driven by one or two common trends, which rarely holds in the data. We find that when this discrepancy exists, high-frequency components (measurement errors) capture variable-specific time variation in trends. When high-frequency components are restricted to be small or ignored, the discrepancy is captured by the model component, which distorts shock decompositions. We show that incorporating variable-specific trend components directly into the measurement equations yields a decomposition in which the high-frequency, model, and trend components each capture what they are intended to. We also find trend modelling useful in forecasting.

AI.tldr: DSGE模型中常见的共同趋势假设与数据不符，导致高频成分（测量误差）捕获了变量特定的趋势变化。当限制或忽略高频成分时，模型成分会失真。通过在测量方程中直接加入变量特定趋势成分，可以改善分解效果和预测性能。
AI.research_question: 当DSGE模型的共同趋势假设与数据不符时，如何正确处理变量特定的趋势变化以避免模型成分失真？
AI.motivation: DSGE模型通常假设变量的长期变化由一两个共同趋势驱动，但这种假设很少在数据中成立，导致模型估计和分解出现偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型框架，结合时间序列分解理论，探讨趋势建模在宏观经济分析中的应用。
AI.method: 通过在测量方程中直接纳入变量特定的趋势成分，将高频成分、模型成分和趋势成分进行分离，并进行实证分析和预测评估。
AI.findings: 当限制或忽略高频成分时，模型成分会捕获本应由趋势成分解释的变化，导致冲击分解失真。直接建模变量特定趋势可以改善分解效果和预测准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在DSGE模型中处理变量特定趋势的新方法，完善了宏观经济模型的趋势建模理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济政策分析和预测提供了更准确的模型框架，改善了冲击分解和预测性能的实际应用价值。

title: Societal Secrecy and Corporate Debt Financing Choice
affiliations: University of Sussex, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Lingnan University and Independent

detail.title: Societal Secrecy and Corporate Debt Financing Choice
detail.abstract: We investigate the impact of societal secrecy on corporate debt financing decisions. Based a sample of 30,680 firms across 34 countries, we find robust evidence that societal secrecy is positively associated with bank debt financing and negatively associated with public debt financing. This finding is robust to a wide variety of sensitivity tests and to addressing endogeneity concerns. Cross-sectional analyses show that strong shareholder rights protection and the degree of internationalization moderate the relation between societal secrecy and debt choice. Additional analyses reveal that societal secrecy influences the choice of debt financing through three channels: information asymmetry, proprietary cost information, and information production cost. Our study sheds light on societal secrecy as a potential explanation for the variations in public debt market development across countries.

AI.tldr: 研究发现社会保密文化显著影响企业债务融资选择：保密程度高的社会倾向于银行债务融资而非公开债务融资，这种关系通过信息不对称、专有信息成本和信息生产成本三个渠道发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 社会保密文化如何影响企业债务融资决策？
AI.motivation: 解释不同国家公开债务市场发展差异的原因，探讨文化因素对企业融资选择的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论、代理成本理论和制度理论，构建社会保密文化影响债务选择的理论框架
AI.method: 使用34个国家30,680家企业的样本数据，采用多元回归分析和内生性处理等方法
AI.findings: 社会保密程度与银行债务融资正相关，与公开债务融资负相关；股东权利保护和国际化程度具有调节作用；通过信息不对称、专有信息成本和信息生产成本三个渠道发挥作用
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将社会保密文化作为解释债务融资选择差异的理论因素，拓展了文化维度对公司金融影响的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业跨国融资决策提供文化层面的考量，为政策制定者促进公开债务市场发展提供参考

title: Autonomy in Contract Law
affiliations: Radboud University Nijmegen - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Autonomy in Contract Law
detail.abstract: This paper explores the role of autonomy as a value or principle underlying contract law and as a regulatory goal pursued by lawmakers and courts within contract law. It emphasizes the critical role autonomy plays in enabling individuals to shape their economic interactions and life choices through contractual agreements. The paper contrasts the traditional 'principle approach', rooted in 19thcentury liberalism, which treats autonomy as a starting point and prioritizes freedom from state interference and individual responsibility, with the 'substantive equality approach', which treats autonomy as an aspirational final point and recognizes the need for regulatory intervention to ensure true autonomy by addressing power imbalances and vulnerabilities. The discussion in this paper highlights how market failures, such as monopolies and information asymmetry, can threaten autonomy and necessitate protections through competition law and contract regulation. The paper also explores debates around paternalism, particularly the balance between weak and strong forms of state intervention, and the implications of the choice theory of contracts. This theory advocates diversifying contract options to enhance autonomy, but it also raises challenges regarding market dynamics and the cognitive burden on individuals. Overall, the paper emphasizes the complexity of safeguarding autonomy within evolving legal and economic frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了自主性作为合同法基本原则和监管目标的重要作用，分析了传统原则方法与实质平等方法的对比，讨论了市场失灵对自主性的威胁以及国家干预的适当程度。
AI.research_question: 自主性作为合同法的基本原则和监管目标，如何在现代法律和经济框架中得到有效保障？
AI.motivation: 随着市场环境的变化和权力不平衡问题的凸显，传统基于19世纪自由主义的合同法原则面临挑战，需要重新审视自主性的内涵和保护机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统原则方法（19世纪自由主义）与实质平等方法的对比理论；选择合同理论；市场失灵理论（垄断、信息不对称）。
AI.method: 理论分析和对比研究方法，通过对不同法学理论和监管方法的系统比较来探讨自主性的保护机制。
AI.findings: 市场失灵（如垄断和信息不对称）威胁自主性，需要通过竞争法和合同监管进行保护；国家干预需要在弱式和强式父爱主义之间寻求平衡；选择合同理论虽能增强自主性但也带来市场动态和认知负担的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了自主性作为合同法基本原则和监管目标的综合分析框架，深化了对传统原则方法与实质平等方法对比的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和法院提供了在保护合同自主性时平衡自由与干预的实践指导，有助于设计更有效的法律保护机制来应对市场失灵和权力不平衡问题。

title: Independent Preparation Escrow (IPE) Model: An Arm's-Length Mechanism to Accelerate Municipal PPP Preparation in South Africa

detail.title: Independent Preparation Escrow (IPE) Model: An Arm's-Length Mechanism to Accelerate Municipal PPP Preparation in South Africa
detail.abstract: The Independent Preparation Escrow (IPE) Model allows a private entity to prefund an independent escrow account that pays invoices from a municipality-appointed Transaction Advisor for feasibility and procurement work. The municipality maintains control over the scope and governance; all outputs are disclosed in the tender data room; and the preferred bidder reimburses documented preparation costs plus a capped, benchmark-linked carry-cost at financial close. The IPE Model speeds up the time-to-tender while maintaining competition, transparency, and auditability.

AI.tldr: 独立准备金托管模型允许私营机构预先设立独立托管账户，为市政指定的交易顾问支付可行性研究和采购工作的发票，加快招标进程同时保持竞争性、透明度和可审计性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能加快基础设施项目招标进程，又能保持竞争性、透明度和可审计性的融资机制？
AI.motivation: 传统基础设施项目准备阶段资金不足导致招标延迟，需要一种既能解决资金问题又不损害公共利益的创新融资模式。

title: Global Supply Chain Resilience in Emerging Technologies: A Case Study of Bitcoin Mining
affiliations: Washington and Lee University - School of Law and Southern Methodist University - Dedman School of Law

detail.title: Global Supply Chain Resilience in Emerging Technologies: A Case Study of Bitcoin Mining

publicationDetails.detailsText: SMU Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 707
publicationDetails.journalName: Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The United States has put into motion bold plans in critical and emerging technologies to bolster its national and economic security. For example, the federal government created a national bitcoin strategic reserve and a stockpile of other cryptocurrency; while several states have committed to or are considering similar goals. However, the security of these reserves is dependent on two types of supply chains within the Bitcoin mining industry: analogue supply chains, relating to the physical components needed for Bitcoin mining, and data supply chains, relating to the complex and layered logistical network of actors that create input into the software components of a technical system. 

More broadly, because critical and emerging technologies are central to preserving U.S. economic and national security advantages, the resilience of their supply chains is itself a matter of national security. Yet ensuring this resilience often falls to private market actors. Analyzing these supply chains therefore requires a bi-directional perspective: On one side, the technologies’ national security significance shapes how firms approach risk management. On the other, the degree to which firms succeed in managing their supply chain risks will in turn determine the security of the nation. 

This Article makes two contributions: First, securing the supply chain resilience key to U.S. national and economic security in critical and emerging technologies requires a bi-directional perspective that considers the private law impact on an area normally dominated by public law considerations. Second, the Article then provides a framework that equips private actors to meet this challenge by distinguishing among supply chain types; identifying risks within each; describing the reciprocal relationship between national security and corporate supply chain management; and accounting for the unique features of these supply chains—particularly that they extend beyond physical components to include layered data networks.

title: The Winner's Curse in Housing Markets
affiliations: Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) - Saunders College of Business, West Virginia University, UNC Charlotte and Cornell SC Johnson College of Business

detail.title: The Winner's Curse in Housing Markets
detail.abstract: This paper tests for a winner’s curse in housing markets by examining the subsequent performance of bidding war transactions relative to non-bidding war transactions. We develop a model in which homebuyers who purchase their house in a bidding war experience lower annualized returns and a higher likelihood of mortgage default. Consistent with the model, we find that homebuyers in bidding wars experience average total unlevered returns that are 10.5 percentage points lower, equivalent to an overpayment of 8.2 percent, and are 1.9 percentage points more likely to default. These winner’s curse effects are more pronounced among socioeconomically vulnerable homebuyers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过检验竞价战交易相对于非竞价战交易的后续表现，测试了住房市场中是否存在赢家诅咒现象。研究发现竞价战购房者年化回报率更低、抵押贷款违约率更高，证实了赢家诅咒的存在。
AI.research_question: 住房市场中是否存在赢家诅咒？竞价战购房者是否比非竞价战购房者表现更差？
AI.motivation: 研究住房市场中竞价战对购房者后续财务表现的影响，验证赢家诅咒理论在房地产市场的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 赢家诅咒理论（Winner's Curse Theory） - 在竞价环境中，获胜者往往因为过度支付而遭受损失
AI.method: 开发理论模型并实证分析竞价战交易与非竞价战交易的比较数据，考察回报率和违约率差异
AI.findings: 竞价战购房者平均总无杠杆回报率低10.5个百分点（相当于过度支付8.2%），违约可能性高1.9个百分点；社会经济脆弱群体中赢家诅咒效应更明显

title: Environmental Risk in Municipal Bond Markets: The Role of Air Pollution
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University and Texas A&M University

detail.title: Environmental Risk in Municipal Bond Markets: The Role of Air Pollution
detail.abstract: We show that county-level air pollution substantially increases municipal borrowing costs. Utilizing quasi-random variation in fine particulate matter (PM 2.5) exposure generated by the 2005 Clean Air Act nonattainment designations and subsequent coal plant retirements, we find municipalities in polluted counties issue bonds at significantly higher offering yields and yield spreads than their cleaner counterparts. Specifically, a one-standard-deviation rise in log PM 2.5 corresponds to a 1.1 basis-point increase in bond yield spreads, translating into roughly $115,000 annually for the average county and approximately $259 million annually across all U.S. counties examined. The pollution premium intensifies for bonds with greater repayment risk and longer maturities, indicating investor perceptions of persistent credit risk. We identify three reinforcing fiscal mechanisms driving this premium: elevated local hospital expenditures, reduced intergovernmental transfers, and diminished tax revenues. Collectively, our findings highlight air pollution as a significant factor that tightens municipal financial constraints and limits local governments' fiscal capacity.

AI.tldr: 研究发现县级空气污染显著增加市政债券融资成本，PM2.5每增加一个标准差导致债券利差上升1.1个基点，年化成本约2.59亿美元
AI.research_question: 空气污染如何影响市政债券的融资成本？
AI.motivation: 探讨环境因素对地方政府财政能力的制约作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学、公共财政理论、信用风险评估理论
AI.method: 利用2005年清洁空气法案非达标地区指定和燃煤电厂退役产生的准随机变化进行因果推断
AI.findings: 污染严重县市政债券发行收益率和利差显著更高；污染溢价在还款风险高和期限长的债券中更明显；通过医疗支出增加、政府间转移支付减少和税收收入下降三个财政机制传导
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示空气污染对市政融资成本的影响机制，拓展了环境因素与财政能力关系的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府环境治理提供经济激励依据，帮助投资者更好评估市政债券的环境风险

title: Tackling Informality in the Platform Economy: A Social Security Driven Approach
affiliations: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) - Faculty of Law, Independent and KU Leuven

detail.title: Tackling Informality in the Platform Economy: A Social Security Driven Approach

publicationDetails.journalName: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Informal work refers to employment that is not, or is only partially, covered by formal arrangements, often resulting in limited or no social security contributions and protection for the workers involved. This issue lies at the core of social security systems, which aim to protect individuals against social risks and uphold solidarity through redistribution. Given the diverse nature of informal employment, policy responses vary depending on the worker groups targeted and the objectives to be achieved. While some informal workers may benefit from measures such as administrative simplification and reduced social contributions, the formalisation of others may require stricter enforcement and effective monitoring. 

In recent years, digital labour platforms have rapidly expanded as providers of work. As a specific subcategory of non-standard employment, platform work has a strong tendency to informalise work. Due to its structural characteristics, platform work often leaves workers (un)intentionally unprotected against social risks. 

Given the significant share of informal employment in the EU’s platform economy, this paper focuses on formalisation measures aimed at strengthening social security coverage. It examines examples from outside the EU, as various approaches to protecting informal platform workers have been explored globally. Since platform workers within and beyond the EU face similar or comparable challenges, identifying good practices can provide valuable insights. By doing so, this paper aims to offer guidance on how the EU and its Member States can formalise the platform economy to meet the objectives set out in the European Pillar of Social Rights and the 2019 Council Recommendation on access to social protection.

title: How Fintech Affects Spending Behavior: Evidence from Tap-to-Pay
affiliations: University of Utah

detail.title: How Fintech Affects Spending Behavior: Evidence from Tap-to-Pay
detail.abstract: This paper examines how tap-to-pay (TTP) adoption affects consumer spending using proprietary item-level transaction data from U.S. convenience stores. Exploiting staggered store rollouts and employing both difference-indifferences and instrumental variable designs, I show that TTP raises monthly consumer spending primarily by increasing transaction frequency, while average transaction size at the consumer-month level remains stable. At the transaction level, however, TTP purchases are larger and contain more items. The effects are concentrated in beverages, tobacco, and lottery products, consistent with theories of payment salience and self-control. These findings highlight how interface-level fintech innovations alter consumer behavior.

title: The Architecture of Blockchain Value: Capabilities, Pillars, and Growth Dynamics
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Architecture of Blockchain Value: Capabilities, Pillars, and Growth Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper develops a capability-based framework for understanding the architecture and value of blockchain systems. We classify networks into three paradigms: single-capability systems that deliver one core function, multi-capability systems that integrate programmable services, and meta-capability systems that coordinate marketplaces of heterogeneous services. To explain how these paradigms scale, we introduce five architectural pillars, purpose, consensus, incentives, tokenomics, and network effects, that jointly determine the feasibility and sustainability of capability sets. Building on these foundations, we propose a valuation model in which network value arises from user adoption, per-unit service value, and architectural network effects, with composability across capabilities generating quadratic growth advantages. A formal dominance result shows that, under symmetric conditions, meta-capability systems structurally outperform multi-capability systems, which in turn dominate single-capability systems. The framework advances both theory and practice by linking protocol design choices directly to value creation. For managers, investors, and policymakers, the results highlight why some architectures scale reliably while others encounter structural bottlenecks, offering a structured basis for evaluating long-term viability and strategic positioning of blockchain ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于能力的区块链系统架构与价值评估框架，将网络分为单能力、多能力和元能力三种范式，通过五大架构支柱分析其扩展性，并建立了包含用户采用、服务价值和网络效应的估值模型，证明了元能力系统在对称条件下的结构优势。

AI.theoretical_framework: 能力基础观、网络效应理论、架构设计理论、代币经济学

AI.findings: 1）区块链系统可分为单能力、多能力和元能力三种范式；2）五大架构支柱（目的、共识、激励、代币经济学、网络效应）共同决定能力集的可行性和可持续性；3）元能力系统在对称条件下结构上优于多能力系统，后者又优于单能力系统

title: Methodological Guide for Applying the Decentralized Monetary Index -Risk (DMI-R): A Framework for Quantitative and Qualitative Assessment

detail.title: Methodological Guide for Applying the Decentralized Monetary Index -Risk (DMI-R): A Framework for Quantitative and Qualitative Assessment
detail.abstract:
The purpose of this guide is to introduce a rigorous framework for applying the Decentralized Monetary Index – Risk (DMI-R), developed by Lotfi Mahiddine, to assess the systemic risks posed by decentralized finance (DeFi) to monetary policy and financial stability.  
The index is designed to help central banks:

- Track liquidity shifts from traditional banking to DeFi.
- Measure the erosion of monetary control, especially interest rate effectiveness.
- Analyze the interconnectedness between traditional and decentralized systems.
- Define early warning thresholds to trigger appropriate policy or regulatory responses.

In essence, this document lays the foundation for a new analytical tool that empowers policymakers to navigate the emerging risks of a decentralized financial era.

AI.tldr: 本指南介绍了DMI-R指数框架，用于评估DeFi对货币政策和金融稳定的系统性风险，帮助央行追踪流动性转移、衡量货币政策有效性、分析系统关联性并设定预警阈值。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统性风险指数来评估去中心化金融（DeFi）对传统货币政策和金融稳定的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着DeFi的快速发展，传统央行面临流动性转移、货币政策有效性下降等新挑战，需要新的分析工具来监测和应对这些系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统性风险理论、货币政策传导机制理论和金融稳定性理论，结合DeFi特有的去中心化特性构建分析框架。

AI.findings: 提出了一个完整的DMI-R指数框架，能够系统性地监测DeFi对传统金融体系的冲击，为政策制定提供早期预警。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了首个专门针对DeFi系统性风险的理论框架，填补了传统金融风险理论与新兴去中心化金融之间的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和监管机构提供了实用的监测工具，帮助其及时识别风险、制定应对策略，维护金融稳定和货币政策有效性。

title: DNA-Based Fiscal Simulation Models: The Future of Predictive Tax Strategy

detail.title: DNA-Based Fiscal Simulation Models: The Future of Predictive Tax Strategy
detail.abstract: As financial uncertainties evolve, conventional tax estimation techniques strain to articulate the intricate connections between consumers, investors, regulations, and other aspects. DNA-Based Fiscal Simulation Models, which are centred on versatile, biologically plausible redesigns of computerised simulation operations (scenarios that imitate adaptive real phenomena), indicate an intriguing theoretical advancement for forecasting tax modelling. These frameworks, which integrate agent-based simulation, artificial intelligence (AI), and big data, may simulate adaptive, autonomous decision-making, reminiscent of biological procedures. This white paper addresses how we anticipate DNA-Based Fiscal Simulation Models have an ability to substantially reinvent the tax policy environment via offering realistic income, conformity, and economic effect analyses and/or projections for the dynamic tax scenario. We provide the method we use, the prospective advantages resulting from employing fiscal simulation models for distribution tax modelling, operational obstacles, and model examples such as scenarios and infographics. If authorities can accept DNA-Based Fiscal Simulations and reconsider and come up with a tax plan, they will be able to stimulate economic growth while enhancing taxpayer hu compliance and boosting revenue the production process.

AI.tldr: DNA-Based Fiscal Simulation Models integrate agent-based simulation, AI and big data to revolutionize tax policy analysis by simulating adaptive decision-making processes, offering realistic economic projections and compliance analysis.
AI.research_question: How can DNA-Based Fiscal Simulation Models reinvent tax policy environment through realistic income, conformity and economic effect analyses?
AI.motivation: Conventional tax estimation techniques struggle to articulate complex connections between consumers, investors, regulations and other financial aspects in evolving financial uncertainties.
AI.theoretical_framework: Biologically plausible redesigns of computerized simulation operations that imitate adaptive real phenomena, integrating agent-based simulation, artificial intelligence and big data.
AI.method: Agent-based simulation combined with AI and big data analytics to simulate adaptive, autonomous decision-making processes reminiscent of biological procedures.
AI.findings: DNA-Based Fiscal Simulation Models have the ability to substantially reinvent tax policy environment by offering realistic analyses and projections for dynamic tax scenarios.
AI.theory_contributions: Proposes a novel theoretical framework of biologically-inspired simulation models for fiscal policy analysis, bridging computational science and economics.
AI.practical_contributions: Enables authorities to stimulate economic growth while enhancing taxpayer compliance and boosting revenue production through improved tax planning.

title: Indicator-based Multi-criteria Urban Sustainability Assessment under Varying Policy Priorities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Indicator-based Multi-criteria Urban Sustainability Assessment under Varying Policy Priorities
detail.abstract: The international political community currently accepts the sustainable city concept as the mechanism through which society can address its economic, social and ecological urban problems. The aim of this study was therefore to compare, and then rank, 19 alternative global cities against a family of 17 sustainability criteria. The chosen family of sustainability criteria represent economic, environmental and social aspects of urban sustainability. Cities were then assessed against four differing policy priorities, as defined by four differing decision makers: (1) overall sustainability, (2) economic sustainability, (3) environmental sustainability, and (4) social sustainability. Both weighted-sum and multi-criteria aids were employed to assess the city decision problem from weak and strong sustainability perspectives. The chapter concludes that a multi-criteria, non-compensatory approach is more useful for structuring and appraising the complex and dynamic city system through the implementation of a strong sustainability approach. Of the 19 cities, Stockholm ranked highest under three policy priorities, with Munich ranking highest under economic sustainability. This chapter explains the choice of sustainability indicators and the two methods used to identify the highest-ranking alternative from the given set of possible alternatives: first, a weighted-sum approach, and second, a multi-criteria decision aid (MCDA) approach, ELECTRE III.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较并排名了19个全球城市在17个可持续发展标准下的表现，采用加权求和与多标准决策分析（ELECTRE III）两种方法，从弱可持续性和强可持续性角度评估城市可持续发展水平。
AI.research_question: 如何评估和比较不同全球城市在可持续发展方面的表现？
AI.motivation: 国际社会将可持续城市概念作为解决经济、社会和生态城市问题的机制，需要建立有效的评估方法来比较不同城市的可持续发展水平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论，包括经济、环境和社会三个维度的可持续性；弱可持续性与强可持续性理论框架；多标准决策分析理论。
AI.method: 采用17个可持续发展标准（涵盖经济、环境和社会方面），使用加权求和法和多标准决策辅助方法（ELECTRE III）对19个全球城市进行评估和排名。
AI.findings: 斯德哥尔摩在三个政策优先级中排名最高，慕尼黑在经济可持续性方面排名最高；多标准非补偿性方法更适合通过强可持续性方法评估复杂的城市系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合弱可持续性和强可持续性视角的城市可持续发展评估框架；验证了多标准非补偿性方法在城市系统评估中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了城市可持续发展评估的具体方法；建立了可操作的城市排名体系；为不同政策优先级下的城市选择提供了决策支持。

title: Financial Inclusion and Wealth Accumulation under Dual Banking System: Evidence from Machine Learning
affiliations: Seikei University - Faculty of Economics and University of Malaya (UM)

detail.title: Financial Inclusion and Wealth Accumulation under Dual Banking System: Evidence from Machine Learning
detail.abstract: Using unique survey data in Malaysia from 2021-2024, this study investigates similarities and differences of household financial inclusions by standard commercial banks and Islamic banks. We first show that households are more likely to open bank account at standard commercial banks through geographically distributed branches, but this not the case for Islamic banks. We second demonstrate that banked households have larger financial assets, liabilities, and higher homeownership than unbanked households no matter which types of bank accounts are opened. Third, the existence of dual banking systems leads to financial inclusion of more households, with standard commercial banks financially inclusive of middle-income households and Islamic banks financially inclusive of low-income households.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2021-2024年马来西亚独特调查数据，分析了标准商业银行和伊斯兰银行在家庭金融包容方面的异同。研究发现两类银行在服务客户群、地理分布和收入层级方面存在补充关系，双重银行体系有助于提高整体金融包容性。
AI.research_question: 标准商业银行与伊斯兰银行在家庭金融包容方面存在哪些相似之处和差异？双重银行体系如何影响家庭的金融包容水平？
AI.motivation: 马来西亚存在标准商业银行和伊斯兰银行并行运作的双重银行体系，但尚缺乏对两者在家庭金融包容方面异同性的系统研究。理解这种双重结构对金融包容的影响有助于为政策制定者提供见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融包容理论，采用微观家庭数据来分析不同银行类型对家庭金融参与的影响。考虑到地理可达性、收入层级、资产负债结构等因素。
AI.method: 使用2021-2024年马来西亚独特调查数据，进行实证分析。采用统计模型评估家庭在不同类型银行开户的决策因素，以及银行开户对家庭资产、负债和房产拥有情况的影响。
AI.findings:
1）家庭更倾向通过地理分布广泛的标准商业银行开户，但伊斯兰银行不存在这种地理优势
2）无论开设哪类银行账户，已银行化家庭都拥有更大金融资产、更多负债和更高的房产拥有率
3）双重银行体系提高了整体金融包容性：标准商业银行覆盖中收入家庭，伊斯兰银行覆盖低收入家庭
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了金融包容理论，证明了双重银行体系在提升金融包容性方面的补充作用，为理解不同银行类型的异质性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为马来西亚政府和监管机构提供了政策建议：可以利用两类银行的补充特点来实现更全面的金融包容，标准商业银行重点服务中收入群体，伊斯兰银行重点服务低收入群体。

title: Wage Spillovers and Internal Migration: Evidence from India *
affiliations: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Tax Analysis (OTA), World Bank - Research Department and World Bank

detail.title: Wage Spillovers and Internal Migration: Evidence from India *
detail.abstract: How are local labor markets linked and how are wage spillovers transmitted across markets? More importantly, what is the role of the inter-market labor flows in this process? In order to answer these questions, we construct a spatial equilibrium model of endogenous labor mobility where the migration decisions are based on the standard random utility model. We show that the resulting equilibrium distribution of wages across markets can be estimated by an endogenous spatial autoregressive (SAR) specification where the elements of the weight matrix are functions of the bilateral migration flows. Next, we use internal migration and local wage data from India to estimate the predictions of the analytical model. More specifically, we explore the extent of the spatial interdependence of wages while accounting for the endogeneity of migration patterns. Using the estimated parameters, we simulate several counterfactual scenarios. With an exogenous productivity shock at the origin market, we find greater productivity shocks spillover to other markets that have stronger migration linkages with the affected market.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个考虑内生劳动力流动的空间均衡模型，通过印度内部迁移和工资数据估计发现：市场间迁移流动是工资溢出效应的重要传导机制，与受影响市场迁移联系更强的地区会获得更大的生产率冲击溢出。
AI.research_question: 地方劳动力市场如何相互联系？工资溢出效应如何跨市场传播？跨市场劳动力流动在这一过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解劳动力市场间的相互联系机制，特别是迁移流动在工资溢出传导中的作用，对于制定有效的区域经济政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机效用模型的空间均衡模型，内生劳动力迁移决策，内生空间自回归(SAR)规范
AI.method: 构建理论模型，使用印度内部迁移和当地工资数据进行实证估计，通过模拟反事实情景分析
AI.findings: 市场间迁移流动是工资溢出的重要传导渠道；与受影响市场迁移联系更强的市场会获得更大的生产率冲击溢出效应
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了考虑内生迁移决策的空间均衡模型，提出了基于双边迁移流的内生空间权重矩阵构建方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解区域经济联动机制的理论框架，有助于设计更有效的区域发展政策

title: Online Search Behavior and Consumer Intent: Implications for Nowcasting
affiliations: Bank of Finland - Research and University of Jyväskylä - Jyväskylä International Macro & Finance Research Group (JyIMaF)

detail.title: Online Search Behavior and Consumer Intent: Implications for Nowcasting

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Finland Research Discussion Paper No. 10/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Finland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines online search activity’s ability to capture consumers’ intentions and enhance short-term forecasting of key economic outcomes. Economic decisions such as consumption and investment are typically preceded by intentions, which, while difficult to observe directly, often manifest as online information-seeking behavior. Using a large, high-frequency dataset of search activity, we nowcast U.S. consumer confidence and private consumption, finding that legal and governmental searches are associated with shifts in consumer confidence, while real estate and news-related searches add value to forecasts of private consumption. We then extend the analysis to GDP nowcasting for selected OECD economies, assessing the predictive performance of search-based indicators across different contexts. Overall, our findings highlight the value of digital attention data as behaviorally grounded signals of consumer intentions, offering a timely complement to traditional economic indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现在线搜索活动能够有效捕捉消费者意图，提升关键经济指标的短期预测能力。通过分析高频搜索数据，发现特定类型的搜索（法律政府类、房地产新闻类）与消费者信心和私人消费存在显著关联，并成功应用于OECD国家的GDP即时预测。
AI.research_question: 在线搜索活动能否捕捉消费者意图并增强关键经济结果的短期预测能力？
AI.motivation: 经济决策通常基于意图，而意图难以直接观察，但往往通过在线信息搜索行为表现出来。传统经济指标存在时滞，需要更及时的行为信号来改善预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和信息搜索理论，认为消费者的经济意图会通过在线搜索行为表现出来，这些数字注意力数据可以作为行为基础的经济信号。
AI.method: 使用大规模高频搜索数据集，进行美国消费者信心和私人消费的即时预测（nowcasting），并扩展到OECD经济体的GDP预测，评估搜索指标在不同情境下的预测性能。
AI.findings: 法律和政府相关搜索与消费者信心变化相关，房地产和新闻相关搜索对私人消费预测有增值作用。搜索指标在OECD国家的GDP即时预测中表现良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了数字注意力数据作为消费者意图行为信号的理论价值，为行为经济学和信息经济学提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了及时补充传统经济指标的预测工具，为政策制定者和企业提供了更快速的经济趋势洞察，改善了短期经济预测的准确性和时效性。

title: Collaboration vs. Affiliation in Higher Education: A Case Study of Institutional Misrepresentation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The researcher (author) affirms a moral obligation as a whistleblower registered with the Hungarian Commissioner of Human Rights. Despite potential risks of retaliation, the full-time student remains dedicated to exposing academic misconduct at Semmelweis University. The objective is not to shame or demean any faculty or colleagues but to raise awareness through publication in international scholarly journals. The goal is to highlight the academic violations at Semmelweis University, ensuring that international audiences receive evidence-based information supported by references, notwithstanding possible collusion within Hungarian national institutions, including the Hungarian Administrative Court, the Commissioner of Human Rights, and the Hungarian Accreditation Committee (MAB). Presently, the independent researcher is engaged in additional research for another year, awaiting responses from national institutions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No participants or ethics approval was required for this publication, which is a preprint, early-stage research.
declarations.funderStatement: The researcher is not affiliated with any political party or organization, and is not being helped with finances.

detail.abstract: This document records a recurrent pattern of misrepresentation concerning affiliations and claims of institutional equivalence by Dr. Alán Alpár, Vice-Rector for International Studies at Semmelweis University. Notably, Alpár has proposed or implied associations with Harvard University and has asserted that Semmelweis University is 'on par with Harvard.' Independent verification reveals no verified ties to Harvard, and objective comparisons indicate a substantial disparity between the two institutions. The analysis is contextualized within the framework of documented violations of educational rights at Semmelweis University, which is presently subject to active proceedings by the Ombudsman and the Administrative Court (Case No. EBF-AJBH-309-2025; 7. Kpk. 750.239/2025/2). By consolidating various evidence, international oversight acknowledgments, and disclosures protected by whistleblower statutes, this paper uncovers systemic misrepresentations while upholding a neutral and evidence-based perspective.

title: The Impact of Tuition Fees on Student Migration: Evidence from Sweden
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago

detail.title: The Impact of Tuition Fees on Student Migration: Evidence from Sweden
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the effect of imposing tuition fees in Sweden on the location decision of international university students. Using a synthetic difference-indifferences model, I compare non-Swedish EEA students, who are not affected by the policy, to students from a set of developed countries who face this rise in tuition costs over a period of 17 years. I find that, on average, a decrease of 140 students per country of origin, which corresponds to approximately 98% of the average number of students from Non EEA developed countries studying in Sweden, and the effect is stable over time. Additionally, I find weak evidence that fewer foreign students impact the decision of Swedish students to study abroad in the short run.

AI.tldr: 本文评估瑞典征收学费对国际大学生留学地选择的影响，发现学费政策导致非欧盟发达国家生源平均减少140人/国（约98%），且对瑞典学生出国留学决策有微弱短期影响

title: The Intervention Fragility Quotient: An Improved Metric for Assessing Robustness in Clinical Trials
affiliations: Elson S Floyd College of Medicine, Washington State University

detail.title: The Intervention Fragility Quotient: An Improved Metric for Assessing Robustness in Clinical Trials

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The reproducibility crisis in biomedical research highlights the need for more reliable statistical tools beyond the p-value. Fragility metrics, such as the Fragility Index and Fragility Quotient, have been proposed to measure the robustness of clinical trial outcomes; however, both suffer from methodological limitations, including sample size dependency and imbalance between intervention and control groups. The Intervention Fragility Quotient addresses these limitations and is applicable to both equal and unequal randomizations. While the Fragility Quotient normalizes the Fragility Index to the total sample size, the Intervention Fragility Quotient contextualizes fragility within the intervention arm, thereby providing a more clinically meaningful interpretation. Worked examples illustrate the differences between these three fragility metrics. We recommend replacing the Fragility Quotient, which is distorted by unequal randomization, with the Intervention Fragility Quotient, which applies across all randomization ratios. The Intervention Fragility Quotient provides a pragmatic and interpretable tool for clinical 2 trialists, regulators, and decision-makers, with potential applications in adaptive designs, regulatory submissions, and portfolio risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出干预脆弱性商数（Intervention Fragility Quotient）作为改进的统计工具，解决了现有脆弱性指标在样本量依赖性和组间不平衡方面的局限性，为临床研究提供更可靠的稳健性评估方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个适用于不同随机化比例的脆弱性指标，以克服现有Fragility Index和Fragility Quotient的方法学局限性？
AI.motivation: 生物医学研究的可重复性危机需要超越p值的更可靠统计工具，现有脆弱性指标存在样本量依赖性和组间不平衡等局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于临床试验统计稳健性理论，特别是脆弱性指标的理论框架，包括Fragility Index和Fragility Quotient的概念基础。
AI.method: 理论方法开发，通过数学推导提出Intervention Fragility Quotient，并使用工作实例比较三种脆弱性指标的差异。
AI.findings: Intervention Fragility Quotient能够有效解决样本量依赖性和组间不平衡问题，适用于所有随机化比例，提供更具临床意义的解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的脆弱性度量理论框架，扩展了临床试验稳健性评估的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床研究人员、监管机构和决策者提供了实用的统计工具，可应用于适应性设计、监管提交和投资组合风险评估等领域。

detail.title: Human Capital Outflow under the Effect of Economic Misery and Institutional Quality: Empirical Evidence from Selected Developing Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding body involved in this research

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal Article, Journal name " Pakistan Journal of Economic Studies

detail.abstract: Objective: Broader macroeconomic, monetary, and fiscal policies require reliable variance estimates to minimize economic misery. This research aims to determine economic misery and institutional quality on human capital outflow. Research Gap: An existing study evaluating the relationship of only one variable (economic misery) with human capital outflow. We are examining the relationship between human capital outflow and economic misery after applying the conditionality of a critical variable, the institutional quality index, another essential variable. Design/Methodology/Approach: This study avails a fixed effect approach to assess the economic misery effect for the case of 68 developing nations from 2000 to 2019. The study uses the Hausman test technique for the reliability of the results. The Main Findings: Our results substantiate that economic misery (a combination of inflation and unemployment) positively and significantly impacts human capital outflow in developing countries. Institutional quality further adds to human capital outflow from developing countries to the rest of the world. Our empirical estimations reveal that economic misery conditional to institutional quality matters in stimulating the outflow of human capital. It contributes positively and statistically significantly in the case of developing countries of the world. Income inequality is also a major contributor to human capital outflow. Theoretical / Practical Implications of the Findings: Revisiting the developing nations' planning is recommended to minimize economic misery and increase institutional quality. Afterwards, the developing nations' financial conditions, trade and institutional quality will be fostered. Originality/Value: The authors are the first to examine how economic misery and conditional institutional quality react to human capital outflow.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了经济苦难（通货膨胀与失业的组合）和制度质量对发展中国家人力资本外流的影响，发现两者都显著正向推动人力资本外流，并建议改善经济状况和制度质量来减少人才外流。
AI.research_question: 经济苦难和制度质量如何影响发展中国家的人力资本外流？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济、货币和财政政策需要可靠的方差估计来最小化经济苦难，而现有研究只考察了经济苦难一个变量对人力资本外流的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以经济苦难理论和人力资本流动理论为基础，重点考察经济苦难（通货膨胀与失业的组合）和制度质量对人力资本外流的关联性。
AI.method: 采用固定效应模型分析68个发展中国家2000-2019年的数据，使用Hausman检验确保结果的可靠性。
AI.findings: 经济苦难对人力资本外流有显著正向影响，制度质量进一步加剧人力资本外流，收入不平等也是重要推动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次综合考察经济苦难和条件性制度质量对人力资本外流的关联效应，丰富了人力资本流动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提供政策建议：重新规划以减少经济苦难、提升制度质量，从而改善金融条件、贸易和制度环境来减少人才外流。

title: An Explicit Expression for the Expectation of a Product of Quadratic Forms in Multivariate Normal Random Variables
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and Nankai University

detail.title: An Explicit Expression for the Expectation of a Product of Quadratic Forms in Multivariate Normal Random Variables
detail.abstract: We present an explicit formula for the expectation of a product of quadratic forms in multivariate real normal random variables. The proposed expression is optimized for zero redundancy, containing the fewest possible terms without repetition. Moreover, the coefficients of all the terms are given in closed form, and we provide an efficient algorithm to enumerate the contributing terms. Our results are further extended to Hermitian quadratic forms in multivariate complex normal random variables. As an application, we show that our formula can be used to obtain a simple expression for the product moments of central and noncentral Wishart distributions. Finally, we derive a general expression that allows for repeated quadratic forms in the product.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多元实正态随机变量中二次型乘积期望的显式公式，该公式具有零冗余性、闭式系数和高效枚举算法，并扩展到复正态随机变量的Hermitian二次型，应用于Wishart分布乘积矩的简化表达。
AI.research_question: 如何推导多元正态随机变量中二次型乘积期望的最优显式表达式？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中关于多元正态随机变量二次型乘积期望的计算方法存在冗余项多、计算复杂度高的问题，需要开发更高效的闭式解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多元正态分布理论和二次型理论，运用组合数学方法构建无冗余的期望表达式框架。
AI.method: 采用组合数学和代数方法推导闭式表达式，开发高效算法枚举贡献项，并扩展到复正态随机变量的Hermitian二次型。
AI.findings: 成功推导出具有最少项数、无重复项的闭式表达式，提供了高效枚举算法，并获得了Wishart分布乘积矩的简化表达式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多元正态随机变量二次型乘积期望的最优闭式解理论框架，扩展了复正态情形的理论结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了计算高效的算法实现，简化了Wishart分布乘积矩的计算，为统计推断和信号处理等应用领域提供了实用工具。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2025/3105
title: Opening the Black Box of Local Projections
affiliations: Université du Québec à Montréal - Département des Sciences Économiques and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Opening the Black Box of Local Projections

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Local projections (LPs) are widely used in empirical macroeconomics to estimate impulse responses to policy interventions. Yet, in many ways, they are black boxes. It is often unclear what mechanism or historical episodes drive a particular estimate. We introduce a new decomposition of LP estimates into the sum of contributions of historical events, which is the product, for each time stamp, of a weight and the realization of the response variable. In the least squares case, we show that these weights admit two interpretations. First, they represent purified and standardized shocks. Second, they serve as proximity scores between the projected policy intervention and past interventions in the sample. Notably, this second interpretation extends naturally to machine learning methods, many of which yield impulse responses that, while nonlinear in predictors, still aggregate past outcomes linearly via proximity-based weights. Applying this framework to shocks in monetary and fiscal policy, global temperature, and the excess bond premium, we find that easily identifiable events—such as Nixon’s interference with the Fed, stagflation, World War II, and the Mount Agung volcanic eruption—emerge as dominant drivers of often heavily concentrated impulse response estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的分解方法，将局部投影估计分解为历史事件贡献的总和，揭示了传统黑箱估计背后的驱动机制和历史事件。
AI.research_question: 如何分解局部投影估计以识别驱动特定估计的历史机制和事件？
AI.motivation: 局部投影在实证宏观经济学中被广泛用于估计政策干预的脉冲响应，但它们往往是黑箱，不清楚什么机制或历史事件驱动特定估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最小二乘法的局部投影框架，提出了历史事件贡献分解的理论基础。
AI.method: 引入新的分解方法，将LP估计分解为每个时间戳的权重和响应变量实现的乘积，权重具有两种解释：纯化和标准化冲击，以及政策干预与样本中过去干预的接近度得分。
AI.findings: 应用于货币和财政政策冲击、全球温度、超额债券溢价等案例，发现易于识别的事件（如尼克松干预美联储、滞胀、二战、阿贡火山喷发）是高度集中的脉冲响应估计的主要驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了局部投影估计的可解释性框架，将机器学习方法与历史事件驱动机制联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了识别关键历史事件对当前估计影响的方法，增强了实证分析的可解释性和透明度。

title: AxiomCortex™: Scientific R&D Report — Bias-Mitigated AI Evaluation for Nearshore Software Engineering Teams
affiliations: TeamStation AI, TeamStation AI, TeamStation AI, TeamStation AI, TeamStation AI and TeamStation AI

detail.title: AxiomCortex™: Scientific R&D Report — Bias-Mitigated AI Evaluation for Nearshore Software Engineering Teams

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors are employees and equity holders of TeamStation, Inc., which designs and operates the Axiom Cortex evaluator described in this paper. The research documents scientific methods for bias-mitigated, calibration-aware evaluation in nearshore software engineering and may benefit TeamStation AI’s nearshore IT staffing services. No author holds paid advisory roles, consulting arrangements, or financial interests in competing technical-assessment providers.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analyzes de-identified operational evaluation records from TeamStation AI’s hiring workflows for software-engineering roles. Candidates received notice that automated evaluation assists the process; processing occurred under published notices and data-processing agreements. No patient/clinical data were used; no experimental interventions were administered; and no protected attributes were inferred. Because the analysis used de-identified, job-related data collected for operational purposes and imposed no experimental treatment, institutional IRB/ethics committee review was not required. Data were minimized and encrypted in transit and at rest. Fairness and accuracy results are reported in aggregate, with practices aligned to applicable compliance regimes (e.g., NYC Local Law 144 AEDT, EU AI Act) where relevant.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received. Research and manuscript preparation were internally sponsored by TeamStation, Inc. (TeamStation AI). The sponsor did not have veto power over analysis or the decision to post this SSRN working paper.

detail.abstract: This report presents Axiom Cortex, a cognitive-and-technical evaluation engine integrated into the TeamStation AI platform for nearshore software engineering. The system measures problem-solving, architecture reasoning, clarity, and cognitive load using behaviorally anchored scoring, Conceptual Fidelity (content over phrasing), and a language-aware Calibration Layer that normalizes ESL/L2 effects. We formalize latent traits for Architectural Instinct, Problem-Solving Agility, Learning Orientation, and Collaboration; specify deterministic aggregation formulas; and define audit-ready metrics: inter-rater reliability, ROC/PR performance, calibration error, and subgroup fairness (adverse-impact ratios and equal-opportunity gaps). Operational controls cover monitoring, drift detection, thresholds, and human oversight, with compliance mappings to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, NYC Local Law 144, and the EU AI Act. For CTOs building nearshore IT staffing programs, Axiom Cortex enables faster, fairer decisions by judging the quality of reasoning rather than surface fluency—cutting false negatives among high-skill ESL talent and improving time-to-impact. Learn more about our bias-aware technical interview evaluation (https://teamstation.dev/technical-interview-evaluation) and our integrated nearshore IT platform (https://teamstation.dev/nearshore-integrated-services) from TeamStation AI (https://teamstation.dev .

AI.tldr: Axiom Cortex是一个集成在TeamStation AI平台中的认知技术评估引擎，通过行为锚定评分、概念保真度和语言校准层来评估软件工程师的问题解决能力、架构推理、清晰度和认知负荷，旨在实现更快速、更公平的近岸IT人才招聘决策。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够公平评估软件工程师认知技术能力，特别是针对ESL/L2人才的评估系统？
AI.motivation: 传统技术面试往往过分关注语言流利度而非实际技术能力，导致高技能ESL人才被误判，需要开发一个能够准确评估技术推理质量而非表面语言能力的评估系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为锚定评分理论、概念保真度理论（内容重于措辞）、语言校准理论，以及架构本能、问题解决敏捷性、学习导向和协作等潜在特质的形式化定义。
AI.method: 采用确定性聚合公式，集成行为锚定评分、概念保真度评估和语言感知校准层，通过监控、漂移检测、阈值设定和人工监督等操作控制机制。
AI.findings: 系统能够减少ESL高技能人才的假阴性错误，提高决策速度和公平性，改善人才到岗后的影响力时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了软件工程师评估的潜在特质理论框架，提出了语言校准和概念保真度的评估方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CTO构建近岸IT人员配置项目提供了实用的评估工具，符合NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001、NYC Local Law 144和EU AI Act等合规要求，实现了审计就绪的度量标准。

reference: []; ECB Working Paper No. 2025/3103
title: Central Bank Communication with Non-experts: Insights from a Randomized Field Experiment
affiliations: European Central Bank and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Central Bank Communication with Non-experts: Insights from a Randomized Field Experiment

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We conducted a randomized field experiment to investigate the impact of direct central bank communication on the monetary policy knowledge and expectations of non-experts. Between 2022 and 2025, at the ECB Visitor Centre, we exposed nearly 5,000 participants from diverse visitor groups to policy briefings, similar to the communication at ECB press conferences. The random assignment of participants to treatment, placebo, or control groups created exogenous variation in the information they received. We implemented a new survey to gain insights into participants’ monetary policy knowledge, as well as their inflation and growth expectations, both before and after the information treatment. This approach enabled us to explore how knowledge and trust influence the economic expectations of nonexperts. Our findings indicate that treated individuals improved their monetary policy knowledge and developed a better understanding of the ECB’s inflation target, which proved to be a key factor in explaining why a substantial share of treated non-experts revised their medium-term inflation expectations, aligning them with the inflation target. However, the improved understanding of monetary policy did not lead to systematic revisions in their economic growth expectations. Removing potential language barriers amplified the effects of direct communication on monetary policy knowledge and individual inflation expectations, confirming the importance of addressing citizens in their native language.

AI.tldr: 通过实验研究证明了欧洲央行直接沟通能够提升非专家的货币政策知识和通胀预期，尤其是对中期通胀预期的影响，但对经济增长预期没有系统性影响。消除语言障碍能增强沟通效果。
AI.research_question: 直接的中央银行沟通如何影响非专家的货币政策知识和经济预期？知识和信任在这一过程中发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 了解中央银行沟通对公众知识和预期的实际影响，以改善货币政策的有效性和可信度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息传播和预期形成理论，探讨沟通平台如何影响非专家的经济理解和预期调整。
AI.method: 随机化田间实验，将近5000名参与者随机分配到处理组、偶助组或对照组，在ECB访客中心进行政策简报。通过前后测识调查测量知识和预期变化。
AI.findings: 处理组在货币政策知识和通胀目标理解方面有显著提升，并且对中期通胀预期进行了调整使其与通胀目标一致。但经济增长预期没有系统性变化。消除语言障碍能增强沟通效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了直接沟通在改善非专家货币政策理解和预期形成中的关键作用，特别是对中期通胀预期的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行提供了具体的沟通策略建议，如重视本土语言沟通以提高效果，帮助政策制定者更有效地传递政策信息。

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w34180
title: Labor and Product Market Power, Endogenous Quality, and the Consolidation of the US Hospital Industry
affiliations: University of Chicago

detail.title: Labor and Product Market Power, Endogenous Quality, and the Consolidation of the US Hospital Industry

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Existing structural analyses of the harmful effects of market consolidation focus on either product or labor markets in isolation, ignoring that product market competitors often compete for workers as well. This paper develops a unified framework for merger evaluation, finding that firms' simultaneous exercise of oligopoly power in the product market and oligopsony power in the labor market amplifies the harm from mergers to both consumers and workers. The model also demonstrates how merger-induced gains in labor market power incentivize firms to reduce product quality, highlighting an additional channel for consumer harm. The model's predictions are tested and quantified in the context of the recent consolidation of the US hospital industry. Linking panel data from several sources on all US hospitals from 1996-2022, a difference-in-differences design is estimated for nearly 150 high-concentration within-market mergers. Hospital mergers significantly reduce patient volume, increase prices, reduce employment, lower wages, and deteriorate quality of care, resulting in higher patient mortality. After recovering the structural parameters, the estimated model replicates observed merger impacts. Counterfactual exercises reveal that ignoring increased labor (product) concentration would lead one to under-predict the harm of mergers to consumers (workers).

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架分析企业并购对产品和劳动力市场的双重影响，发现市场集中度提高会同时损害消费者和工人利益，并降低产品质量。通过对美国医院行业的实证分析验证了模型预测。
AI.research_question: 企业并购如何同时影响产品市场和劳动力市场？并购导致的垄断和买方垄断力量如何相互作用并放大对消费者和工人的损害？
AI.motivation: 现有研究孤立分析产品市场或劳动力市场的并购影响，忽略了企业同时在两个市场行使市场力量的重要现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一框架同时考虑企业在产品市场的垄断力量和在劳动力市场的买方垄断力量，分析并购对价格、工资、就业和质量的综合影响。
AI.method: 构建理论模型并进行实证检验，使用1996-2022年美国医院面板数据，采用双重差分法分析近150个高集中度市场内的并购案例。
AI.findings: 医院并购显著减少患者数量、提高价格、降低就业和工资、恶化护理质量，导致患者死亡率上升。忽略劳动力市场集中度会低估对消费者的损害，忽略产品市场集中度会低估对工人的损害。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出同时分析产品市场和劳动力市场并购影响的统一理论框架，揭示了市场力量在两个市场间的相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断机构提供更全面的并购评估方法，强调需要同时考虑并购对消费者和工人的影响，以及产品质量的潜在下降。

reference: MPI Collective Goods Discussion Paper, No. 2025/14
title: LLM as a Law Professor: Having a Large Language Model Write a Commentary on Freedom of Assembly
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Research on Collective Goods and Max Planck Institute for Research on Collective Goods

detail.title: LLM as a Law Professor: Having a Large Language Model Write a Commentary on Freedom of Assembly

publicationDetails.detailsText: MPI Collective Goods Discussion Paper, No. 2025/14
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Research on Collective Goods Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In many jurisdictions, academia is at the service of legal practice. Law professors write commentaries that summarize the state of the art of doctrine, chiefly of jurisprudence. In the spirit of a proof of concept, using the guarantee of freedom of assembly in the European Convention on Human Rights, we show that this task can be completely outsourced to large language models. Using standard NLP metrics and an LLM as a judge approach, we develop an evaluation pipeline that works without costly human annotation. The commentaries fully written by GPT 4o, Gemini 2.5 flash or Kimi K2 Instruct are on par with their best human written competitor, the Guide provided by the Court itself.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明大型语言模型可以完全替代人类撰写法律评注，在欧盟人权公约集会自由条款的案例中，GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 flash和Kimi K2 Instruct生成的评注质量与欧洲法院官方指南相当
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型能否完全替代人类撰写高质量的法律评注？
AI.motivation: 学术界为法律实践提供服务的需求，特别是撰写总结法律学说现状的评注，传统方法成本高且耗时
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然语言处理评估指标、LLM作为评判者的方法
AI.method: 使用标准NLP指标和LLM作为评判者的评估流程，无需昂贵的人工标注
AI.findings: GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 flash和Kimi K2 Instruct完全由AI撰写的评注质量与最佳人类撰写的竞争对手（欧洲法院提供的指南）相当
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了AI在法律文本生成领域的应用潜力，为法律科技发展提供理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了无需人工标注的自动化评估流程，大幅降低了法律评注撰写的成本和时间

reference: ETUI Research Paper - Working Paper 2025.08
title: How Platformisation is Shaping the Future of Domestic Work. A Mapping of Home Care and Cleaning Platforms in Six EU Countries
affiliations: Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Milano and Catholic University of the Sacred Heart of Milan

detail.title: How Platformisation is Shaping the Future of Domestic Work. A Mapping of Home Care and Cleaning Platforms in Six EU Countries

publicationDetails.journalName: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: One aspect of demographic ageing is the growing demand for domestic and care services. This highlights the increasingly central role of domestic work. The emergence of digital labour platforms in this context represents a significant shift within a sector characterised by informality, weak labour protections and complex social needs. This paper offers a first comparative mapping of home care and cleaning service platforms across six European countries – Denmark, France, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands and Spain – representing different welfare and regulatory systems. The study investigates two questions: (i) Do these platforms contribute to the formalisation of domestic work, or do they risk reinforcing informal practices? (ii) What organisational patterns have emerged across national contexts and how are they shaped by different welfare regimes? By cross-referencing two key dimensions – management of the matching process and regulation of employment relationships – the article develops a fourfold typology of digital platforms: marketplaces, digital agencies, on-demand platforms, and regulated marketplaces. Although all platforms present themselves formally as intermediaries, each type performs this role in distinct ways, with varying implications for employment arrangements and working conditions. Moreover, the findings reveal cross-national variation in terms of the prevalence of digital platforms. Countries characterised by higher public service provision, such as Denmark, have a minimal presence. Beyond national specificities, however, the nature of the service provided – cleaning versus care – constitutes a more salient factor in platform organisational models. The marketplace is more dominant in cleaning services and digital agencies than in care services.

AI.tldr: 本文对欧洲六国家政和护理服务平台进行首次比较研究，发现平台类型分为市场平台、数字中介、按需平台和监管市场四类，不同服务类型（清洁vs护理）对平台组织模式的影响比国家福利制度差异更显著。
AI.research_question: 1) 这些平台是促进家政工作正规化还是强化非正规实践？2) 在不同国家背景下出现了哪些组织模式，这些模式如何受到不同福利制度的影响？
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化导致家政和护理服务需求增长，数字劳动平台在这一非正规化、劳动保护薄弱且社会需求复杂的部门中带来了重大变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于福利制度和监管体系差异的比较框架，重点关注平台作为中介角色的不同表现形式。
AI.method: 对丹麦、法国、爱尔兰、意大利、荷兰和西班牙六个欧洲国家的家政和护理服务平台进行比较映射分析。
AI.findings: 平台可分为四类：市场平台、数字中介、按需平台和监管市场；公共服务提供水平高的国家（如丹麦）平台存在较少；服务类型（清洁vs护理）比国家差异对平台组织模式影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了数字平台的四重分类学，揭示了平台作为中介角色的不同实现方式及其对就业安排和工作条件的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解不同平台模式对家政工作正规化影响的框架，有助于制定更有效的劳动保护政策。

title: Incentive Design under Probabilistic Preference Congruence: A Note on Exercise 3.10 from The Theory of Corporate Finance by J.Tirole

detail.title: Incentive Design under Probabilistic Preference Congruence: A Note on Exercise 3.10 from The Theory of Corporate Finance by J.Tirole
detail.abstract: This note explores optimal incentive design when the congruence of preferences between entrepreneur and investor is uncertain ex ante, as formulated in Exercise 3.10 of Tirole (2006). We study a fixed investment model with moral hazard, where the entrepreneur privately learns whether their preferences are congruent (aligned) or dissonant (misaligned) with the investor's before exerting effort. We show that (i) the optimal power of the incentive scheme increases with the probability of dissonance, and (ii) introducing a menu of contracts after observing the preference type does not improve pledgeable income due to self-selection constraints. The results provide theoretical support for simple contractual forms often observed in startup and venture debt financing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业家与投资者偏好一致性不确定时的最优激励设计，发现激励强度随偏好不一致概率增加而增强，且菜单式合同无法改善可抵押收入。
AI.research_question: 在企业家与投资者偏好一致性不确定的情况下，如何设计最优激励方案？

detail.title: Environmental Reputation Risk and the Cost of Equity: The Impact of Corporate Response to Climate Change Exposures
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of environmental and climate change reputation risk on the cost of equity, emphasising the role of financial analysts’ perceptions of corporate responses to climate change exposures. We find that reputational risk measured by environmental misconduct is positively associated with a higher cost of equity. However, firms that adopt a proactive approach to climate change, demonstrated by positive attitudes in earnings conference calls, experience lower equity costs following environmental misconduct. Conversely, negative corporate attitudes toward climate risks increase the equity costs. The mediating effect of corporate attention on climate change exposures arises through its influence on analysts’ earnings forecasts revisions. These results highlight the importance of proactive corporate engagement with environmental and climate risks in shaping investor perceptions and financial outcomes.

detail.title: Details matter: Loan pricing and transmission of monetary policy in the euro area

publicationDetails.journalName: Deutsche Bundesbank Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Does the maturity of the relevant risk-free rate influence the strength of monetary policy pass-through to interest rates on new loans? To address this question, we present novel empirical evidence on lending practices across all euro area countries, using AnaCredit data covering nearly seven million new loans issued to non-financial corporations in 2022–2023. We document substantial variation in (a) the prevalence of fixed- vs floating-rate loans, (b) rate fixation periods, and (c) reference rates. This variation results in lending rates being exposed to different segments of the risk-free rate yield curve which, in turn, influence their sensitivity to monetary policy changes. We show that loans linked to shorter-maturity risk-free rates experience more pronounced monetary pass-through. Importantly, this effect is not purely mechanical, as part of the effect is offset by adjustments in the premium, revealing previously less-explored heterogeneity in the pass-through to lending rates.

detail.title: Portfolio Overlap and Mutual Fund Performance.
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the cross-sectional distribution of performance among actively managed equity mutual funds and highlights a novel investment characteristics of successful funds based on the degree to which their holdings do not overlap with those of other funds. We find that our measure of portfolio overlap strongly predicts funds' future extra performance across various time horizons and is related to managers' skills to i) buy(sell) undervalued(overvalued) stocks, ii) select securities that outperform characteristic-based benchmark portfolios, and iii) time different investment styles effectively. Our findings also indicate that fund management structure, such as turnover and team size, strongly impacts portfolio decisions.

detail.abstract: This paper challenges the dominant ‘infrastructure gap’ narrative by reframing infrastructure investment in Africa as a layered phenomenon rather than a shortage. Grounded in complexity science and social physics, it treats infrastructure not as an asset or input but as an operator on the evolving field of State, Market, and Society. In the inner layer, infrastructure reconfigures institutions and trajectories in nonlinear ways, beyond the reach of cost–benefit analysis. In the middle layer, patterns such as scaling laws and investment ratios reveal systemic signatures. Gross Fixed Capital Formation as a share of GDP highlights divergences between national ecosystems, inviting a reading of infrastructure as participation in transformation rather than quantity alone. In the outer layer, conventional tools can serve policy only when calibrated to structural dynamics and limits. Together the layers yield a coherent framework that resists mimicry, honours history, and attends to resonance over replication. Infrastructure becomes transformation, not expenditure.

title: How Tether Depegging Affects Cryptocurrency Returns
affiliations: Macquarie University, Macquarie University and Macquarie University - Department of Actuarial Studies and Business Analytics

detail.title: How Tether Depegging Affects Cryptocurrency Returns
detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between Tether depegging events and the returns of ten major cryptocurrencies from November 2017 to November 2024. We distinguish between upward and downward deviations from the Tether peg, identifying these events as threshold exceedances based on historical prices, using both constant parameter and rolling-window frameworks. Our results show that downward depegging events lead to immediate declines in cryptocurrency returns, with the impact typically increasing in severity as the deviation grows. Upward depegging events are also associated with negative effects. Lagged analysis shows that severe downward depegging is often followed by a partial recovery the next day, while lead effects are generally weak, except in cases of large negative depegging. This suggests that markets may begin to price in concerns about Tether's stability ahead of depegging events.
