title: CEO Personality Traits and Relationship-Specific Investments in Supply Chain Relationships
affiliations: Yeshiva University - Syms School of Business, University of Maryland - Department of Accounting & Information Assurance, University of Maryland-College Park - Robert H. Smith School of Business and University of Maryland, College Park

detail.title: CEO Personality Traits and Relationship-Specific Investments in Supply Chain Relationships
detail.abstract: Transaction cost economics (TCE) predicts that asset specificity exposes suppliers to opportunism, but it largely treats buyer behavior as uniform. We propose that the personality of the customer's CEO shapes suppliers' perceptions of opportunism risk and, in turn, their willingness to make relationship-specific investments. Using CEO turnovers at customer firms as quasi-exogenous shocks, we link pre-constructed Big Five personality scores from unscripted earnings call Q&A to suppliers' R&D alignment in a difference-indifferences design. We find that incoming CEOs lower in openness, agreeableness, or extraversion lead suppliers to reduce alignment, whereas lower neuroticism (i.e., greater emotional stability) increases it. These effects are amplified when customers are less dominant in the dyad, as captured by relative size or sales. We also find that personality predicts relational structure, with more extraverted, open, and conscientious CEOs fostering longer, more extensive supplier ties. Our findings enrich TCE by incorporating behavioral heterogeneity in leaders and extend upper-echelons theory to interfirm coordination under contractual incompleteness.

detail.abstract: This report presents Axiom Cortex, a cognitive-and-technical evaluation engine integrated into the TeamStation AI platform for nearshore software engineering. The system measures problem-solving, architecture reasoning, clarity, and cognitive load using behaviorally anchored scoring, Conceptual Fidelity (content over phrasing), and a language-aware Calibration Layer that normalizes ESL/L2 effects. We formalize latent traits for Architectural Instinct, Problem-Solving Agility, Learning Orientation, and Collaboration; specify deterministic aggregation formulas; and define audit-ready metrics: inter-rater reliability, ROC/PR performance, calibration error, and subgroup fairness (adverse-impact ratios and equal-opportunity gaps). Operational controls cover monitoring, drift detection, thresholds, and human oversight, with compliance mappings to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, NYC Local Law 144, and the EU AI Act. For CTOs building nearshore IT staffing programs, Axiom Cortex enables faster, fairer decisions by judging the quality of reasoning rather than surface fluency—cutting false negatives among high-skill ESL talent and improving time-to-impact. Learn more about our bias-aware technical interview evaluation (https://teamstation.dev/technical-interview-evaluation) and our integrated nearshore IT platform (https://teamstation.dev/nearshore-integrated-services) from TeamStation AI (https://teamstation.dev

AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够公平评估近岸软件工程师认知技术能力，同时减少语言偏见影响的AI评估系统？
AI.motivation: 传统技术面试中，非英语母语者(ESL/L2)常因语言表达问题而被低估技术能力，导致高质量人才流失。需要开发一个能够评估实质技术推理能力而非表面语言流利度的评估系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为锚定评分理论、概念保真度理论(注重内容而非措辞)、语言校准理论(标准化ESL/L2影响)，以及潜在特质理论(架构本能、问题解决敏捷性、学习导向、协作能力)。
AI.method: 开发集成评估引擎，采用确定性聚合公式，包含校准层来标准化语言差异，使用行为锚定评分和概念保真度评估方法。
AI.findings: 系统能够有效减少ESL/L2人才评估中的假阴性错误，提高评估的公平性和准确性，缩短人才到岗后的影响时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了软件工程师的潜在认知特质评估框架，提出了语言校准和概念保真度的理论模型，为AI驱动的公平评估提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CTO提供了快速、公平的近岸IT人员招聘决策工具，符合NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001、NYC Local Law 144和欧盟AI法案等合规要求，包含监控、漂移检测和人工监督等操作控制机制。

title: Caste And Occupational Identity In Large Language Models
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management (IIMB), Bangalore and Indian Institute of Management (IIMB), Bangalore

detail.title: Caste And Occupational Identity In Large Language Models

publicationDetails.journalName: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: A large body of scholarship has documented evidence of racial and gender biases in large language models (LLMs). In this work, we examine three types of LLM biases in the context of caste and occupational identity in India through five studies. Our studies cover a comprehensive set of occupations in India and test for bias across all of India's districts. Our results provide four key insights. First, we find representation bias such that individuals from marginalized caste groups are significantly under-represented in LLM output compared to their share in India's working population. This potentially reflects India's digital divide. Second, corrective measures to increase representation introduce other sources of errors. Corrective measures can also lead to association bias where marginalized castes are linked to occupations that require lower education levels and provide lower pay. Third, the models also demonstrate selection bias with a higher probability of shortlisting resumes with names from dominant caste groups. Finally, we propose a training approach by which selection bias can be reduced in LLM shortlisting. Our work is highly relevant at a time when generative AI is becoming increasingly important in recruitment and hiring processes as a cost-saving measure.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过五项实验分析了印度种姓和职业身份背景下的大型语言模型偏见，发现了代表性偏见、关联偏见和选择偏见三种偏见类型，并提出了一种减少选择偏见的训练方法。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在印度种姓和职业身份背景下存在哪些类型的偏见？这些偏见如何影响模型输出？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在招聘过程中越来越重要，但已有研究显示LLMs存在种族和性别偏见，需要研究其在印度种姓制度背景下的偏见问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于偏见理论框架，分析LLMs在印度社会结构中的三种偏见类型：代表性偏见、关联偏见和选择偏见。
AI.method: 通过五项实验研究，覆盖印度所有地区的全面职业集合，测试模型在整个印度的偏见表现。
AI.findings: 1) 边缘种姓群体在LLM输出中代表性不足；2) 纠正措施会引入其他错误并导致关联偏见；3) 模型存在选择偏见，更倾向于选择主导种姓的简历；4) 提出了减少选择偏见的训练方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了LLM偏见研究到种姓制度背景，提出了三种具体的偏见类型及其相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为减少招聘过程中的AI偏见提供了具体训练方法，对印度及其他类似社会结构的国家具有重要实践意义。

title: Digital Transformation, Supply Chain Integration, and Supply Chain Performance: A Bibliometric Analysis of Global Research Trends (2010–2025)
affiliations: Accra Technical University, Accra Technical University, Accra Technical University, Accra Technical University, Accra Technical University and Accra Technical University

detail.title: Digital Transformation, Supply Chain Integration, and Supply Chain Performance: A Bibliometric Analysis of Global Research Trends (2010–2025)
detail.abstract: Digital transformation (DT) technologies are redefining supply chains, intensifying scholarly focus on how supply chain integration (SCI) drives supply chain performance (SCP). Despite extensive research on DT, SCI, and SCP individually, systematic evidence on their intellectual evolution, thematic trends, and global collaborations remains scarce.Although DT, SCI, and SCP have been studied individually, consolidated evidence on their intellectual evolution, research hotspots, and collaboration patterns remains limited. This study conducts a bibliometric analysis of over 6,000 peer-reviewed publications indexed in Scopus (2010–2025) using the Bibliometrix R package. It examines trends in publications, journals, countries, institutions, authors, citations, and keyword co-occurrences. Results reveal sharp growth in research output, with turning points linked to Industry 4.0 (post-2014), blockchain and IoT (2016–2019), and the COVID-19 pandemic (2020–2021). Digital twins, and machine learning. The analysis confirms the field’s multidisciplinary nature, spanning management, operations research, engineering, and information systems. Key sources include Sustainability (Switzerland), IEEE Access, and the IEEE Internet of Things Journal, while leading scholars such as Dmitry Ivanov, Sarkis, and Govindan shape the discourse. Influential works highlight big data analytics, blockchain, and digital twins as pivotal in linking integration with performance. Keyword clustering identifies three main streams: technology-driven integration, sustainability-oriented supply chains, and resilience-focused systems. Theoretically, the study frames DT–SCI–SCP research through Resource Orchestration Theory, Dynamic Capabilities, and Legitimacy Theory. Practically, it guides managers to align digital investments with integration, sustainability, and resilience. Limitations include reliance on Scopus, language bias, and bibliometric indicators. Future research should broaden regional scope and address ethical governance and cybersecurity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对6000余篇Scopus论文的文献计量分析，探索了数字化转型技术、供应链整合和供应链表现之间的关系进化路径、研究热点和全球合作模式，为管理者提供了理论框架和实践指南。
AI.research_question: 数字化转型技术如何通过供应链整合影响供应链表现？该领域的知识进化、主题趋势和全球合作模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 虽然数字化转型、供应链整合和供应链表现已分别有深入研究，但缺乏对三者关联性的系统性识别和知识进化分析，需要通过文献计量方法揭示该领域的研究轮廓和发展趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源组织理论(Resource Orchestration Theory)、动态能力理论(Dynamic Capabilities)、合法性理论(Legitimacy Theory)
AI.method: 库字计量分析(Bibliometric Analysis)，使用Bibliometrix R包分析Scopus数据库中2010-2025年间的6000余篇同行审查论文
AI.findings: 研究输出快速增长，关键转折点包括工业4.0(2014年后)、区块链和物联网(2016-2019)、COVID-19大流行(2020-2021)。关键技术包括数字双胞生和机器学习。关键词聚类确定三个主要流派：技术驱动的整合、可持续性导向的供应链、弹性聚焦系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了基于资源组织理论、动态能力理论和合法性理论的DT-SCI-SCP研究理论框架，为理论发展提供了结构性指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了将数字投资与整合、可持续性和弹性相结合的实践指南，帮助企业更有效地管理数字化转型过程。

detail.abstract: The current organizational structure of the company appears to be hierarchical, with clear divisions between different departments such as engineering, marketing, production, and sales. While this structure might be effective in maintaining day-to-day operations and ensuring efficiency, it might hinder innovation. The siloed nature of departments can result in limited collaboration and communication between teams, making it difficult to share ideas and integrate new technologies seamlessly.

affiliations: UCLA School of Law - UCLA School of Law and UCLA School of Law - UCLA School of Law

detail.title: The Cleanest Water and the Dumbest Kids: Do Small Water Systems Comply with the Safe Drinking Water Act?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

publicationDetails.detailsText: UCLA School of Law, Public Law Research Paper No. 25-36
publicationDetails.journalName: University of California, Los Angeles School of Law, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
When students are first introduced to the dominant federal legislation for tap water, the Safe Drinking Water Act of 1974 (SDWA), two things often stand out. The first is that SDWA is a technically complex statute. It establishes water standards for over 100 contaminants. The second is the huge number of water systems that are regulated. There are over 150,000public water systems scattered throughout the country. The vast majority of these public water systems (PWSs) are very small. So here’s the problem. Is it realistic to expect small PWSs to comply with SDWA’s highly technical requirements? Is it likely that the 120,000 PWSs with little funding and limited staffing are all in compliance with all the drinking water standards? At face value, it seems the answer has to be, “No and No.” 

This article provides the first comprehensive law review analysis of small PWSs and their compliance with SDWA. These small systems face steep technical, managerial, and financial barriers to meeting SDWA’s complex standards. Drawing on over two decades of public health, law, and policy scholarship, the article examines persistent patterns of noncompliance, especially in monitoring and reporting, and highlights how challenges are compounded in disadvantaged, rural, and minority communities. It reviews policy responses—including funding programs, variances, consolidation, and privatization—and assesses their limitations in addressing systemic shortfalls. With the recent adoption of stringent standards for PFAS “forever chemicals,” the burdens on small systems are poised to intensify.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面分析了小型公共供水系统在《安全饮用水法案》下的合规困境，指出小型系统面临技术、管理和财务三重障碍，特别是在弱势农村和少数族裔社区，并评估了现有政策应对措施的局限性。
AI.research_question: 小型公共供水系统是否能够切实遵守《安全饮用水法案》的复杂技术要求？现有政策应对措施在解决系统性缺陷方面存在哪些局限性？
AI.motivation: 《安全饮用水法案》监管超过15万个公共供水系统，其中绝大多数是小型系统，这些系统资金有限、人员配备不足，面临巨大的合规挑战，特别是在新污染物标准不断增加的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共健康、法律和政策研究的理论框架，分析技术复杂性、资源约束与监管合规之间的关系，特别关注环境正义和弱势社区问题。
AI.method: 文献综述法，综合过去二十多年的公共健康、法律和政策学术研究成果，进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 小型供水系统在监测和报告方面存在持续不合规模式，技术、管理和财务障碍相互叠加，在弱势农村和少数族裔社区问题尤为严重。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供全面的法律评论分析，建立了小型供水系统合规问题的理论分析框架，丰富了环境监管与资源约束关系的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了系统性解决方案评估，指出了现有资助项目、差异化管理、整合和私有化等措施的局限性，为应对PFAS等新污染物标准的挑战提供参考。

title: From Model Choice to Model Belief: Establishing a New Measure for LLM-Based Research
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: From Model Choice to Model Belief: Establishing a New Measure for LLM-Based Research

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: There are no human participants in this article and informed consent is not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors report no external funding or grant support for this work.

detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior, but common practices to use LLM-generated data are inefficient. Treating an LLM's output ("model choice") as a single data point underutilizes the information inherent to the probabilistic nature of LLMs. This paper introduces and formalizes "model belief," a measure derived from an LLM's token-level probabilities that captures the model's belief distribution over choice alternatives in a single generation run. The authors prove that model belief is asymptotically equivalent to the mean of model choices (a non-trivial property) but forms a more statistically efficient estimator, with lower variance and a faster convergence rate. Analogous properties are shown to hold for smooth functions of model belief and model choice often used in downstream applications. The authors demonstrate the performance of model belief through a demand estimation study, where an LLM simulates consumer responses to different prices. In practical settings with limited numbers of runs, model belief explains and predicts ground-truth model choice better than model choice itself, and reduces the computation needed to reach sufficiently accurate estimates by roughly a factor of 20. The findings support using model belief as the default measure to extract more information from LLM-generated data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"模型信念"的概念，通过利用LLM的token级概率分布来更高效地提取信息，相比传统的"模型选择"方法，在统计效率和计算成本方面都有显著提升。
AI.research_question: 如何更有效地利用大语言模型生成的数据？如何通过LLM的概率分布特性来提升模拟人类行为的统计效率？
AI.motivation: 当前使用LLM生成数据的方法效率低下，仅将模型输出作为单个数据点使用，未能充分利用LLM的概率特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大语言模型的概率生成机制，提出模型信念的概念，建立其与模型选择均值的渐近等价性理论。
AI.method: 理论证明模型信念的统计性质，并通过需求估计实证研究验证其性能，比较模型信念与模型选择在预测准确性和计算效率方面的差异。
AI.findings: 模型信念在有限运行次数下能更好地解释和预测真实模型选择，计算效率提升约20倍，是更有效的统计估计量。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化定义了模型信念概念，证明了其渐近等价性和统计效率优势，为LLM数据利用提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了更高效的LLM数据提取方法，显著降低计算成本，为实际应用中的需求估计等场景提供实用工具。

title: Is There a Job Mobility Paradox in Travel Industry with Covid-19 Pandemic; Leaving or Bearing?
affiliations: Uva Wellassa University, Uva Wellassa University and Uva Wellassa University

detail.title: Is There a Job Mobility Paradox in Travel Industry with Covid-19 Pandemic; Leaving or Bearing?
detail.abstract: Travel agencies play a premium role in the Sri Lankan tourism industry generating a significant contribution in the country's economy, particularly the employment and foreign exchange earnings. The current outbreak of COVID-19 pandemic affected badly, creating severe affects for many sectors around the world, mainly for travel and tourism industry. It has completely malformed the human life. The fear of traveling, travelling restrictions, need of maintaining social distance has challenged the travel behavior of tourists. However, this pandemic has risked around 50 million of jobs globally in tourism sector including downsizing in employments of 12% to 14% in all sectors in travel and tourism industry. Moreover, the employees in the travel and tourism sector are uncertain about their future; some of them have already shifted for alternative income sources. Hence, this study was expected to investigate the impact of COVID-19 pandemic on the employment and employee's intention on continuation in the travel sector. Consequently, qualitative research approach was used. A sample of ten executive level employees was interviewed from ten travel agencies registered in Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority. Convenience sampling technique was used in the study due to the difficulties to reach the employees since they are not operating yet. Thematic analysis derived under phenomenological research design was used to achieve the objective of this research. According to the results, majority of employees have lost their jobs due to pandemic, and salaries were reduced. As a result, the income, social life, experience and family life were severely affected with COVID-19 pandemic; however, few of them used this pandemic as an opportunity to advance their own interests.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了COVID-19疫情对斯里兰卡旅行社行业就业的影响，发现大多数员工因疫情失业或降薪，收入、社交生活和家庭生活受到严重影响，但少数人将其视为发展机会。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情对旅行社行业就业和员工留任意向的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 疫情严重冲击全球旅游业，导致约5000万个工作岗位面临风险，斯里兰卡旅游业员工对未来不确定，部分已转向其他收入来源，需要研究疫情对就业的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用现象学研究设计，基于定性研究方法探讨疫情对旅游业就业的深层次影响。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，对10家斯里兰卡旅游局注册旅行社的10名高管进行访谈，采用便利抽样和主题分析。
AI.findings: 大多数员工因疫情失业或降薪，收入、社交生活、工作经验和家庭生活受到严重影响；少数员工将疫情视为发展个人利益的机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了危机情境下旅游业人力资源管理理论，为突发公共卫生事件对就业影响的研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅行社行业制定疫情应对策略提供参考，帮助企业和政策制定者更好地支持受影响员工，促进旅游业复苏。

title: Dialysis Clinic Patient Flow and Work Design
affiliations: Cornell University and University of Toronto at Scarborough - Division of Management

detail.title: Dialysis Clinic Patient Flow and Work Design
detail.abstract:
For 467,000 patients in the United States with advanced kidney failure, hemodialysis is a life-sustaining treatment. Approximately 7,600 outpatient dialysis clinics serve these patients, whose treatment costs over $25 billion annually. Each treatment involves a pre-treatment "put-on" task and a post-treatment "take-off" task performed by patient care technicians (PCTs). These frontline workers face intense, overlapping demands that can compromise patient safetyespecially infection control-and contribute to PCT burnout. We study how to jointly schedule PCTs and patients to reduce makespan and increase labor efficiency in dialysis clinic operations.

We first analyze the prevailing "push" approach, which starts put-on tasks for treatment as soon as a station is free. We then propose two alternatives: an "interlaced" scheme that staggers put-ons and takeoffs to reduce idle time, and a "tandem" scheme that pairs two PCTs-one specializing in put-ons, the other in takeoffs across twice as many stations. Under standard conditions, we derive closed-form expressions for each approach's completion time and show that interlacing finishes earliest with homogeneous treatment durations, while tandem configurations can lower labor per patient. We also incorporate heterogeneous treatment durations to show numerically that our insights are robust.

In contrast to the push-focused approach, these insights direct facility administrators' attention to what is most important for labor efficiency: minimizing the time that a station is unoccupied between successive patients. Due to the inefficiencies associated with the push approach, transitioning to an interlaced or tandem system with increased standard task times can alleviate workplace stress and promote patient safety without increasing labor costs. Specifically, dialysis clinic managers could move from the common 15/15-minute put-on/take-off scheduling standard to a 25/20-minute standard, thereby allotting PCTs 50% more time to complete tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究血液透析诊所中如何通过改进患者护理技师（PCT）和患者的联合调度来减少总完成时间、提高劳动效率，提出了交错调度和串联调度两种替代方案，可在不增加劳动力成本的情况下为PCT提供更多操作时间，改善工作压力和患者安全。

AI.motivation: 美国有467,000名晚期肾衰竭患者依赖血液透析维持生命，年治疗费用超过250亿美元。PCT面临高强度、重叠的工作需求，可能危及患者安全（特别是感染控制）并导致职业倦怠。
AI.theoretical_framework: 作业调度理论，特别是医疗环境中的资源调度和排队理论，关注最小化工作站空闲时间和最大化劳动效率。
AI.method: 分析现有的"推送"方法，提出两种替代方案："交错"调度（错开上下机时间）和"串联"调度（两名PCT专业化分工）。在标准条件下推导闭式表达式，并考虑异质治疗时间进行数值分析。
AI.findings: 交错调度在同质治疗时间下完成最早，串联配置可以降低单患者劳动力成本。研究见解对异质治疗时间也具有稳健性。

AI.practical_contributions: 指导诊所管理者关注工作站空闲时间最小化，建议从15/15分钟标准转向25/20分钟标准，为PCT提供50%更多操作时间，在不增加成本的情况下改善工作条件和患者安全。

As known based on the communications, the theme park is scheduled to reopen in two weeks. However, the business intelligence unit has recently noticed a surge of negative opinions among the consumers. This is evident on the social media platforms and other digital media platforms. A major cause of concern is that the organization’s ethics are being questioned in most of these negative opinions.

publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this paper we present the results of experiments and computational analyses of trading in decentralized markets with asymmetric information. We consider three trading configurations, namely the ring, the small-world, and the Erdös-Rényi random network, which allow us to introduce heterogeneity in nodes degree, centrality and clustering, while keeping the number of possible trading relationships fixed. We analyze how the prices of a traded risky asset and the profits of differently informed traders are affected by the distribution of the trading links, and by the location of the traders in the network. This allows us to infer key features in the dynamics of learning and information diffusion through the market. Experimental results show that learning is enhanced locally by clustering rather than degree, pointing to a learning dynamic driven by interdependent, successive trading events, rather than independent exposures to informed traders. By calibrating a behavioural agent-based model to the experimental data we are able to estimate the speed at which agents learn and to locate where information accumulates in the market. Interestingly, simulations indicate that proximity to the insiders leads to more information in regular networks but not so in random networks.

AI.findings: 1) 聚类比节点度数更能增强局部学习；2) 学习动态由相互依赖的连续交易事件驱动；3) 规则网络中靠近内部交易者的位置信息积累更多，但随机网络中不明显。

detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly tools such as Chat GPT and emerging forms of super intelligence, is transforming human-computer interaction and reshaping the future of work. This study aims to explore whether gender-based differences exist in perceptions of these technological shifts. Specifically, the research examines respondents' views across six key constructs: Knowledge Access, Redefining Roles and Skills, Legal Research, Data Privacy, Software Development, and Augmented Productivity. The non-parametric Mann-Whitney U test was applied to assess statistically significant differences in perceptions based on gender. The findings indicate that for most constructs-including Knowledge Access (p = .327), Redefining Roles and Skills (p = .433), Legal Research (p = .756), Software Development (p = .227), and Augmented Productivity (p = .632)-there were no statistically significant differences in perception between male and female respondents. This suggests a general consensus across genders in recognizing the transformative potential of AI in these domains. However, a significant difference was observed in the Data Privacy construct (p = .025), indicating that gender influences how data privacy issues in AI applications are perceived. Female respondents reported slightly higher concerns compared to their male counterparts. The results support the conclusion that while gender does not significantly affect perceptions of AI in most work-related areas, it does play a role in shaping concerns around data privacy. These insights are valuable for developers, policymakers, and educators working to promote equitable and inclusive AI integration in professional settings. Understanding gender-specific concerns-especially in sensitive areas such as data privacy-can help tailor strategies for responsible AI adoption and ensure that technological advancements align with diverse user expectations and ethical standards. Further research is recommended to explore the underlying factors contributing to these gendered perceptions.

detail.title: Benchmark: Skunk Works
detail.abstract:
The organization from the course scenario has a traditional hierarchical structure. This means that there is a clear chain of command, with each employee reporting to a manager. This structure can be effective for tasks that are well-defined and predictable. However, it can be less effective for innovation, which often requires cross-functional collaboration and risk-taking.

Skunk Works, on the other hand, has a flatter structure. This means that there are fewer layers of management, and employees are encouraged to work together across functions. This structure can be more effective for innovation, as it allows for faster decision-making and more flexibility.

AI.tldr: 传统层级组织结构适合定义明确的可预测任务，但不利于创新；Skunk Works的扁平结构通过减少管理层级和促进跨职能协作，更适合创新和快速决策。

title: Buy Now, Regret Later"? A Review Of Instant Gratification And Post Purchase Dissonance In E-Commerce
affiliations: Maharaja Surajmal Institute, Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies, , Delhi School of Business and Amity University Uttar Pradesh, India - Amity School of Business

detail.title: Buy Now, Regret Later"? A Review Of Instant Gratification And Post Purchase Dissonance In E-Commerce
detail.abstract: By including immediate gratification as a main motivator for online purchases, the fast growth of e-commerce has changed consumer behavior. This review looks at the psychological processes behind impulsive buying behavior and post-purchase dissonance-two connected phenomena becoming more and more common in digital markets. Driven by dopamine release and reinforced by persuasive UX/UI design, scarcity cues, and AI-powered personalization, instant gratification promotes fast decision-making by reducing cognitive friction. These actions are amplified by social commerce, influencer marketing, and gamified shopping venues that use FOMO-fear of missing out-and social validation systems. But the very elements that promote instant purchases also cause increased post-purchase conflict, a state of regret or dissatisfaction brought on by unmet expectations. Based on Festinger's Cognitive Dissonance Theory, this review looks at personal, product-related, contextual, and technical influences that exacerbate this emotional fallout, including price sensitivity, product complexity, urgency cues, and social pressures. The study reveals how gender, cultural norms, and social support networks affect the severity of regret, therefore influencing consumer reactions including returns, complaints, and bad reviews. Ecommerce systems use a dual strategy-maximizing conversions through urgency and personalization, while minimizing regret through clear return policies, proactive customer support, and loyalty programs. However, current research reveals critical gaps, including the lack of longitudinal studies on gratification-regret cycles, limited exploration of personality-technology interaction effects, insufficient understanding of emotional recovery post-return, and minimal attention to the ethics of persuasive digital design. This review provides a conceptual model for striking a balance between profit-driven urgency and consumer psychological well-being by combining ideas from behavioral economics, neuroscience, and digital marketing. The results ask e-commerce participants to implement design and policy measures that maintain consumer happiness beyond the point of sale, hence developing ethical, sustainable, and trust-based digital economy..

AI.theoretical_framework: 以Festinger的认知瞬间理论为核心，结合多巴胞释放机制、诱导性UX/UI设计、稀缺符号、AI个性化推荐等理论，构建了一个多层次的理论分析框架。

AI.findings: 即时满足通过多巴胞释放和认知摩擦减少促进快速决策；社交商务、网红营销和游戏化购物场景放大了FOMO和社交认可效应；价格敏感度、产品复杂性、紧急符号和社交压力等因素加剧购后瞬间；性别、文化规范和社交支持网络影响后悔严重程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统合行为经济学、神经科学和数字营销的概念模型，为理解数字化购物环境下消费者心理机制提供了新的理论视角，完善了认知瞬间理论在数字中地时代的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子商务参与者提供了平衡业务转化与消费者心理健康的实践建议，包括明确的退换货政策、主动的客服支持和忠诚度计划，以及请求关注诱导性数字设计的伦理问题，促进可持续、以信任为基础的数字经济发展。

detail.abstract: Emergency Medical Services (EMS) is a life-saving entity, but the population density in the rural setting is often low, which is accompanied by a lack of infrastructure and geographic isolation. The present paper discusses the potential possibilities of such a development; how Location Intelligence (LI), the process of utilizing geospatial data and analytics might be used to streamline the effective response time of EMS in a rural community. Making a usage of Geographic Information Systems (GIS), up-to-date traffic rates, population dispersion, and past experiences with emergency response, the research learns about spatial patterns as well as pinch points that compromise the functioning of the EMS. To model the best locations of the ambulance stations, in order to leverage areas of high risk and other areas as alternatives to achieve their optimal locational strategies regarding high priorities, the datadriven approach to modeling is adopted. Finding indicates the implementation of LI tools may help decrease the time of response on average by the rearrangement of EMS resources in a strategic manner while enhancing directions in routes. The results highlight the revolutionary nature of geospatial analytics when it comes to maximizing the effectiveness of healthcare delivery in rural areas, and can be used by the policymakers, EMS planners, and public health actors interested in refining the outcomes of emergency response in low-income regions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何利用位置智能（LI）和地理信息系统（GIS）优化农村地区紧急医疗服务（EMS）的响应时间，通过数据驱动的方法重新规划救护车站点布局，平均可减少响应时间。
AI.research_question: 如何利用位置智能和地理空间数据分析来优化农村地区紧急医疗服务的响应效率？
AI.motivation: 农村地区人口密度低、基础设施缺乏和地理隔离导致EMS响应时间较长，需要寻找技术解决方案来改善这一状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于位置智能理论、地理信息系统理论和空间分析理论，结合人口分布、交通流量和历史应急响应数据。
AI.method: 采用数据驱动建模方法，利用GIS分析地理空间数据、实时交通数据、人口分布模式和历史应急响应经验，识别空间模式和瓶颈点。
AI.findings: 通过战略性重新配置EMS资源，位置智能工具的实施可以平均减少响应时间，同时优化路线导航。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了位置智能在医疗应急服务领域的应用理论，为农村地区医疗服务优化提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、EMS规划者和公共卫生机构提供了具体的数据驱动决策工具，可改善低收入地区应急响应效果，提升农村医疗服务质量。

title: Precision Without Labels: Detecting Cross-Applicants in Mortgage Data Using Unsupervised Learning
affiliations: Stanford University, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: Precision Without Labels: Detecting Cross-Applicants in Mortgage Data Using Unsupervised Learning

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-25
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop a clustering-based algorithm to detect loan applicants who submit multiple applications (“cross-applicants”) in a loan-level dataset without personal identifiers. A key innovation of our approach is a novel evaluation method that does not require labeled training data, allowing us to optimize the tuning parameters of our machine learning algorithm. By applying this methodology to Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) data, we create a unique dataset that consolidates mortgage applications to the individual applicant level across the United States. Our preferred specification identifies cross-applicants with 92.3% precision.

AI.tldr: 开发了一种基于聚类的算法，用于在没有个人标识符的贷款数据中检测提交多个申请的"交叉申请人"，并提出了无需标注训练数据的新评估方法，在HMDA抵押贷款数据中实现了92.3%的精确度
AI.research_question: 如何在缺乏个人标识符的贷款数据中准确识别提交多个抵押贷款申请的交叉申请人
AI.motivation: 传统方法需要个人标识信息来识别重复申请人，但在匿名化数据中无法使用，需要开发新的无监督检测方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于聚类分析的机器学习理论，结合无监督学习中的相似度度量和分组技术
AI.method: 开发基于聚类的算法，使用新颖的无标签评估方法优化机器学习调参，应用于HMDA抵押贷款数据
AI.findings: 最佳模型能够以92.3%的精确度识别交叉申请人，成功创建了全国范围内个人层面的抵押贷款申请整合数据集
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了无需标注训练数据的机器学习评估方法，为无监督学习中的参数优化提供了新思路
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构和监管机构提供了在匿名数据中检测重复申请的有效工具，有助于风险评估和市场监管
